eras.subtitle: A century of shifting alliances and death

events.title: King Jarot Dies, the War Begins
events.summary: King Jarot of Galifar dies. His children reject their eldest sister's claim and the Five Nations turn Jarot's armies on each other.
events.detail: The crown should have passed to Princess Mishann of Cyre. Prince Thalin of Thrane, Prince Kaius of Karrnath and Princess Wroann of Breland refused her, and Prince Wrogar of Aundair's support was not enough. The Five Nations used the armies and new technologies Jarot had amassed to wage war on one another. Nearly a century later the fighting has still not ended.

events.title: House Cannith Builds Flying Fortresses
events.summary: Giant flying military bases take to the skies for the war effort.
events.detail: House Cannith created the flying fortresses in 912 YK. Each is a floating base populated by military personnel under permanent military protocol. Ten are currently deployed by the Brelish military.

events.title: The Grimdell Family Disappears
events.summary: Twenty years into the war, the Grimdell necromancy family vanishes from sight.
events.detail: Grave, Gelyia, Grail, Gelion and Geraldine Grimdell were already a known problem before they disappeared. Decades later they resurface working for House Thuranni, the entertainment house that fronts for assassins and thieves. Their mother is said to always be trying new things with necklaces.

events.title: Brand Broadhelm Framed for Treason
events.summary: Brand refuses Thaddeus Cannith the plans to his suit. Thaddeus frames him for a Thranish plot against the King.
events.detail: Brand and Thaddeus D'Cannith were once friendly rivals. When Brand would not hand over his power suit blueprints, Thaddeus framed him for aiding an assassination attempt on King Boranex. Convicted under the old king, Brand spent the next forty years in prison. Ember's packages never reached him and the Broadhelm forge fell to paranoia without him.

events.title: The Warforged Are Created
events.summary: House Cannith builds living constructs in Cyre to fight the war. They have free will.
events.detail: Warforged are an artificial race of sentient constructs. Clockwork, the Sentinels' artificer, was built to be a Sentinel and builds warforged of his own. The Even Hand and Mustang will prove how far the technology has come.

events.title: The Day the Walls Fell
events.summary: Six days of fighting in Wroat. The Dragons of Centarrel are killed and the dragons leave Khorvaire.
events.detail: The graves in the Tomb of Centarrel are dated from the 8th to the 13th of Eyre 968. High Marshall Elmor Daerthane, Thaldamir's father, and Cedric Ironhard, Gelf's father, both fought and died with the troops. After the dragons were killed the rest of their kind abandoned Khorvaire. Only the pulp-named Steve the Skycracker and Bob the Blazebringer still police the Dagger River skies.

events.title: The Guns of Wroat Are Raised
events.summary: Breland arms its capital after the walls fell.
events.detail: The great guns ring the wall of Wroat beside Brokenblade Castle, where the King resides, and the Citadel, where the High Marshalls direct the war. The party sees them on the Kingsblade's approach. The Dreamweaver later tries to crash the Kingsblade into that Citadel.

events.title: The King Founds the Sentinels
events.summary: A top-secret extra-judicial special forces unit answerable only to the King and the five High Marshalls.
events.detail: Sentinel teams choose their own missions and are held accountable for them. It is easier to ask forgiveness than permission. A gold badge grants authority with no questions asked. Brand remembers the name being floated when he was counsel to the old king, though the project was not approved at that meeting.

events.title: Willow Disappears
events.summary: The shifter elder who warned the young ones to stop embezzling from Aundair vanishes.
events.detail: After Sazed was captured, the younger shifters grew reckless and stole directly from the Aundairian government. Willow warned them and then was never seen again. Without her the elders fled to Breland, and Falken Sagewood founded the hidden village of Hearthsfire.

events.title: First Elemental Airship in Combat
events.summary: House Lyrandar's elemental airships fly into battle for the first time.
events.detail: An elemental ring, bound by Lyrandar magic, lifts the ship. Most are owned by the Aundairian military; a few belong to privateers. Within three years Breland fields Galifar-class ships like the Kingsblade and the Pillar of Dawn.

events.title: Lirael Sr Fixates on the Dreamweaver
events.summary: A general and wizard becomes convinced someone in the Brelish military is trying to capture the Dreamweaver.
events.detail: Lirael Sr, head of the Ardev magic society, turns its whole focus to the Dreamweaver and the Shadow Mirror he believes can control it. He stops eating, stops his duties, dismisses his guard and is discharged after investigating his superiors. His wife sends Lirael Jr to follow him to a warlock cult in Starilaskur, the Watchers of the Gate.

events.title: Lirael Sr Vanishes
events.summary: A year and a half after his obsession began, the general simply disappears.
events.detail: The Sharn magic society denies he ever arrived. His library books are never returned. He had spoken to Blazehelm about the Shadow Mirror shortly before. One last poem in his journal points at a black obelisk: light the way and it will show.

events.title: Massacre of the Watchers of the Gate
events.summary: During a ritual in the Witches Waltz, Lirael is possessed and tears the warlock cult apart.
events.detail: Grand Warlock Maldroc Daelmourn led the celestial warlocks of the Fury through a ritual in which the mirrors became doorways into the astral sea. The Dreamweaver entered Lirael and he killed the Watchers, leaving nothing but gore, then burned their library. He later assassinated Vena Belladonna, head of the magic society, and was imprisoned. Only the young wizard Gelard Greenly saw the possession and he was barred from testifying.

events.title: Glade Founds Stones Throw
events.summary: Glade Amberwood breaks from Hearthsfire to build a shifter village closer to Brelish society.
events.detail: Falken Sagewood warned him it was not safe. Glade kicked the Covenant of Emberfall out after a disagreement and, by rumour, let changelings in. A year later the village burns.

events.title: Bravewind Attacked
events.summary: A changeling village near Ardev is raided and its people fed through a portal.
events.detail: A revived Flock changeling remembers running, being kidnapped, put through a portal and possessed. His orders were to disguise himself, deceive, steal, kill, kidnap drow and kill a dwarf and a shifter. The Flock are the Dreamweaver's expendable hands.

events.title: Royal Ardev Regiment Destroys the Portal
events.summary: Under a black order, Captain Flowers' regiment bombs an ancient teleportation circle in the Boranex forest as a Balor steps through.
events.detail: The cover story was a training exercise for a torch-and-burn op in Thrane. The regiment, conscripts from Lirael's village, used a Broadhelm concussion bomb on the circle. The demons stranded on this side became the quasit village that robs Hobbstweedle. Nobody knows who sent the order.

events.title: The Regiment Is Disbanded
events.summary: Four days after the exercise the Royal Ardev Regiment is scattered across the country, still drawing pay.
events.detail: Captain Flowers is sent to Ardev to replace a police captain who had just died. Murphy Gravewood, Gauss Hog and Kal Valvier stay in Wroat waiting for reassignment. All three are hunted by the Even Hand within the month.

events.title: Stones Throw Massacre
events.summary: Young Silver Flame warriors come from all sides in the dead of night and burn the shifter village.
events.detail: The corpses bear radiant burns. Carrk Moonrunner, the Ring of Siberys, was lured away by a Covenant druid disguised as his fox totem and returned too late. Eight small children and ten-year-old Skye Amberwood hide in the well for a week.

events.title: The Wizard and the Raven
events.summary: Far from DarkWood, a grizzled old wizard opens a long-locked book and reads aloud the prophecy that frames the whole story.
events.detail: In a dim library crammed wall to wall with texts divine and devilish, and with trinkets from a hundred lifetimes, an old human wizard in green robes slumps at his desk, pipe drooping, a raven perched on his staff. The raven caws once and the wizard whips around with unnatural speed, his green eyes finding a scrying eye in the dark; he smirks, puffs his pipe and turns back. Without a word of command the raven pries a book from the shelf, and the wizard releases its ancient clasp. He reads of a century of war entering its final stage, “its shrieking twilight, its howling dark, the swan song.” “But you are not heroes, you are not soldiers, and you are not villains, you are criminals. And yet it is your hands which hold the quill.” The characters know nothing of this scene. It is simply where their story begins.

events.title: Waking on the Prison Train
events.summary: Three criminals wake in the dark of a lurching prison train, freshly out of one prison and bound for another.
events.detail: The characters wake to nothing but darkness, remembering only that they recently left a prison. The train lurches to a stop, and they brace as the carriage opens and light floods in. The new arrivals ride in two carriages. Brand shares the first with Tauren Thickcock, Scud Barlowe and Elarian. Lirael and Sazed ride in the second with Leff and Rolick Erenside. Not all of these fellow prisoners will survive the week.

events.title: Fresh Fish at the Gates
events.summary: The carriages roll through the woods to DarkWood Prison, and the inmates behind the walls start chanting: fresh fish, fresh fish.
events.detail: The journey continues into thick woods and up to a new prison. The players were promised it would not be a corn maze, and it is not. As the carriages approach the gates, a chant rises from inside the walls: “Fresh fish, fresh fish.” The arrivals are split into bunks. Lirael and Elarian share the first with Tauren, and Brand and Sazed share the second with Leff.

events.title: Bloodworth Takes Their Treasures
events.summary: Officer Bloodworth strips the new prisoners of the things they treasure most.
events.detail: Officer Bloodworth confiscates each prisoner's most precious belongings. Elarian loses his pendant. Sazed loses his book, Whispers of Wind and Grass, and his Oath Watcher pendant. Brand loses his holy symbol, and his power armor suit ends up locked away too. Getting all of it back becomes the party's first goal once the prison erupts.

events.title: A Sending Stone Behind the Wall
events.summary: Lirael pulls a loose rock from his bunk wall and finds a hidden picture and a sending stone.
events.detail: In the first bunk, Lirael works a rock loose from the wall. Behind it is a picture of a goofy, soft-faced man and a small stone. Brand recognises the stone as a sending stone. It connects to other people inside the prison. Over the next day it brings Lirael conversations with Sheldor Higgins and Faird, and it becomes his favourite tool for scheming.

events.title: Thaldamir Snaps His Fingers
events.summary: In the cafeteria Elarian provokes the elf Thaldamir Daerthane, who snaps his fingers, and everyone rolls initiative.
events.detail: At the cafeteria, Lirael is slipped something special by the prisoner Keys. Elarian then manages to anger Thaldamir Daerthane, an elf who leads one of the prison's gangs. Thaldamir snaps his fingers and his gang closes in. The first session ends with everyone rolling initiative. Some of the gang members killed in this first cafeteria fight will be back later, raised as zombies in the prison yard.

events.title: Bloodworth Tortures Sazed
events.summary: Officer Bloodworth tortures Sazed and keeps asking the same question: who sent you?
events.detail: Sazed is taken away and tortured by Officer Bloodworth. Through all of it, Bloodworth asks one thing: who sent you? Sazed has no real answer to give. The truth, which nobody knows yet, is that the Sentinels arranged for the party to be sent to DarkWood. The torture gives Sazed a personal score with Bloodworth. Before the escape is over, he will kill Bloodworth three times.

events.title: Halien Talks with Elric Galen
events.summary: Halien has a quiet conversation with Elric Galen, the guard the party will come to call the good guard.
events.detail: Halien has a private conversation with Elric Galen. Nobody at the table recorded what was said. In hindsight, it matters a great deal. Halien Habberschmidt's real name is Gelf Ironhard, and both men are undercover agents of the Sentinels. The two of them were in charge of getting the party sent to DarkWood in the first place.

events.title: Lirael Plays Cromwell
events.summary: A voice on the sending stone asks for someone called Cromwell, and Lirael convinces it, more or less, that he is Cromwell.
events.detail: The sending stone comes alive with a voice asking for Cromwell. It belongs to Sheldor Higgins, who is searching for his friend. Lirael plays along and mostly sells it. More stone conversations follow, including one with Faird, and the talk turns to a plan to kill Rex, the leader of a prison gang. Sheldor will learn the truth about his Cromwell once the prison is burning.

events.title: Newbie Night
events.summary: The guards march the new prisoners to initiation night, hand them weapons and tell them to fight each other one on one.
events.detail: The fresh arrivals are taken away to initiation night, which the guards call newbie night. Each prisoner is handed a weapon. The rule is that they fight each other, one on one. Officer Bloodworth and his guards are there to watch. The party looks at the weapons in their hands, and then at the guards.

events.title: Initiation Night Becomes a Prison Break
events.summary: Instead of fighting each other, the prisoners turn their new weapons on the guards and kill Officer Bloodworth.
events.detail: Handed weapons and told to fight one another, the party decides to kill all the guards and start a prison break instead. It works. Officer Bloodworth, Sazed's torturer, dies along with his goons. It is the first time the party truly fights together. Bloodworth does not stay dead for long.

events.title: The Alarm Is Pulled
events.summary: Two guards escape the newbie night massacre, the alarm sounds, and DarkWood erupts into a full prison riot.
events.detail: Not every guard dies at the fight. Two get away, and one of them is Fumble Figgins, who runs. On the prisoners' side, Tauren falls and Scud runs off. Someone pulls the alarm. The whole prison rises in riot, guards against prisoners and gang against gang.

events.title: Snatched Off the Ledge
events.summary: Elarian is snatched off a ledge, and Lirael, Brand, Scud and Leff drift down after him on Lirael's feather fall.
events.detail: In the chaos, Elarian is grabbed and pulled off a ledge. Lirael casts feather fall, and he, Brand, Scud and Leff float down after him. They land on the prison's first level in the middle of another fight. Alongside other prisoners, they set about finishing off the guards waiting there.

events.title: Sazed Breaks Out Swinging
events.summary: Sazed fights his way out of the cell riot to rejoin the party and starts knocking guards flat, while Lirael puts others to sleep.
events.detail: Sazed escapes a riot in the cells to help the party. He promptly starts million-dollar-babying everyone, knocking guards out three times over. By the end he is up to two burning skulls. Lirael puts a group of guards to sleep. The party wins the fight on the first level and kills every guard there but two.

events.title: Shmem Gorgis Dies
events.summary: The tuba player Shmem Gorgis dies in the fighting, and his send-off nearly burns down the prison.
events.detail: Shmem Gorgis, a tuba player and friend of Sorenson, is killed in the first-level fight. The party gives him a short send-off. It involves fire, and the fire nearly takes the prison with it. They put it out with buckets of water from the kitchen. Shmem does not stay gone: he comes back as a zombie in the prison yard.

events.title: Byll and Cyriel Are Spared
events.summary: Lirael puts the last two guards, Byll and Cyriel, to sleep, and Byll bargains for his freedom by offering to show the party their gear.
events.detail: The only guards left alive are Byll and Cyriel. Lirael puts them to sleep and they are locked in a cell. Byll wakes and makes an offer: let him out, and he will show the party where their gear is hidden and the way out. The party takes him along as a captive guide. Both guards survive the escape and later end up trapped on the roof with Thaldamir.

events.title: Sorenson Gets Shmem's Tuba
events.summary: The party meets Sorenson, breaks the news that his friend Shmem is dead, and hands him Shmem's tuba.
events.detail: The party meets Sorenson and tells him Shmem has died. They give him Shmem's tuba. The party also frees the prisoners in this part of the prison. Over the sending stone, Keys and Faird call for help: they are trapped in the cafeteria. Elarian, Sorenson, Tauren, Leff and Rolick run off to help them while the party pushes on toward the gear.

events.title: Saving Elric Galen
events.summary: The party finds Elric Galen, the good guard, about to be killed by another guard, and saves him.
events.detail: On the way to the gear, the party runs into Elric Galen being attacked by another guard. They save him just before he is killed. Elric says he will help them find their equipment. With a better guide in hand, the party lets Byll go. The guard who tried to kill Elric later rises among Grail's zombies, and Elric turns out to be far more than a guard.

events.title: Zombie Bloodworth in the Pit
events.summary: Passing the pit, Brand is nearly dragged in when an undead Bloodworth leaps out and grabs him.
events.detail: The route to the equipment runs past a pit with its own elevator. Officer Bloodworth, killed at newbie night only hours earlier, leaps out of it undead and grabs Brand. Brand nearly goes over the edge before the party pulls him back. They send the pit's elevator back down. It is the first sign that DarkWood's dead are not staying dead.

events.title: Rex and Thaldamir's Gang War
events.summary: Rex's gang and Thaldamir's gang are locked in battle right across the path to the equipment room, so the party lets them fight.
events.detail: The way to the equipment room is blocked by a gang war. Rex and his gang are fighting Thaldamir and his crew. Rather than wade in, the party decides to let the two gangs wear each other down. They sneak off to find another way around. The route takes them back past the pit.

events.title: Cutting the Pit Elevator
events.summary: Back at the pit, the elevator is rising with zombie Bloodworth and his zombie guards aboard, so the party shoots the ropes.
events.detail: Passing the pit a second time, the party notices the elevator coming back up. Riding it are zombie Bloodworth and his team of zombie guards, almost at the top. The party fires on the elevator ropes. The ropes snap and the elevator falls, taking undead Bloodworth and the soldiers down with it. It buys time, but not much.

events.title: Lirael Plays Both Sides of the Riot
events.summary: Lirael tells the rioting guards to go rescue Thaldamir and tells the rioting prisoners to go rescue Rex, and both sides go.
events.detail: The party has to get past the riot. Lirael tells the guards that Rex and Thaldamir are fighting and that Thaldamir needs their help. Then he tells the rioting prisoners that Rex needs theirs. Both groups run off to join the gang war. The party sneaks past the commotion, and Lirael earns inspiration because the whole thing is so funny.

events.title: Talking Past the Barricade
events.summary: Frightened young officers have barricaded the officer cafeteria, and Lirael and Elric talk their way in.
events.detail: The officer cafeteria is barricaded by a group of frightened young officers. Lirael and Elric convince them that the party are officers too. The officers let them into the officer lounge. Its far side leads straight to the warden's office. These young officers later rise among Grail's dead.

events.title: Warden Sharpe's Confession
events.summary: Cornered in his office, Warden Sharpe admits DarkWood is an experiment turning ex-Brelish soldiers into zombies for an attack on Karrnath.
events.detail: The party breaks into the warden's office through the cafeteria and finds Warden Sharpe with his secretary, Magnot Whitlin. Sharpe spills what he knows. The prison is turning ex-Brelish soldiers into undead for an attack on Karrnath, and there is a ritual room for the work. He does not know who he is really working for. He says the army has been hollowed out and the High Marshalls have been deceived. The party puts the warden to sleep and moves on.

events.title: Erald Dwelve Names the Necromancer
events.summary: The record keeper Erald Dwelve hands over the prison's records and gives the necromancer a name: Grail Grimdell.
events.detail: The party meets Erald Dwelve, the prison's record keeper. Erald holds records of the necromancy done inside DarkWood, and he hands them over. From him the party learns the name of the necromancer behind it all: Grail Grimdell. Erald joins the escape and later travels with the party. He also turns out to own a pet mimic named Chester.

events.title: Thaldamir Begs for His Life
events.summary: The party thorn-whips Thaldamir through the prison bars; he begs for his life, promises millions of gold, and ends up chained to a wall.
events.detail: Sneaking back past the gang fight, the party is spotted by Thaldamir. They thorn-whip him over to them through the bars. He begs for his life and promises them millions of gold. The party spares him, but they cuff his hands and chain him to a wall.

events.title: Brand Suits Up
events.summary: The secret inventory room gives the party their gear back at last, and Brand does an awesome iron man transition into his power armor.
events.detail: The party finally reaches the secret inventory room. Inside are thieves' tools, trap disarm tools, Elarian's pendant, Sazed's book Whispers of Wind and Grass and his Oath Watcher pendant, and Brand's suit and holy symbol. Brand climbs into his power armor in an awesome iron man transition. In the corner stands a mirror with a tarp thrown over it.

events.title: Nightmares in the Mirror
events.summary: The tarp comes off the mirror and everyone is dragged into a personal nightmare until Sazed smashes it.
events.detail: Lirael walks a pier behind his family; they cannot hear him, and the faster he runs the farther away they get. Brand walks the streets of Sharn running red with blood, hides under a corpse, and watches soldiers in mechanical suits of armor duckwalk out of the smoke. Sazed leaves his hut to find his village on fire and ringed by soldiers, and the villagers' corpses rise, point at him and say “It was you.” Each wakes in a cold sweat. Sazed destroys the mirror. Mirrors will come back to haunt the party later.

events.title: Chester the Mimic's Gift
events.summary: A friendly mimic named Chester only wants to see how good the party is at lockpicking, and rewards them with a bag of holding.
events.detail: In the inventory room the party meets a friendly mimic. He just wants to see how good they are at picking locks. Impressed, he hands them a bag of holding. It is not a bag of holding, as Sazed discovers two days later. Meanwhile a fire in the secretary's office goes ignored and spreads, and the party heads up to the cafeteria to help Keys and Faird.

events.title: The Cafeteria Rescue
events.summary: Brand thunderwaves through the enemy ranks, Lirael fights with a blade of shadow, and Sazed brains guards with his quarterstaff to save their allies.
events.detail: The party bursts into the prison cafeteria, where Elarian, Sorenson, Tauren, Leff, Rolick, Keys and Faird are fighting for their lives. Brand thunderwaves through the enemy ranks. Lirael fights with a blade of shadow. Sazed brains guards with his quarterstaff. The party turns the tide and saves their friends.

events.title: Out Through the Broken Wall
events.summary: Elarian is blown out through the cafeteria wall, the dead start rising below, and the party rappels through the hole into the yard.
events.detail: An explosion blows Elarian up and throws him out through the destroyed cafeteria wall. Below, the necromancer is raising everyone, and an undead horde is massing through the prison. Thaldamir's gang, Rex's gang and Chester the mimic flee for the roof. The party rappels down through the hole in the wall into the prison yard. Rex joins them.

events.title: Grail Grimdell Raises the Dead
events.summary: In the burning prison yard Grail Grimdell thanks the party for so many beautiful corpses, and everyone they have killed stands back up.
events.detail: The necromancer Grail Grimdell confronts the party in the yard, composed and eloquent. “I must thank you, you have given me so many beautiful corpses for my army. I'm sure you'll recognise them.” He offers them a special place at his side. The dead rise from the ground: Officer Bloodworth, Shmem Gorgis, Scud Barlowe, Magnot Whitlin and Warden Sharpe. Behind them come Bloodworth's personal guard, the guards from every fight, the young officers from the barricade, and gang members from the very first cafeteria brawl. Everyone the party has killed is back.

events.title: The Horde Overwhelms Brand
events.summary: As fire spreads through the prison, the party tries to run; Lirael gets clear, but the zombies swarm Brand and kill Rolick Erenside.
events.detail: Fire is starting to engulf the prison, and the party tries to run from the zombies. Rex, Leff and Rolick charge in to fight. Lirael manages to escape and Sazed is almost clear, but the horde overwhelms Brand. On the roof, Byll, Cyriel, Chester, Thaldamir and many other prisoners and guards are trapped in a losing fight against the zombies and the flames. Rolick Erenside is killed by the zombies.

events.title: Brand Kills Grail Grimdell
events.summary: Brand fights his way out from under the horde and kills Grail Grimdell, and every zombie in the yard drops dead.
events.detail: Pinned by the horde, Brand still reaches the necromancer. He kills Grail Grimdell. The moment Grail dies, all of the zombies fall dead around him. The party catches its breath. For a few minutes it looks like the nightmare is over.

events.title: Grail's Final Form
events.summary: Grail's necklace raises him as an awakened zombie, more deranged and more powerful, and his dead rise again remembering their lives.
events.detail: As the party starts to rest, the necklace on Grail's corpse raises him as an awakened zombie. He is now noticeably more deranged and far more powerful. With an evil laugh he declares: “You fools think you won. You have only allowed me to achieve my final form!” He vows to become lord of the dead, his dead covering the earth and suffocating the light from this world. All his zombies rise again, their souls now bound to their bodies so they remember their former lives, zombie Rolick among them. “Now my children look upon your killers and help them join us!”

events.title: Invisible Grail and the Meat Shield
events.summary: Grail turns invisible, turns Brand's attacks onto his own zombies, and Rex falls and rises as one of them.
events.detail: Grail turns invisible to avoid being attacked. He reveals himself only to try a vampiric touch on Brand, without success. Then he uses Undead Meat Shield, turning Brand's attacks against him into attacks on his zombies. Rex is killed and rises as a zombie. Zombie Rolick throws dust of dryness at Sazed and the barbarians. The fight is slipping away from the party.

events.title: Lirael Talks Damron Pink Around
events.summary: Lirael convinces the guard Damron Pink to open the gate and send help, even though the party killed all his friends, and returns with Fumble Figgins and guards.
events.detail: Lirael breaks away and reaches Damron Pink at the gate. The party has killed Damron's friends, Bloodworth and his blood guards among them. Lirael convinces him to open the gate and send guards to help anyway. He returns to the fight triumphantly, with Fumble Figgins and a squad of guards behind him. The tide of the battle turns.

events.title: Bloodworth Dies a Third Time
events.summary: Sazed gets his final revenge on his torturer, smashing zombie Bloodworth's skull to pieces.
events.detail: Bloodworth died at newbie night, rose in the pit, and rose again in the yard. Sazed, whom Bloodworth tortured, faces him one last time. He smashes zombie Bloodworth's skull to pieces. It is the third time Bloodworth has been killed. This one sticks.

events.title: Grail's Lieutenants Fall
events.summary: One by one the named zombies go down: Rolick, Rex, Scud, Shmem, Magnot and Warden Sharpe.
events.detail: With the guards in the fight, the party cuts through Grail's best. Zombie Rolick the druggy, Rex the gang leader, Scud the pyro, Shmem the tuba player, Magnot the secretary and Warden Sharpe are all killed. Zombie Scud, now remembering his life, loves how he goes. He burns to death. Only Grail is left.

events.title: Brand's Seeking Shot Ends Grail
events.summary: Brand's iron man seeking attack punches clean through Grail from brain to backside, and the necromancer falls for good.
events.detail: Grail Grimdell has been killed once already and came back stronger. This time Brand ends it with his iron man seeking attack. The table's description of the shot is simple: in at the brain, out the other end. Grail falls and does not rise again. His necklace is left on the corpse.

events.title: Mourning the Fallen
events.summary: In the quiet after the battle, Sorenson mourns his tuba player Shmem and Leff mourns Rex.
events.detail: The party mourns the allies they lost. Rolick and Rex both died in the fight. Sorenson mourns Shmem, his tuba player. Leff mourns Rex, whom he looked up to. The prison is still burning around them.

events.title: Down from the Roof, Except Thaldamir
events.summary: Lirael feather-falls the survivors off the burning roof but lets Thaldamir drop and break his leg; Brand knocks him out and everyone spits in his face.
events.detail: Byll, Cyriel, Chester and other prisoners and guards are stranded on the roof. Lirael uses feather fall to bring them down safely. Chester turns out to be Erald's pet mimic; Erald called to him on the roof. Lirael lets Thaldamir fall, and the elf breaks his leg. When Thaldamir starts complaining, Brand knocks him out cold, and then everyone spits in his face.

events.title: Sheldor Looks for Cromwell
events.summary: Sheldor Higgins charges out of the burning prison calling for his friend Cromwell, and Lirael admits it was him on the stone.
events.detail: Sheldor Higgins comes charging out of the flaming prison entrance, slaying zombies and leading prisoners behind him. He is calling for his friend Cromwell and cannot find him. Lirael admits he was the one pretending to be Cromwell on the sending stone. Sheldor is unhappy. He says he has not heard from the real Cromwell in weeks.

events.title: Grail's Necklace
events.summary: On Grail's body the party finds the necklace that brought him back: whoever dies wearing it rises as a zombie possessed by Grail.
events.detail: The party searches Grail Grimdell's corpse. They find the necklace that raised him as an awakened zombie. It will raise its wearer as a zombie possessed by Grail. The party keeps it. Two nights later Lirael wears it to pass himself off as Grail reborn, and Grail's brother uses it on himself.

events.title: The Note Signed DDT
events.summary: A mysterious note on Grail's body, signed DDT, summons him to the hidden mountain village of Mara'bor.
events.detail: Alongside the necklace, the party finds a note. “Grail my friend, I will be needing your assistance once again. You have been of great service to the organization and we ask for your heed again. As usual nothing will be in writing, meet me at the hidden mountain village of Mara'bor for more instructions.” It is signed DDT. Brand remembers Mara'bor from a book about hidden mountain villages he read as a kid. Elric says he knows how to get there.

events.title: Cool Guys Don't Look at Explosions
events.summary: The fire reaches the armory and DarkWood Prison explodes behind the party as they walk out free.
events.detail: As the party leaves, the fire reaches the prison armory and DarkWood explodes. Cool guys don't look at explosions, and the party keeps walking. They pass out through the prison walls. For the first time in a long time, they are free.

events.title: Damron Pink's Ultimatum
events.summary: Damron Pink lets the party take horses and carriages, and promises to kill them if he ever sees them again.
events.detail: Damron Pink tells the party he won't forget that they stopped the necromancer. He also won't forget that they killed his friends. They can take horses and carriages. But if he ever sees them again, he will kill them. Damron starts to pack up with Fumble Figgins, Byll and Cyriel.

events.title: Sheldor Teaches the Snel Katar
events.summary: On the road to Mara'bor, Lirael explains himself to Sheldor, who forgives him and teaches him the drow handshake, the Snel Katar.
events.detail: The party leaves for Mara'bor with Elric, Halien, Tauren, Leff, Sorenson, Keys, Faird, Erald, Sheldor and Chester the mimic. On the road, Lirael talks to Sheldor about why he pretended to be Cromwell. Sheldor understands. He shows Lirael the traditional drow handshake ritual, the Snel Katar. Anywhere you go, it is a sign of friendship and trust between drow. Someone else had a conversation on the road too, but nobody remembers what it was.

events.title: Bluffing the Mine Guards
events.summary: At the mine entrance to Mara'bor, the party lies its way past the two guards, Spingel and Joerick.
events.detail: The party arrives at the mine entrance that leads to Mara'bor. Two guards stand watch: Spingel and Joerick. The party deceives them into letting everyone through. The two guards will pay for that mistake. The next day Damron Pink yells at them for it and sends them to hunt the party down.

events.title: Halien Stands Watch
events.summary: Halien sends the rest of the freed prisoners away and stays to guard the entrance while Elric takes the party into Mara'bor.
events.detail: At the mine entrance the group splits. Halien tells Tauren, Leff, Sorenson, Keys, Faird, Erald and Chester where to go, and they leave. Later the party learns they went to the Kingsblade. Halien stays behind to stand guard at the entrance. Elric takes the party on into Mara'bor alone.

events.title: A Wild Cart Ride Down
events.summary: Elric takes the party down into the mountain on a wild mine cart ride to the hidden village of Mara'bor.
events.detail: The way into Mara'bor runs downward through the mine. The party rides a cart, and the ride is wild. At the bottom lies the hidden mountain village Brand once read about as a child. Elric leads them to his house.

events.title: Supper at Elric's House
events.summary: Elric cooks for everyone and grudgingly gives Sazed a black covert ops uniform, while the party plies him with questions and Lirael reads his thoughts.
events.detail: At his house Elric makes everyone food. Sazed asks for new clothes instead of his prison fatigues. Elric hems and haws, then hands him a black covert ops uniform. The party starts plying Elric for information. Quietly, Lirael casts detect thoughts.

events.title: Elric Reveals the Sentinels
events.summary: Elric admits that Halien is really Gelf Ironhard, that both are Sentinels, and that they sent the party to DarkWood on purpose.
events.detail: Under questioning, Elric reveals that Halien Habberschmidt's real name is Gelf Ironhard. Both men belong to an extra-judicial Brelish military unit called the Sentinels. They were in charge of sending the party to DarkWood Prison. The Sentinels want to stop the necromancy plot, and they are interested in the party as applicants. To join, you must complete a task. Let's just say the party did that well.

events.title: Brand Remembers the Old King's Council
events.summary: The name Sentinels stirs a memory: Brand once sat in a council with the old king and the High Marshalls where it was proposed.
events.detail: Brand remembers his time as counsel to the old king. At one meeting, with the High Marshalls among many others present, the council discussed an extra-judicial Brelish military unit. The project was not approved. Many names were thrown around for it, and one of them was the Sentinels. Brand has not said which side he took at that meeting.

events.title: DDT and the Dragonmarked Houses
events.summary: Someone has a brain blast: the first D in DDT could be the D' that starts a dragonmarked house name.
events.detail: The note on Grail's body was signed DDT. Late in the night someone at the table has a brain blast. The first D could be the D' that comes before the name of a dragonmarked house. The guess pays off the next afternoon. In Grail's cellar the party finds the sigil of House D'Thuranni.

events.title: Elric Throws a Spoon
events.summary: Elric realises someone has been reading his thoughts, deduces it is Lirael, and throws a spoon at him.
events.detail: Partway through the night, Elric realises someone has been reading his mind. He works out that it is Lirael. He throws a spoon at him and scolds him for his rudeness. The party finally goes to bed around 6:30 in the morning. They wake around 2:30 in the afternoon.

events.title: Tea with the Warden's Widow
events.summary: Posing as Brelish army men, the party visits Warden Sharpe's widow Verona, who already knows her husband is dead and makes them tea.
events.detail: Elric gives the party the lay of the town, and they decide to explore the Sharpe house first. They tell Verona Sharpe they are from the Brelish army, here to interrogate a prisoner. She tells them they are too late: her husband is dead. Damron has not told her what happened, but she is no fool; she knew who her husband was and what he was involved in, and his absence means he is dead. She lets them search his things and makes them tea. They find the warden's personal effects, a painting of his family, and his son's suicide note, and nothing else useful.

events.title: Spying on Damron's House
events.summary: The party peeks into the Bloodworth Bar, then overhears Damron Pink screaming at Spingel and Joerick for letting them into Mara'bor.
events.detail: The party peers into the Bloodworth Bar and sees Fiona Bloodworth with her two kids, Mug and Kari. They decide not to go in, though the players joke darkly about coming back for them later. Then they hear yelling from Damron's house. Through the window they see Damron Pink tearing into the two guards, Spingel and Joerick, for letting the party in. He hands them a bag full of scrolls and orders them to find the party.

events.title: Bloodworth's Voice from the Abandoned House
events.summary: Brand's suit glints and nearly gives them away, so the party lures the guards off with fake cries from a dead man: Officer Bloodworth.
events.detail: Spingel and Joerick come out of Damron's house. The whole party hides except Brand, whose suit gives off a faint glint. They duck behind an abandoned house while the guards come to investigate. Brand tinkers a rock to play his own impression of Bloodworth and throws it behind the guards. Lirael adds a minor illusion of Bloodworth's voice inside the abandoned house, banging and asking for help. The guards forget the noise and start trying to unbar the front door to rescue Bloodworth.

events.title: Ambush at the Abandoned House
events.summary: Sazed blows the stealth, Lirael sleeps Spingel, Joerick misty-steps away, and Lirael jumps a river to put him down too.
events.detail: The party rips the boards off the back window at the same moment the guards rip the boards off the front door. Sazed tries to walk around the house to watch them, fails his stealth check, and alerts them. The guards come around the building, but the party has already jumped in through the window. Lirael pokes out and casts sleep, dropping Spingel, and the party surrounds Joerick and nearly beats him to death. Joerick misty-steps away to run and tell Damron, but Lirael jumps the river and puts him to sleep. The party drags both guards inside, takes their scrolls, ties and gags them, and warns them that if they try anything they will be killed.

events.title: Grail's Lair Under the Floor
events.summary: Under the abandoned house is Grail's black-and-purple lair, with a family portrait, a House D'Thuranni sigil, a map of five prisons and a goth sending stone.
events.detail: Searching the trashed abandoned house, the party finds a trap door to a hidden cellar. Elric stays upstairs to watch the guards. Below is Grail's living area: a black and purple one-room abode full of necromantic items. They find a painting of the Grimdell family when they were younger and the sigil of House D'Thuranni. They also find a map of the Yedani Mountains with five prisons marked on it, and a goth sending stone. DarkWood was only one of them.

events.title: Calling Grail's Brother
events.summary: Pretending to be Grail on the goth sending stone, the party sets up a midnight meeting with his brother.
events.detail: The party decides to impersonate Grail on the sending stone. They put on an act that he is still fighting at the prison and the tide has turned against him. Grail's brother answers and agrees to meet at the abandoned house in Mara'bor that night. The plan is for Lirael to wear Grail's necklace and convince the brother he is Grail reincarnated, with the party as his allies. What they will do after that is unclear, probably not fully thought out, like all great D&D plans.

events.title: The Bag of Devouring
events.summary: Sazed tries to stow the Grimdell painting in Chester's bag of holding and is dragged inside by tentacles; it is a bag of devouring.
events.detail: Sazed tries to put the family painting into the bag of holding Chester gave them. The bag is actually a bag of devouring. Its nasty tentacles grab Sazed and drag him inside. He passes his strength check and hauls himself back out. The party fishes the painting back out of the bag. The 11,000 gold they had stored in it is gone.

events.title: Gelf Behind the Closet Door
events.summary: Back at Elric's ransacked house, the party finds Gelf hurt and hiding behind a secret closet door, and he collects on a bet.
events.detail: The party carries the sleeping guards to Elric's house, using minor illusion to make it look like they are carrying a box. The house has been ransacked. Gelf is hiding behind a secret door at the back of the closet, and the guards go in there too. Gelf is injured: Damron came back to the camp and knew who he was, so Gelf escaped the guards outside, slipped into Mara'bor and ran into a gelatinous cube. Elric admits he spilled the beans about the Sentinels. Gelf laughs at him; they had a bet on it, and Elric pays up.

events.title: Gelf Tells All
events.summary: Gelf ignores Elric's protests and explains why the Sentinels sent the party to DarkWood, and who the Grimdells really work for.
events.detail: Elric says they are not authorized to say, but Gelf does not care. The Sentinels learned of the necromancy from an agent inside DarkWood; the prisons are black book projects not even the High Marshalls knew about. They sent the party in on purpose, two birds with one stone: destroy the prison and recruit new Sentinels after recent heavy losses. When the party is skeptical, Gelf says their personal desires may line up with the Sentinels' more than they think, though he admits he was never told how; Major Blazehelm knows and has offers for each of them. House D'Thuranni, he explains, is an entertainment house hiding a dark underbelly of thievery and murder. The Grimdell necromancer family vanished about twenty years into the war and has recently resurfaced working for House D'Thuranni. When the party lays out the plan to ambush Grail's brother, Elric and Gelf are completely in.

events.title: Rotten Potatoes
events.summary: Damron searches the abandoned house, and Lirael's illusion of a crawl space full of rotten potatoes fools him; Fumble Figgins wants to eat them.
events.detail: Gelf and Elric stay to guard the prisoners while the party sneaks back to the abandoned house. Lirael trips on Brand's thrown stone just as Byll and Cyriel leave their house, and Brand thorn-whips him inside before anyone sees. During a short rest the party talks about how they each ended up in the military. Then Gelf calls on the stone: Damron has noticed Spingel and Joerick are missing and is searching all of Mara'bor. When Damron and his guards check the cellar hatch, Lirael's minor illusion shows a small crawl space of rotten potatoes, and they buy it; Fumble Figgins wants to eat some, but Damron won't let him. Damron heads off to search Elric's house again, so the party warns Elric and Gelf, who sneak over and join the stakeout.

events.title: Grail's Brother Comes to Call
events.summary: At midnight Grail's brother arrives, and Lirael, wearing the necklace, convinces him he is Grail reborn.
events.detail: At midnight Grail's brother, later named by Major Blazehelm as Gelion Grimdell, arrives at the abandoned house. The party tells him to go into the cellar. He questions his “brother”: why is he allied with the living, and why, if he was reincarnated, is he not a zombie? Lirael sells it, and the brother exclaims that their mother was always trying new things with the necklaces. Before they leave, the brother suggests they turn Lirael's friends into zombies. Lirael says he is too tired to do it, so the brother offers to do it himself.

events.title: Kicked Down the Hatch
events.summary: Lirael kicks Grail's brother down the cellar hatch and the beating begins; he conjures skeletons and flees invisible.
events.detail: Lirael kicks Grail's brother down the hatch into the cellar, and everyone piles on. The brother conjures skeletons to fight the party. Sazed manages to steal the necklace. The brother turns invisible and flies out of the cellar. One of his skeletons steals the necklace back, and the skeletons leave the cellar after him.

events.title: The Brother Dies to Rise
events.summary: Sazed rips the necklace from a skeleton, but the brother downs him, puts it on, and kills himself to rise as an awakened zombie.
events.detail: The party chases upstairs, casting faerie fire to find the invisible brother. Sazed rips the necklace away from the skeleton. The brother reveals himself and downs Sazed. He takes the necklace and puts it on. Then he kills himself, and rises again as an awakened zombie, just like his brother did in the DarkWood yard.

events.title: Into the Bag of Devouring
events.summary: The only way to beat an awakened zombie is the bag: Brand piledrives Grail's brother into the Bag of Devouring, and it burps.
events.detail: The party knows the only way to win now is to put him in the bag. Brand heals Sazed and begins to piledrive Grail's brother into the Bag of Devouring. Lirael holds the bag open while Sazed helps guide him in. The brother fails his strength check. He screams as the bag eats him. The bag burps.

events.title: Mara'bor Abandoned
events.summary: The party steps out to find Mara'bor deserted, releases their two captive guards, and finds every horse and carriage gone.
events.detail: The party leaves the abandoned house to find all of Mara'bor abandoned; the families who lived there have gone. They release Spingel and Joerick, warning them that if they ever see them again they will kill them. Outside the village, all of the horses and carriages are gone. Elric and Gelf say they have a place to stay, where the rest of the freed prisoners are. The party starts walking.

events.title: Something Bellows in the Clouds
events.summary: On the walk, a rumble like a stampede and the bellow of some massive monster pass overhead, and red and blue lights glow in the clouds.
events.detail: While the party walks, they feel a rumbling like a stampede coming toward them. They hear a sound like a massive bellowing monster. It screams by above them and carries on toward the mountain. Looking up into the overcast sky, they see blue and red lights inside the clouds.

events.title: Chief Petty Officer Paxon
events.summary: Soldiers appear out of thin air in a clearing, and Gelf trades barbs with Chief Petty Officer Smildar Paxon until he lets them in.
events.detail: After about a forty-minute walk the party reaches a clearing. “Leave this to me and Elric okay guys?” says Gelf, as soldiers and Paxon appear out of nowhere. “Hey there Smildar.” “Oh we're using first names now Gelf? Is that proper military vernacular?” Gelf greets him as “Chief Pettiest of Petty Officers Smildar Paxon his Holiness,” insists the party won't be prisoners much longer, and Paxon sighs that he was really enjoying how nice and quiet the Kingsblade was without him. Paxon writes something on his sheet, signals them to follow, and he and the soldiers vanish as quickly as they appeared.

events.title: The Kingsblade Revealed
events.summary: Crossing an invisible threshold, the party passes through a massive illusion and sees a humongous airship, where Major Blazehelm welcomes them into the Sentinels.
events.detail: “Let's go everyone,” says Gelf. As Elric and Gelf lead the party forward, they too disappear. Crossing the threshold, the party passes through a massive illusion spell and sees a humongous airship in front of them: the Kingsblade, a brand new Galifar class ship on its maiden voyage. A gangway opens. Major Blazehelm introduces himself and welcomes the party into the Sentinels. The DarkWood arc is over.

events.title: Through the Illusion: The Sentinels
events.summary: The party steps through an illusion in a forest clearing and finds a massive airship with tents pitched beneath it, where Major Renaud Blazehelm explains who he really serves.
events.detail: Waiting below the ship are Chief Petty Officer Smildar Paxon and Major Renaud Blazehelm, who leads them into a tent to talk. The Sentinels, he explains, are a top secret, extrajudicial special forces unit created by King Ir'Wynarn. They report only to the King and the five High Marshals. Sentinel teams run independently and choose their own missions, but they are still held accountable for what they do. Blazehelm sums up the philosophy plainly: "It's easier to ask for forgiveness than permission." Every Sentinel carries a gold badge that grants authority; flash it, and no questions are asked.

events.title: The Prison Was a Trial
events.summary: Blazehelm reveals that the party's imprisonment in DarkWood was arranged: tearing the prison apart was their Sentinel trial all along.
events.detail: A Sentinel had uncovered the necromancy going on inside the prison and passed word to Blazehelm. Records were quietly fudged so the party would be sent there, with the dismantling of the prison as their test. Gelf went in undercover as a fellow inmate, and Elric was hired on as a guard to keep watch over them. By Blazehelm's account they did an amazing job, destroying the prison outright. Their efforts even earned their NPC friends from the prison applications to join the Sentinels.

events.title: The Grimdells and House Thuranni
events.summary: Blazehelm names the Grimdell family and the house behind them, and finally gives a name to the mysterious initials DDT.
events.detail: The Major knows the Grimdells by name: Gelion, the dead brother; Geraldine, the daughter; Gelyia, the mother; and Grave, the father. The family is known to work with House Thuranni. Thuranni presents itself as an entertainment house, but it is a front for assassins and thieves. DDT, Blazehelm tells them, is Deckard D'Thuranni, the head of the house. The party also mentions the sounds of something flying over them on the way to the Kingsblade, and Blazehelm suspects Aundairians are tracking them.

events.title: Blazehelm's Three Offers
events.summary: In the tent below the airship, the Major lays out what the Sentinels know about each of them and what he can give each in return for joining.
events.detail: To Sazed he says he understands his loyalty is not to Breland: Sazed may have spied, but the people he betrayed were Breland's enemies and the people he saved were Brelish citizens, so as far as Blazehelm is concerned he helped Breland. He adds a warning that the Silver Flame may have covertly started a new inquisition, and shifter clans are going dark. Brand, the Major knows, was framed; the Sentinels want to find out who did it and clear his name, he may keep wearing his armor, and his inventions will be protected from people like Thaddeus Cannith. Lirael was possessed when he assassinated the head of the magic society and was not responsible. His father went missing searching for the Shadow Mirror, and the Sentinels are hunting for both. Blazehelm admits he is no fan of the Brelish military as it stands and wants their help cleaning out its corruption and black projects.

events.title: Feast Aboard the Kingsblade
events.summary: Aboard the brand new Kingsblade, the party reunites with their prison friends for a feast where Lirael ends up a chicken being chased by gnomes.
events.detail: The Kingsblade is a new Galifar class airship on its maiden voyage. Inside, Gelf, Elric, Paxon, Leff, Tauren, Sheldor, Sorenson, Keys, Erald, Chester and Faird are already eating and drinking, and gnomes serve meals made for each guest's race. Sorenson plays a song about the prison fight. Lirael turns into a chicken and is chased around by the gnomes, Brand lockpicks Chester, and Sazed keeps to himself, writing in his new journal. Everybody gets drunk. As things wind down, Blazehelm hands out their reward and sobers them all up with lay on hands.

events.title: Touring the Kingsblade
events.summary: Blazehelm walks them deck by deck through the ship, from the dwarven engine room to the bridge, and they meet the halfling pilot Screech.
events.detail: In the hull, dwarves work the machinery that keeps the ship running, and Brand loves it. On the lower deck halflings tend their Shuriken fighters; here they meet Screech, a halfling from the northern village of Canuck. The armory on the same deck gives them new weapons and armor, Brand augments his suit, and everyone gets sharp black Sentinel outfits. On the main deck orcs move machinery to ready the Kingsblade for launch, and Screech takes off in his Shuriken to hunt for the Aundairians. On the bridge they meet Captain Feldor Windrake and his crew, and Sazed recognises that one of the bridge officers is a shifter.

events.title: Mission: Broadsword and Broadaxe
events.summary: Screech spots two Aundairian warships in a nearby valley, and Blazehelm hands the new wreckers their first mission: take them out or take them.
events.detail: Screech returns to report an Aundairian Broadsword and Broadaxe over the mountain, sitting in a valley with a staging area. In the war room Blazehelm names the man tracking them: Captain Killian Gavrin, who believes Blazehelm to be his archrival. Since the party are "wrecker" Sentinels, destroying or capturing both ships is their job. Screech will go with them as the best pilot, able to commandeer an Aundairian ship. Blazehelm gives them two smokepowder satchels, each dealing 15d20 force damage in a 10 foot blast, enough to destroy an elemental holding cell. The Broadsword is the lighter, faster ship built for docking onto others, while the Broadaxe is heavily armored, slower and bristling with cannons.

events.title: Sazed's Confession and Nedira
events.summary: Back in their quarters Sazed admits he was an Aundairian spy, then slips away to speak with Nedira, the shifter on the bridge.
events.detail: The party winds down in their quarters, everyone very drunk, and talks over their pasts. Sazed reveals that he was an Aundairian spy who got caught, and that is how he ended up in jail. Later he sneaks off to find Nedira, the shifter he spotted among the bridge crew. Nedira speaks up for the Sentinels, telling him they have been protecting shifter clans. Afterwards the party goes to sleep, and the nightmares begin.

events.title: Sazed's Nightmare: The Burning Hut
events.summary: Sazed dreams he is a child hiding under his bed while soldiers search his family's hut.
events.detail: In the dream he is a small child, hiding under his bed when the door is thrown open and soldiers walk in. His mother covers his mouth so he won't scream. The soldiers look around the room and then leave. For a moment he believes they are safe. Then the soldiers fireball the hut.

events.title: Lirael's Nightmare: Father Behind Glass
events.summary: Lirael dreams of finding his long-missing father in his favorite chair, trapped behind the surface of a mirror.
events.detail: Lirael enters his house and sees his father sitting in his favorite chair; he cannot remember the last time he saw him. He goes to greet him but is stopped, because his father is trapped behind a mirror. His father reaches for him, but neither can get past the mirror's surface, and the old man looks tired and worn. The room goes black. His father is dragged away by men Lirael cannot see.

events.title: Brand's Nightmare: The Cannith Forge
events.summary: Brand dreams of returning to the Broadhelm forge, only to find no one remembers him and the family name is gone from the sign.
events.detail: Brand walks into the Broadhelm forge, and the woman at the front desk asks for his ID; she does not recognise him. He tells her he is Brand Broadhelm, son of Ulnar. She tells him Ulnar died thirty years ago and the Broadhelms have not run the place in decades. His mind spinning, Brand steps outside and looks up at the sign. It reads House Cannith Forge.

events.title: Found You
events.summary: At the end of all three nightmares, a giant eye looks down on the sleepers and speaks two words: "Found you."
events.detail: Just before they wake, Sazed, Lirael and Brand each see the same thing: a giant eye looking upon them. It says, "Found you." They wake shaken and compare notes, discovering that each of them was dragged through his own past that night. Something has noticed them, and it reached all three at once. The party will soon be chasing the Dreamweaver and the Shadow Mirror, and this is the first sign that something is looking back.

events.title: Breakfast and Blazehelm's Whiskey
events.summary: Before heading for the valley, Blazehelm shares a swig of his personal whiskey, and Screech shows off a potion he lifted.
events.detail: The party talks through their nightmares with one another, then has breakfast with their NPC friends before setting out. Blazehelm gives each of them a swig of his personal whiskey, granting +1 to all saving throws for 24 hours. Screech pulls them aside to show them something extra: an invisibility potion he stole. It will matter before the day is out.

events.title: The Dying Aundairian
events.summary: Descending into the valley, the party finds a dead dire wolf and an Aundairian soldier with a strange story about a dog.
events.detail: From the ridge they see the Broadsword and the Broadaxe at the bottom of the valley in a makeshift base. On the way down they come across a dead dire wolf and a dying Aundairian soldier. With his last words he tells them a dog attacked him and his wolves. Then he dies. The party follows the trail of blood and finds the dog, still fighting off three more dire wolves.

events.title: Saving the Stray Dog
events.summary: The party kills three dire wolves to save a stray dog, which becomes their friend once it is fed and petted.
events.detail: The party wades in and kills the three dire wolves. The dog warms to them as soon as they feed and pet it, and it tags along from then on; Keys will later say it considers them its new masters. But the wolves howled as they died. Sazed spots an Aundairian squad heading their way to investigate.

events.title: The Tripwire and the Red Flare
events.summary: Sneaking through the forest, Brand disarms a crossbow trap and pockets it, while the squad that found the wolves fires a red flare.
events.detail: The party slips into the forest and finds a tripwire trap rigged with crossbows and flare arrows. Brand disarms it and takes the whole thing. Behind them, the squad that found the dead wolves fires a red arrow into the sky, meaning negative contact and dead allies. The party then runs into a second squad. Lirael distracts them long enough for everyone to get past.

events.title: The Harpy on the Cliff
events.summary: Lirael sends a harpy guard to sleep, Sazed finishes it, and a botched climb forces Lirael to teleport away.
events.detail: A harpy guards the cliff the party needs to climb. Lirael puts it to sleep, and it wakes when it hits the ground, but Sazed kills it. They try to ascend the cliff using a log, but Lirael is caught and teleports away. Brand tries to distract the archer watching the open field so he can make it up the log himself. It works on the archer, but it also draws the attention of the hobgoblin squad they had just slipped past.

events.title: EEEEE, the Dwarf in a Can
events.summary: Brand opens his dwarf in a can and hurls it at the hobgoblins, and the dwarf who pops out immediately takes the wrong side.
events.detail: When the can lands, a dwarf named EEEEE climbs out, announces that he loves to kill, and asks who he should kill. The hobgoblins tell him to kill the party and pocket the can. One hobgoblin tries to fire a green flare, meaning positive contact with the enemy, but Brand shoots it down and Lirael puts that hobgoblin to sleep. The archer fires a green flare anyway. The whole team escapes up the cliff, and when EEEEE and the hobgoblin captain try to follow, Brand sends them slipping back down with grease. A hobgoblin runs off to fetch harpies while EEEEE and the captain start climbing again.

events.title: EEEEE Falls, the Archer Dies
events.summary: At the top of the cliff the party kills EEEEE and outruns the hobgoblin captain, and Sazed silences the archer.
events.detail: The party engages EEEEE as he crests the cliff and kills him, then runs before the hobgoblin captain can close in. Sazed sneaks up on the archer who is peering over the cliff and kills him. Moving on, Sazed barely avoids a bear trap hidden in the brush. He warns Brand to watch out for traps.

events.title: Brand in the Owlbear Pit
events.summary: Moments after being warned about traps, Brand triggers one and drops into a cave with an owlbear.
events.detail: Despite Sazed's warning, Brand sets off a trap and falls down a hole into a cave below. He is not alone: an owlbear lives down there. Sazed ties a rope to a tree and drops it down the hole. Brand pulls himself back out before things get worse.

events.title: Crossing the Raging River
events.summary: The party crosses a fast river above a waterfall, and when Screech is swept toward the edge, Lirael casts feather fall on everyone.
events.detail: Sazed uses his monk's sure footing to cross the raging river with the rope. Brand walks across under the water while holding the rope. Lirael jumps in farther upstream, lets the current carry him away from the hobgoblin captain, then misty steps out of the water. Screech is scared of water, so Brand holds the rope taut while Screech crosses hand over hand. Then the dog panics, Screech loses his grip and falls into the river, heading for the edge of the falls. Lirael casts feather fall on the party.

events.title: Sazed Rides the Rotor
events.summary: Invisible on Screech's stolen potion, Sazed sprints for the Broadaxe, leaps onto its spinning rotor and plants the smokepowder fuse.
events.detail: Harpies begin scanning the cliffs, and the hobgoblin captain tells them where the party is. Sazed drinks Screech's stolen invisibility potion and makes a mad dash for the Broadaxe. He jumps onto the ship's rotor, masterfully avoiding the blades. There he begins planting the fuse for the smokepowder charge on the heavily armored warship.

events.title: Leap onto the Broadsword
events.summary: While Sazed rides the Broadaxe's rotor, Brand and Screech leap from the waterfall onto the deck of the Broadsword. Lirael falls short.
events.detail: A harpy tries its luring song on the party, but it doesn't work. Brand makes a mad jump for the Broadsword, fires his suit's boosters and makes it. Screech's nimble halfling footwork gets him enough air off the waterfall to land on the ship as well. Lirael is not so lucky: he tries to swing on the immovable rod, fumbles it and lands in the Aundairian camp below. The Broadsword's crew immediately turns on the boarders.

events.title: The Broadaxe Explodes
events.summary: Sazed shortens the fuse and jumps ship; the Broadaxe's elemental cell blows, the warship crashes, and a furious smoke elemental pours out.
events.detail: Sazed shortens the Broadaxe's fuse and jumps over to the Broadsword. Brand is wounded by the archer but thunderwaves two soldiers off the ship, and two harpies join the fight. The Broadsword begins to ascend with the Broadaxe following. Then the Broadaxe's elemental holding cell explodes. The ship falls to the ground, and a very angry smoke elemental comes out of the wreck attacking everyone in reach.

events.title: A Chicken in the Landing Gear
events.summary: Stranded in the Aundairian camp, Lirael turns into a chicken and flies up into the Broadsword through its landing gear.
events.detail: Lirael tells Sazed telepathically not to worry about him: he has a way onto the ship. In the chaos of the Broadaxe's destruction and the smoke elemental's attack, he uses the Ring of Chicken to become a chicken. He flies up and boards the Broadsword by way of the landing gear. Below deck the soldiers are worried and confused, and a chicken goes unnoticed as it slips up to the main deck. There Lirael stops being a chicken, contacts Blazehelm, and joins the fight.

events.title: For Aundair, Overboard
events.summary: Sazed rips the pilot from the controls, Screech takes the helm, and Brand gives the loyal Aundairian a message to carry on his way down.
events.detail: As the Broadsword climbs, Brand thunderwaves the last soldier and both harpies off the deck. Sazed comes out of invisibility, attacks the pilot and drags him from the controls; the ship dips for a second before Screech takes the helm. Brand offers the pilot a chance to join them, but the man swears loyalty to Aundair. Brand tells him he shall die for Aundair, and to tell people of him. Then he shoves him off the ship, and the pilot falls to his death. Screech tells them to contact Blazehelm and have the Kingsblade take off.

events.title: The Hobgoblin Warlord
events.summary: Soldiers boil up from below deck, and a hobgoblin warlord sends his men after the pilot while he takes on the party himself.
events.detail: Sazed and Brand head to the main deck to meet the soldiers coming up from below. The hobgoblin warlord orders his men upstairs to take out the pilot, saying he can handle the party himself. The first hobgoblin sent up is thrown clean off the deck when Screech banks the ship. But Screech is quickly overrun and Brand rushes to help. By the end Brand lies unconscious beside Screech at the helm, while Lirael and Sazed fight the warlord below deck.

events.title: The Kunai to the Rescue
events.summary: As soldiers swamp the stolen ship, the Kunai dropship bursts from the mountain mist and drops the party's prison friends onto the deck.
events.detail: Screech flies the Broadsword as fast and as close to the mountain as he can to reach the Kingsblade. He manages to heal Brand, but more soldiers pour up from below and overwhelm the party. Through the mist comes the Kunai dropship, piloted by Foehammer, dropping off Tauren, Leff, Sorenson, Keys and Cromwell. With the added help, the Aundairian soldiers are overwhelmed and killed. Leff tells them they are now even for the prison. Sorenson pays Keys on a bet, since he thought stealing the ship would take them longer.

events.title: Searching the Broadsword
events.summary: Docked to the Kingsblade, the party searches their prize and terrifies a sleeping hobgoblin they find aboard.
events.detail: The Kingsblade fires docking cables, and Gelf, Elric and a halfling pilot come over to relieve them. Searching the Broadsword, they find a map tracking the Kingsblade: the Aundairians had started with three ships, and one was shot down. They also find a potion of animal friendship and the Book of Fire. A hobgoblin is found asleep, and the party terrifies and interrogates him, but he knows nothing they don't. They restrain him with velociraptor shackles and leave him to Gelf and Elric.

events.title: A Second Prison Erupts
events.summary: Below the mountains another prison explodes and zombies pour out, with no sign of guards, prisoners or necromancer.
events.detail: Back aboard the Kingsblade, Blazehelm congratulates the party. Then they watch another prison under the mountain explode, with zombies pouring out of it. There is no sign of guards, prisoners or a necromancer. Another Galifar class ship, the Pillar of Dawn, flies in, and the two ships open fire on the zombies. The Kingsblade then runs at full speed for the first time and leaves the Yedani Mountains behind.

events.title: Orders: Three Weeks of Training
events.summary: The party wants to search Lirael's father's office for the Shadow Mirror and Dreamweaver, but Blazehelm insists on three weeks of training first.
events.detail: The plan is to go to Lirael's hometown and search his father's office for clues about the Shadow Mirror and the Dreamweaver. Before that, Blazehelm says, they need three weeks of training. Brand is not happy about it. Meanwhile Gelf and Elric will infiltrate House D'Thuranni to try to find Deckard D'Thuranni. The Kingsblade will reach the Sentinel base in five hours, and there will be a party tonight.

events.title: Cromwell's Coin Game
events.summary: Cromwell, very much alive, runs a betting game at lunch, and Lirael wins half his prize with illusory coins.
events.detail: In the crew quarters Sheldor and Erald are shocked to see Cromwell alive and ask how he escaped the prison. Chester tries to get Cromwell to lockpick him, but Cromwell is not having it. The party asks the gnomes for food and sits down for lunch. Cromwell plays a betting game with a coin of his against Lirael, Brand and Screech. Screech and Lirael win $40 each, though $20 of Lirael's winnings is an illusion he conjured. The party then rests for four hours.

events.title: The Approach to Wroat
events.summary: From the top deck the party watches the Brelish capital come into view: the wall, the Guns of Wroat, Brokenblade Castle and the Citadel.
events.detail: The party goes up to the top deck for the approach, though Sazed is still uncomfortable on the ship. They see Wroat, its great wall and the Guns of Wroat. They also see Brokenblade Castle, where the King resides, and the Citadel, where the High Marshals direct the war effort. On the way in they pass Feldor's old ship, The Unstoppable. The Kingsblade lands in the small forest of Boranex outside the city.

events.title: The Moonwatch and Hobbstweedle
events.summary: The stolen ship gets a new name, the Moonwatch, and the party is shown their new house in the Sentinel village of Hobbstweedle.
events.detail: After landing, the party renames the Broadsword from the Windshire to the Moonwatch. They enter the village of Hobbstweedle, a quaint and inviting place full of military folk. Blazehelm shows them their house. Inside is 75gp, along with clothes that fit each of their races and styles. They pregame hard before heading to the party.

events.title: Feast at Blazehelm's Mansion
events.summary: At Blazehelm's opulent mansion the Major gives a rousing speech, and over five courses the party toasts the dead and tells how they stole a ship.
events.detail: The top floor of the mansion belongs to the older senior Sentinels, with bodyguards on the stairs; everything else is open. In the main hall Blazehelm gives a speech so rousing it grants everyone 26 temporary hit points. A five course feast with drinks follows. The party pours one out for their dead friends, tells how Bloodworth went out screaming, and explains how they stole the Broadsword. Then they ask Blazehelm how he knows so much about their pasts, and he tells them.

events.title: How Blazehelm Knew: Gelard Greenly
events.summary: Blazehelm learned of Lirael's possession from a young wizard, Gelard Greenly, who has since disappeared.
events.detail: Gelard Greenly was a young wizard in the magic society at the time. Using detect magic and detect thoughts, he noticed Lirael was possessed, but he couldn't stop him and was barred from testifying at the trial. He came to Blazehelm, having figured out on his own what the Sentinels were, and Blazehelm believed him. Lirael's father had also come to Blazehelm during his search for the Shadow Mirror, and disappeared soon after. Something didn't sit right about his son killing the head of the magic society, so Blazehelm set about getting Lirael out of prison and recruiting him. Gelard has since completely disappeared as well.

events.title: How Blazehelm Knew: The King's Apology
events.summary: Paxon dug Brand's treason conviction out of the files, the case fell apart, and the King himself sends his apologies.
events.detail: Blazehelm had told Paxon to look for recruits in places they would usually write off, since everyone recommended was a buttoned-up, rule-following military type. Paxon went through people convicted of treason, normally an instant disqualifier, and Brand's case jumped out. Nothing in his more than 100 years serving the crown suggested he could aid a Thranish assassination attempt on the King, and as Paxon dug, the case fell apart. Blazehelm consulted the King, who knew Brand as a boy and always suspected something was wrong. Brand was convicted under the King's father, and early in his reign the King was surrounded by too many of his father's men to pardon him; by the time they had moved on, his attention was elsewhere. The King sends his apologies.

events.title: How Blazehelm Knew: Eldritch Groves
events.summary: Sazed's name came from the shifters themselves, and Blazehelm tells him the Battle of Eldritch Groves was never his fault.
events.detail: With a new inquisition looming, Blazehelm wanted more shifter Sentinels watching the villages they had promised to protect, and asked for good candidates. Sazed's name came up as a man held in high esteem among the loreguards. Looking into his case, they saw the village he warned was within Brelish borders: an Aundairian spy who betrayed his masters to save Brelish people. As for the warning he failed to send, the Battle of Eldritch Groves was lost before it began, ill advised, short on supplies, with exhausted battalions and low morale; Blazehelm had advised the High Marshal against it and was ignored. Sazed's failure is not why they lost. "A man willing to do whatever it takes to save the people is someone we need."

events.title: The Beholder in the Entrance Hall
events.summary: As the party gets going, prankster gnomes conjure a beholder in the entrance hall, and Sazed kicks straight through it.
events.detail: After pregaming and drinking through supper, the party is fairly sloshed when the party begins in earnest. Cromwell disappears into the crowd. In the entrance hall the gnomes create an illusion of a beholder, and guests start freaking out. Sazed sees through it. He kicks through the illusion and dispels it.

events.title: Foehammer, Eloria and Clockwork
events.summary: In the mansion's guarded quiet room, Gelf and Elric introduce the party to three veteran Sentinels.
events.detail: A bouncer is keeping people out of the quiet room, but he lets the party in. Inside, Gelf and Elric introduce their friends. Foehammer is the dropship pilot who saved them, and she used to fly dragons. Eloria is the Sentinels' resident cleric and one of the very first Sentinels. Clockwork is a warforged built to be a Sentinel, the resident artificer who makes warforged, weapons and arms and upgrades the ships. The three are impressed with the party's entrance, destroying a prison and stealing a ship, and they tease Gelf and Elric about theirs: accidentally parachuting into a Sentinel base.

events.title: The Music Room
events.summary: Lirael hears tales of Xen'drik from Sheldor and gets a gift from a duergar, while bullywug and kobold bands play.
events.detail: Sazed and Lirael head to the music room while Brand keeps talking with Clockwork and Elric, and Gelf wanders off. Lirael talks with Sheldor and the deep gnomes and duergar. Sheldor tells him about Xen'drik, and a duergar gives him a hood and mask for sunny days. A bullywug band, Smarmy Joe and the Wully Bugs, plays 50s music. A kobold band, Shimmy Fistor and the Squabble Crowd, plays 70s soul.

events.title: Pies, Grease and an Argument
events.summary: The gnomes' pranks catch up with the party: Lirael takes a pie to the face, and Brand ends up arguing with Paxon.
events.detail: Brand rejoins the party and they head for the war room. Outside it, Lirael is pied in the face by a gnome tripwire trap. They disturb Paxon at work, and he and Brand get into an argument. After a bathroom break, Brand and Lirael slip on grease the gnomes have spread on the floor. When some ladies slip on it too, Lirael casts feather fall on them so they don't hit the ground.

events.title: The Quasit in the Cowboy Hat
events.summary: In a janitor's closet the party finds a quasit in a cowboy hat eating spaghetti; Brand blasts it, and its hat holds two magic items.
events.detail: The quasit offers them his hat if they will leave him alone. Brand blasts him to pieces instead. The hat turns out to be a Hat of Slight Disguise, and inside it is a Ring of Random Language. Lirael tries the ring on. For the next ten minutes he can only speak and understand gnomish. It is the first quasit of many: the demons are turning up all over Hobbstweedle.

events.title: Sorenson's Song for Shmem
events.summary: Sorenson, frustrated that his song sounds wrong, talks about his friend Shmem, and Captain Windrake offers to play bass.
events.detail: The party finds Sorenson outside at the fountain, playing his song and frustrated that it doesn't sound right. He tells them about Shmem, who taught him the tuba and became his friend. Feldor Windrake overhears and says he can play bass, and that Sorenson should jam with the band. Sorenson takes him up on it. He plays his song at the concert.

events.title: Brand's New Best Friend
events.summary: Brand bonds with the bullywug bandleader Smarmy Joe, while Lirael's gnomish ears save him from one prank but not the next.
events.detail: Sorenson finishes his song, and the next band up is Adric Hinter and the Uberband. Brand makes friends with Smarmy Joe, who tells him how he never fit in among the bullywugs. By the end of the night Smarmy Joe is Brand's new best friend. Lirael, still hearing gnomish, overhears a gnome prank in time to dodge it. He tries to catch the pranksters, but they blast a fog horn in his ear and get away.
