events.title: Nedira and the Village of Prowlstone
events.summary: Nedira tells Sazed that his warning saved Prowlstone, and a whole generation of shifter children exists because of him.
events.detail: Eloria tells Sazed that Nedira is either in his chair nook or in the courtyard with the bridge crew. Sazed finds him playing cards with the crew and is too awkward to go over. Nedira sees him and comes to talk after the hand. There are no shifter villages nearby, Nedira says, but when Sazed returns they should go see the village he saved. Nedira was at Prowlstone when Sazed's warning came in, and it saved the village; a generation of kids now exists because of him. The two share a vision of starting a shifter village in the Boranex forest, and they share poetry.

events.title: The Gnome Kitchen
events.summary: Brand and Lirael walk into the kitchen to find the gnomes high and throwing daggers at a quasit strapped to a spinning wheel.
events.detail: When Brand and Lirael open the kitchen door, a spring-loaded prank hand flies out at them, and Lirael dodges it. Inside, the gnomes are snorting Khyber powder and throwing daggers at a quasit tied to a spinning wheel. Brand asks where the quasits are coming from. The gnomes say they found quasits in the storage room earlier.

events.title: Dwarven Roulette with Spingus
events.summary: Lirael plays dwarven roulette against head chef Spingus Dillguard and draws the one beer that isn't beer.
events.detail: The head chef is a gnome named Spingus Dillguard. Lirael takes him on at dwarven roulette: six beers, one of which is goblin urine. Lirael loses. He drinks the bad one.

events.title: Quasits in the Storage Room
events.summary: The party clears the quasits out of the storage room so easily it's a letdown, and turns up the janitor's key.
events.detail: On the way to the storage room Sazed runs into the others. They kill the quasits effortlessly, which is kind of disappointing. They find the janitor's key. Back in the kitchen they tell the gnomes the quasits are dealt with. On seeing the quasit on the wheel Sazed kills it at once, and the gnomes run in and stab it several more times.

events.title: Spingus's Price for the Dumbwaiter
events.summary: Spingus offers to sneak the party upstairs through the dumbwaiter, for the price of a potion of uncontrollable flatulence.
events.detail: The party asks Spingus for the best way into the forbidden upstairs and what he knows about it. He tells them there are three generals up there: one who is chill, one who isn't, and one they can win over. If they bring him a potion of uncontrollable flatulence, he will get them upstairs through the dumbwaiter. Lirael hatches a cover story: he will use mage hand to work the dead quasit like a puppet and pretend to be chasing it.

events.title: Chasing a Dead Quasit Upstairs
events.summary: Lirael rides the dumbwaiter up chasing his puppeted quasit and leads a mob of gnomes away, while Brand breaks the dumbwaiter.
events.detail: Lirael goes up the dumbwaiter first, chasing the quasit. He comes out in the upstairs dining room, where the rest of the kitchen gnomes are eating. The gnomes buy the illusion and start chasing the quasit too, and Sazed comes out next and follows them. The dumbwaiter breaks under the weight of Brand's armor, but he thorn whips onto the chandelier and pulls himself into the room. Lirael hides the quasit behind a door and leads the gnome mob around the corner.

events.title: Raiding the Potion Room
events.summary: Under cover of the gnome stampede, the party slips into the senior Sentinels' potion room.
events.detail: Using the distraction, the party heads to the potion room. They find a potion of invisibility. Brand writes down seven potion recipes while Sazed watches the door. Eventually Brand comes to his senses and decides it's time to leave.

events.title: The Keyhole in Paxon's Painting
events.summary: Trashing Paxon's room with the puppet quasit uncovers a hidden keyhole in his painting and an unmarked teleporter room beyond it.
events.detail: Lirael finds Paxon's room and wants to use the quasit to trash it. Brand agrees, and the 'quasit' destroys the room. The mess reveals a hidden keyhole in Paxon's painting. Picking the lock opens the way to an unmarked teleporter room. At that moment Sazed sees Paxon coming down the hall, and the party jumps out the window as Lirael casts feather fall.

events.title: Something in Paxon's Tea
events.summary: The party pays the gnomes their potion of flatulence and helps slip it into Paxon's tea, with Spingus giving a lockpicking lesson.
events.detail: Landing among the guests below, the party claims they were just fighting the quasit and holds up its dead body; everyone believes them. They return to the gnomes, hand over the potion of flatulence, and ask where the teleporter goes, but the gnomes don't know. Then they follow the gnomes to the war room to put the potion in Paxon's tea. Lirael and Brand can't pick the war room lock. Spingus shows them how it's done.

events.title: Valhalla Eriksson and the Ball Bearings
events.summary: At the Valhalla Eriksson concert, Brand is too shy to talk to a dwarf, and Spingus turns the dance floor into a skating rink.
events.detail: The party returns to the concert to watch Valhalla Eriksson. Brand notices a beautiful dwarf woman but is too awkward to talk to her. Sazed tries to just chill. Spingus has other plans: he hands Sazed 200 ball bearings and throws the remaining 800 under the feet of the dancers.

events.title: Tauren Finds Faith
events.summary: Lirael finds Tauren in the shrine to Dol Dorn, searching for a god after a hard life, and tells him about the Blood of Vol.
events.detail: Lirael finds Tauren in the worship room for Dol Dorn. After a life on the street, then the military, then jail, Tauren is starting to find god. Lirael tells him about the Blood of Vol, and Tauren is interested. The two head to the hot tub, where Keys is talking to Scruffy, the dog. Keys says the dog likes them and considers them his new masters.

events.title: The Dragonborn Sauna
events.summary: In a punishingly hot sauna full of dragonborn, Lirael meets the old warrior Dyll Strickland and complains about the heat. The dragonborn turn it up.
events.detail: Tauren and Lirael try the sauna, which is punishingly hot and full of dragonborn plus one human, Dyll Strickland. Tauren can't take the heat and leaves. Lirael talks with Dyll, a warrior who, despite his age, doesn't want to be a general; he wants to stay connected to the soldiers and the battlefield. Lirael mocks how hot it is, and the dragonborn turn it up. It's too hot for Lirael, so he leaves. He will meet Dyll again in a few hours under far less friendly terms.

events.title: Cards with the Halfling Pilots
events.summary: Screech cheats his way past a rival pilot who mocks his dream of captaincy, and Lirael then beats them both.
events.detail: Lirael runs into Screech, Beazle and the other halfling pilots gambling. Beazle is mocking Screech for wanting to captain a ship. Screech cheats and wins. Then Lirael sits down against Screech and Beazle, and he wins.

events.title: Blazehelm and the Sentinels Close Out
events.summary: The final act of the night is the Major's own band, Blazehelm and the Sentinels, and Smarmy Joe sends Brand home with a record.
events.detail: Lirael returns to the concert for the final band: Blazehelm and the Sentinels. Smarmy Joe gives Brand a copy of his record, the two firmly drunk buddies by now. The party heads home after a great night. They will not get much sleep.

events.title: Waking to a Flooded Room
events.summary: The party wakes to find their bedroom filling with water and the door locked, and has to plug a spout with the Bag of Devouring to survive.
events.detail: Sazed spots where the water is coming from and shows Brand. Lirael repeatedly firebolts the door while Leff and Tauren punch at it. Brand manages to secure the Bag of Devouring over the water spout. Sazed notices water leaking through a secret door; Keys turns into a bear, and together with Leff, Tauren and Lirael's firebolts they break off the top half of it. Lirael reaches through and unlocks the door, and the water rushes out, sweeping Brand and Lirael along. Brand now has a fear of water.

events.title: Metal Plates and Three Keyholes
events.summary: A metal plate slams shut behind Sazed, cutting the party off from their friends, and the front door is sealed with three keyholes.
events.detail: As Sazed leaves the room, a metal plate slams shut over the door. On the other side they can hear their friends fighting. The front door is blocked by a metal plate with three keyholes. Light is coming from under every door in the house, even though they left the lights off last night.

events.title: Warforged Ambush: It's a Test
events.summary: Constructs attack in the dining room, and a rune torn from one's heart tells Brand who built them: Clockwork. The whole house is a test.
events.detail: Two Warforged Enforcers and a Clockwork Defender wait in the dining room, and once battle starts an invisible Warforged Spellcaster reveals itself. Brand breaks through a hidden door to find their friends fighting the same enemies in the bedroom and holding their own. The three of them handily take care of the robots. Sazed rips a rune out of the heart of one machine and shows it to Brand. Brand recognises Clockwork's handiwork. This is a test.

events.title: The Polar Bear in the Ceiling
events.summary: Lirael springs an obvious bear trap with a fire poker, and a polar bear drops out of the ceiling on top of him.
events.detail: The party goes to Brand's workshop to collect some tools and spots an obvious bear trap. Lirael sets it off with a fire poker. A polar bear drops from the ceiling and starts mauling him. The bear roars, and they hear the thumping feet of another bear getting closer. It is Keys, still in bear form, coming to help, and together they kill the polar bear.

events.title: The Mirrored Door and the Red Key
events.summary: Lirael gets past a mirrored door by politely asking his reflection to step aside, and wins the first key.
events.detail: Inspecting the constructs, the party finds each holds a stabilizing syringe, and Brand collects them all. Brand sees the Bag of Devouring starting to loosen from the spout, rushes to his room for bolts and a bolt gun, and bolts it down. Meanwhile Lirael and Sazed puzzle over the mirrored door blocking the way into the kitchen. Lirael figures it out: he asks his reflection to move out of the way. He gets a red key, fits it into the red keyhole on the front door, and it turns.

events.title: The Stables Timer and the Kruthik
events.summary: An arrow meant for a glass case hits the red button behind it, and the party has to smash through a fireplace to stop a countdown.
events.detail: Lirael and Sazed peer into the stables and see a countdown timer, a button and a key in a glass box. They shoot arrows at the box until it breaks, but the arrow that breaks it flies through and hits the red button. A plate slams shut over the door. Brand decides to break through the kitchen fireplace into the stables, while Lirael uses mage hand to grab the key; with Sazed's help, Brand gets through. Inside, the timer is counting down beside a young kruthik. Brand disables the timer, Sazed kills the kruthik, and Lirael places the second key in the front door.

events.title: Blue Plus Yellow: The Invisible Key
events.summary: Four colored potions and a dwarvish rune for green lead Brand to mix his own potion of see invisibility and find the last key.
events.detail: In another room they find four potions, red, yellow, blue and purple, and a dwarvish rune that says green. Brand mixes the blue and yellow potions and drinks the result. It is a potion of see invisibility, and he can now see the invisible key. Everyone else drinks some of the potion too.

events.title: Inverted Gravity and a Shrinking Door
events.summary: Before leaving, the party checks the rest of the house: an upside-down library, a door that shrinks and teleports you, and a room that makes you huge.
events.detail: They decide to check the remaining rooms before leaving. Sazed's library now has inverted gravity, and they kind of like it. One door carries a spell that will teleport and shrink whoever passes, which Lirael and Brand both sense. Lirael conjures a mouse and sends it through; it is shrunk and teleported inside a chest in the room, and they retrieve it. The final room makes you really big. Brand loves it, but the effect only works inside the room.

events.title: Drill Instructor Dyll Strickland
events.summary: The party unlocks the front door to find the old warrior from the sauna waiting as their drill instructor, ready with insults.
events.detail: With the final key in the door, they step out to find Drill Instructor Dyll Strickland, Eloria with medical supplies, Clockwork with tools, and gnomes ready to clean up. Dyll gives them a full drill sergeant dressing down. He hands out crude, demeaning nicknames that nobody wants. Brand keeps his emotions in check and takes it as part of the test. Dyll is getting under Sazed's skin.

events.title: The Five Mile Run
events.summary: Dyll marches them on a five mile run, and Sazed leaves everyone behind, arriving at the obstacle course to find Gelf waiting.
events.detail: Sazed runs ahead and reaches the obstacle course first, where Gelf is waiting. Sazed asks about Dyll. Gelf says he's a tough drill sergeant but a good teacher, and he's chiller when he isn't drilling, though still not chill. The rest of the party arrives. Dyll is impressed by Sazed's speed and asks how he got so fast, among other questions. He is unimpressed with Sazed's answers.

events.title: The Obstacle Course
events.summary: Sazed tears through Dyll's obstacle course, while Brand's thorn whip gives out and drops him in the water.
events.detail: Everyone makes it over the climbing wall and the jump wall. Sazed speeds ahead, swimming the rough water with ease, quickly dispatching each dummy and jumping across the pit. Brand jumps off the jump wall and tries to thorn whip his way up the next wall, but the whip dissipates and he falls into the water. Their friends are doing fine except Keys, who is struggling on the climbing wall. Brand goes back to help him.

events.title: Rod, Chicken, Mage Hand
events.summary: Lirael beats the wall with the immovable rod and a chicken transformation, snagging his key with mage hand on the way.
events.detail: Lirael balances on the jump wall, holds the immovable rod above his head and locks it in place. He pulls himself up onto the rod, then turns into a chicken and flies to the top of the wall. He uses his mage hand to grab his key. Then he jumps off the wall and begins floating down to the ground.

events.title: Lirael Takes the First Flag
events.summary: Still a chicken, Lirael squeezes through the bars, climbs the tower for his flag and is first to breakfast. Dyll is impressed.
events.detail: Lirael descends from the wall as a chicken and takes his key back from his mage hand. He squeezes through the bars of the wall and climbs the tower to retrieve his flag. He feather falls down and starts on his breakfast, the prize waiting at the end of the course. Dyll is impressed.

events.title: Keys Becomes a Shark
events.summary: On Brand's advice, Keys turns into a shark and blows through the water section.
events.detail: Brand suggests that Keys turn into an animal. Keys becomes a shark and shoots ahead through the water. Brand and the rest of the NPCs trudge through the water after him. They attack the dummies as they go.

events.title: Sazed Throws Everyone's Keys
events.summary: Sazed dodges a rolling spike log, grabs every key off the spinning blade dummy, and throws his friends theirs over the wall.
events.detail: Sazed dodges the rolling spike log and grabs everyone's keys from the top of the spinning blade dummy. He throws Sheldor's, Keys' and Sorenson's keys over the wall, and they catch them. Then he wall runs and jumps over the line of locked doors. He climbs between two close walls to get on top of them, runs to the tower and gets his flag. He takes the fall damage on the way down and goes to his breakfast.

events.title: Brand and the Squad Finish
events.summary: Brand leads the rest of the squad through the ropes and locked doors, and they jump from the tower into the bushes together.
events.detail: Brand and the NPCs monkey climb the ropes, except Sorenson, who goes around the pit. Sorenson tries to grab everyone's keys but is knocked over by the log. Brand thorn whips his own key, and Sorenson crouches and grabs Leff's and Tauren's. Brand unlocks both doors, and he and the NPCs rush up the tower to their flags. Tauren and Leff jump for the bushes, then Brand, Keys and Sorenson follow. Dyll insults them approvingly and keeps training them for the rest of the day.

events.title: Brand Argues with a Cleaning Gnome
events.summary: Home after training, Brand objects to how the gnomes are cleaning up his things and insists on finishing the job himself.
events.detail: When the party gets home, the gnomes are finishing cleaning and repairing the house after the morning's test. Brand argues with a gnome about how it is cleaning his room. He doesn't like that his things have been moved, even temporarily. He insists on doing the rest of the cleaning himself.

events.title: Quasit Thieves in the House
events.summary: Sazed catches quasits stealing from the house, kills four and captures one, which talks about a village before it annoys Brand into killing it.
events.detail: Sazed goes to make food and finds quasits stealing the party's things. He kills four of them; two get away, and he captures one. Interrogated, the quasit tells them about a village. But it pisses Brand off. Brand kills it.

events.title: Sheldor Tells Sazed of Xen'drik
events.summary: Over supper Sheldor asks Sazed about shifter culture and tells him about Xen'drik, a place Sazed thinks he might like.
events.detail: At supper Sheldor asks Sazed about shifter culture. In return he tells Sazed about Xen'drik. Sazed thinks he might like it there.

events.title: How Leff Earned Skullcrusher
events.summary: Leff tells Brand that in his culture a last name must be earned in combat and given by a friend, and Brand gave him his.
events.detail: Leff explains that he comes from a warrior culture where you must earn your last name in combat, and it is given to you by a friend. Brand gave Leff his name back in the prison. When Leff crushed a guard's skull, Brand named him Skullcrusher.

events.title: No Potions Without an Herbalist Kit
events.summary: After training on Zarantyr 10, Brand and Lirael try their hand at potion making and realise they need an Herbalist kit.
events.detail: With Brand's stolen recipes in hand, Brand and Lirael sit down to make potions after the day's training. They realise they need an Herbalist kit to do it. A potion store in Wroat could sell them one. The table agrees to play out that trip into Wroat later, after the demon fight.

events.title: Tauren's Secret
events.summary: Tauren quietly admits to Sazed that he can't read and asks him to teach him, and to keep it secret.
events.detail: On the evening of Zarantyr 10, Tauren comes to Sazed with a confession. He can't read. He asks Sazed to teach him. And he asks him to keep it a secret.

events.title: Sazed Finds the Quasit Village
events.summary: Following up on the captured quasit's story, Sazed goes looking and finds the demons' village, with imps and cambions among them.
events.detail: After training on Zarantyr 11, Sazed goes searching for the village the quasit spoke of. He finds it. Quasits are not the only things living there: there are imps and cambions too. He tells Lirael and Brand, and the three decide to get supplies from Blazehelm to deal with the quasit problem.

events.title: Gelf's Requisitions and Cigars
events.summary: With Blazehelm unavailable, Gelf gets them invisibility potions and cigars, and explains he is about to go undercover in House Thuranni.
events.detail: Blazehelm can't see them, but Gelf helps out. He gets requisitions for the invisibility potions they want and gives them cigars. He is busy because he is going undercover in House Thuranni soon. When the Pillar of Dawn dealt with the Yedani prisons, it captured two members of House Thuranni. Gelf and Elric will polymorph into them and impersonate them to try to find Deckard D'Thuranni.

events.title: Scouting the Demon Village Unseen
events.summary: The party goes to the quasit village, drinks their invisibility potions and surveys the demons before making a plan.
events.detail: Supplied by Gelf, Sazed, Lirael and Brand head out to the quasit village. They turn invisible before getting close. Unseen, they survey the village and its imps, quasits and cambions. Then they make their plan of attack.

events.title: Creeping Into the Demon Village Unseen
events.summary: Invisible and blessed, the party slips into the demon village in the Boranex forest and starts removing demons one at a time.
events.detail: The quasits that had been robbing the house led back to a village of imps and cambions hidden in the Boranex forest. The party approaches under invisibility and Brand casts bless on everyone before the first move. Sazed takes out an imp quietly. Working together, the three of them drop a second imp and a cambion without alerting the rest of the village. For a few minutes the plan works exactly as intended.

events.title: Brand Walks Up to a Quasit
events.summary: With the stealth plan going perfectly, Brand decides to stroll straight up to a quasit and announce himself to the entire village.
events.detail: Brand abandons the careful approach and walks right up to a quasit in plain view. The whole village wakes up at once. Over a dozen imps and quasits swarm him from every direction. None of them can get past his shield, and they flail at him uselessly while he stands in the middle of the mob. The rest of the party now has every demon in the village packed tightly around one dwarf.

events.title: Thunderwave Through the Demon Village
events.summary: Lirael drops a thunderwave on the demons crowding Brand's shield and kills nearly every one of them in a single blast.
events.detail: The imps and quasits had bunched up around Brand, trying and failing to get through his defences. Lirael's thunderwave tears through the crowd and kills nearly all of them at once. The party mops up the survivors one by one. Two imps turn invisible and escape into the forest. Those two will turn up again, first stealing food in Gelf's house and later firebombing the party's home in revenge.

events.title: The Last Cambion Talks
events.summary: The final cambion grabs Lirael and Sazed's minds before he is forced out, then admits the demons came through a portal that broke behind them.
events.detail: The last cambion tries to take over Brand's mind and fails. He succeeds with Lirael and Sazed, but is forced out before he can make them do anything. The party interrogates him before finishing him. He says the demons came through a portal and got stranded on this side when it broke. Since then they have been stealing from the Sentinels to feed themselves. Then they kill him.

events.title: Bells, Beans and Stolen Sentinel Gear
events.summary: Searching the village turns up stolen Sentinel equipment, bells of jingling, a scroll of mage armor and a bag holding seven magic beans.
events.detail: The demon village is full of Sentinel gear, confirming who had been robbing the base. Among the loot are bells of jingling and a scroll of mage armor. The real prize is a bag of magic beans with seven beans inside. Nobody knows yet what each bean will do. The party decides to keep the beans to themselves.

events.title: The Broken Teleportation Circle
events.summary: A path from the village ends at a ruined teleportation circle covered in markings unlike anything the party has seen.
events.detail: Following a path out of the village, the party finds a broken teleportation circle. It is covered in markings that match no circle they know. It leads to a plane they cannot identify; they guess Khyber, since demons come from there and nobody would need a portal to get here from the Demon Wastes. This was a powerful portal. Whatever destroyed it took a tremendous amount of force.

events.title: Whiskey and a Napkin Sketch
events.summary: Gelf pours Blazehelm's whiskey to toast the cleared village, then stares blankly at Lirael's napkin drawing of the circle.
events.detail: The party goes to Blazehelm's mansion hoping the Sentinels can explain the portal. Blazehelm is still unavailable, so they meet Gelf instead. Gelf is happy and impressed that they wiped out the whole village save a couple of imps. He pours everyone some of Blazehelm's whiskey, which steadies them for the days ahead. Lirael draws the broken portal on a napkin, but Gelf has never seen anything like it. Everyone realises they need Paxon's help, and none of them is happy about it.

events.title: Paxon Nerds Out About Ancient Circles
events.summary: Paxon arrives with a book on ancient teleportation and info-dumps until Brand and Sazed decide he is actually kind of cool.
events.detail: Gelf fetches Paxon, who brings a book on ancient teleportation. He does not know where the circle goes, but it matches the style of other ancient circles. Some of those have been reactivated with powerful magic, and if the far side is active the circle can be used again. The Sentinels could repair it, but reactivating it would take a powerful wizard. Gelard Greenly might know how, and where it leads; he is the one who told Blazehelm of Lirael's possession and innocence, and he has since disappeared. After watching Paxon get excited about history, Brand and Sazed think he is kind of cool. Lirael and Gelf still find him annoying.

events.title: The First Bean Is a Coffee Geyser
events.summary: Planted in the forest well away from home, the first magic bean erupts into a geyser of excellent coffee.
events.detail: Back home, the party tells nobody about the bag of beans. They plant one in the forest, far enough from the house that nothing important gets hurt. It turns into a geyser of amazing coffee. They fill their waterskins with it. Six beans remain.

events.title: Erald Reports on the Fart King
events.summary: Erald brings news from the High Marshalls: nobody had any record of the prison, and Paxon farted through the entire briefing.
events.detail: On the way home the party runs into Erald and Chester. Erald asks why they are covered in coffee and they brush it off. He had gone with Paxon and Elric to debrief the High Marshalls on the prison. Paxon farted the whole time, stank up the dropship on the ride over, and could not stop before the meeting. The High Marshalls knew nothing of the prison; there were no records of it and nobody knows how the money was siphoned. They have opened a full investigation, and Erald will now work with Paxon, the fart king, in records and investigations.

events.title: A Baby Morkoth Raids Brand's Room
events.summary: Meditating in the library, Lirael hears noises from Brand's room and finds it flooded and stripped of tools, with a baby morkoth crawling back into the bag.
events.detail: Lirael finally manages to land properly in Sazed's upside-down library and meditates there while the others sleep; Sazed warns him not to do it too often. Afterwards he hears something from Brand's locked room. He climbs into the attic, through the bear cage above the room, and opens the trap door. The room is covered in water and empty of every tool. The only thing left is the Bag of Devouring, with a baby morkoth climbing into it. Lirael casts suggestion and makes it bring the tools back before it slips into the bag again, then wakes the house.

events.title: Hauling Morkoths Out of the Bag
events.summary: With a pulley in the stables and ropes around their friends, the household drags the baby morkoths out of the bag, and a drunk Cromwell joins in.
events.detail: Brand is deeply unhappy that his shop has been raided for the third time. The party takes the bag to the stables and rigs a pulley. Sheldor, Leff and Tauren are roped up and Keys turns into a bear, and the four of them go into the bag to drag the morkoths out while the party, Sorenson and Scruffy stand ready to haul them back. Sheldor and Leff pull their morkoths through, then Keys, then Tauren. At that moment Cromwell stumbles in drunk, looking for people to party with, and joins the fight. The young morkoths are tough, but numbers and planning make short work of them.

events.title: Sheldor Insists on Going Back In
events.summary: Sheldor badly wants to climb into the bag for the rest of the loot, and Lirael's read on him says he is more reckless than usual.
events.detail: Sheldor is adamant about going back into the bag to collect the rest of the loot. The party refuses. Leff, Keys and Tauren side with them, saying they felt a dark presence inside. Sheldor says he felt nothing and that it probably does not affect drow. Lirael studies him and finds him more reckless and gung-ho than normal. They convince him to rest and deal with the loot later; Brand tidies his room, locks the bag inside, and everyone goes to sleep.

events.title: Sheldor Shoves Brand in the Bag
events.summary: Brand wakes pinned by two Sentinels under a silence spell while Sheldor forces him into the Bag of Devouring, where something starts eating his mind.
events.detail: Brand wakes to find two Sentinels holding him down while Sheldor tries to stuff him into the bag. He tries to scream, but one of the Sentinels has cast silence. He throws a glass of water and then his alarm clock, and both get caught. He breaks free for a moment and is shoved into the bag anyway. Inside, the Dreamweaver begins assaulting his mind.

events.title: The Horn of Silent Alarm
events.summary: Losing his mind inside the bag, Brand frees one hand and blows the horn. Sazed is shoved in next, shrugs off the Dreamweaver and throws Brand out.
events.detail: Sheldor and the Sentinels move on to Sazed, casting another silence. Inside the bag Brand is losing the mental fight. He gets one hand free and blows the Horn of Silent Alarm, waking Lirael, Cromwell, Sorenson, Leff, Keys and Scruffy. Lirael races down the hall as the fight starts, but the attackers still manage to shove Sazed into the bag. Sazed handily holds off the Dreamweaver, pushes Brand out and jumps after him. The two of them land on top of each other on Sazed's bed, and Brand has his mind back.

events.title: Keys Mauls the Sentinel Spellcaster
events.summary: Eight friends pile onto Sheldor and the Sentinels; Keys as a bear kills the spellcaster and Sheldor admits under suggestion that he is possessed.
events.detail: Brand puts his armour on and joins in. Lirael bursts through the door and Tauren wakes up, so all eight of them attack Sheldor and the two Sentinels. Keys turns into a bear and mauls the Sentinel spellcaster to death; he is later identified as Lug Murzog. Lirael casts suggestion on Sheldor, who says he is attacking because he is possessed. The party chooses not to kill the others and knocks Sheldor and the remaining Sentinel out with non-lethal blows. Cromwell leaves to find someone who actually wants to party.

events.title: Tell Him Gelf and Elric
events.summary: Lirael tricks the captured Sentinel into lying, and reading his mind hears a second voice feeding him the names Gelf and Elric.
events.detail: Everyone is shaken. Sorenson asks whether this will make a great song, without his usual cheer; he is really asking if everything will be okay. The party takes the Sentinel to the stables and leaves Sheldor with their friends. Lirael claims the Sentinel grabbed the wrong targets and was meant to take Sorenson, Tauren and Leff, and the Sentinel plays along, describing the party as the targets. Reading his mind, Lirael hears 'Good, they believe you.' When asked who else is involved, Lirael hears 'Tell him Gelf and Elric,' and the Sentinel says 'Gelf and Elric.' They knock him out and realise he is possessed by the Dreamweaver too.

events.title: Barging In on Gelf's Breakfast
events.summary: The party storms Gelf, Elric and Screech's breakfast with detect thoughts running, and learns all three have been having nightmares.
events.detail: Sorenson locks the house down behind them with a code phrase: 'What is most savoury? Pickles! NO! A sunset!' At Gelf's house one of Gelf's conquests is leaving with her shoes in hand, and the party barges in past Screech. Lirael's detect thoughts finds Gelf recounting his night, Screech excited to teach Lirael to fly, and Elric concentrating on details of the person he impersonates. None of them knows what the Dreamweaver is. When Lirael pushes into Elric's mind a second time, Elric asks what is going on, and the party tells them everything. All three admit they have been having nightmares too; Screech and Elric head to the party's house with the code phrase and Gelf comes to the mansion.

events.title: Code Orange at the Mansion
events.summary: Gelf declares a code orange, and Blazehelm locks down the mansion and swears everyone to secrecy, even from the High Marshalls.
events.detail: At the mansion Gelf tells the guard it is a code orange, a possible infiltration of the Sentinels. Blazehelm meets them in the downstairs war room and hears the story. He decides to keep it secret, even from the High Marshalls, until they know who is possessed. The mansion closes to business, its guards are replaced with Blazehelm's personal guard, and the party gets passes. He sends for Paxon, and for Feldor and Eloria because they know dream magic. A carriage goes with the party to bring back the two possessed Sentinels and the dead one.

events.title: Lug Murzog Comes Back Clean
events.summary: Paxon spends a diamond and six months of edited records to revive the Sentinel Keys killed, and he turns out not to be possessed.
events.detail: In the upstairs war room Blazehelm names the Sentinels as Lug Murzog and Charlie Trundle, both good soldiers. Cromwell shows up, as he tends to. The group needs a way to detect possession and a way to break it; Lirael thinks detect thoughts works well for the first. The dead man must be revived because his death was unjust and to avoid a death certificate, though normally a diamond would not be spent on an ordinary Sentinel. Paxon explains he will have to edit records for six months to hide the diamond. Lug Murzog comes back, Lirael's detect thoughts shows he is clean, and he and Brand apologise to each other. Feldor and Eloria suggest entering the victims' dreams to fight the possession from inside.

events.title: The Dreamweaver Speaks Through Two Men
events.summary: Behind an illusory two-way mirror, the interrogation collapses when the thing inside Sheldor and Charlie Trundle addresses everyone by name.
events.detail: Lirael uses minor illusion to make a two-way mirror in the war room office. Gelf and Elric play good cop and bad cop, and Gelf throws water to wake the prisoners. At the first question the Dreamweaver takes over the room, speaking through both men at once. It calls the men pawns and names each person behind the glass. When Brand says it will not get away with this, it says it already has. It tells them all to kill themselves because it will only get worse, and it keeps commenting on what they whisper behind the mirror. Nothing gets the interrogation back on track, and finally Gelf knocks both men out.

events.title: Back to Training as If Nothing Happened
events.summary: Shaken, the group locks the prisoners in the Hobbstweedle jail and agrees to act normal until Brand can test them with detect good and evil.
events.detail: The group reconvenes after the interrogation. Brand argues they should wait until tomorrow before entering the prisoners' dreams, and test ways to spot possession first; he can prepare detect good and evil by then. Everyone agrees. Sheldor and Charlie Trundle go to the Hobbstweedle jail under Blazehelm's personal guard. Blazehelm tells everyone present to keep this to themselves. The party is to return to training as if nothing had happened.

events.title: Every Book Checked Out by Lirael Sr
events.summary: The military library's Dreamweaver shelf is empty. Every book was borrowed by Lirael's father just before he vanished, and never returned.
events.detail: After training the party goes into Wroat for magic items, then to the military library to research the Dreamweaver. Every relevant book was checked out by Lirael Sr shortly before he went missing, and the late fees have piled up. Lirael flashes his badge and the librarian gives him a copy of the credentials his father left. They list Lirael Sr as a general. On paper his discharge was honourable, but he was really pushed out for his conspiracy theories, worded that way to avoid scrutiny.

events.title: Sazed Finds the Stolen Shifter Books
events.summary: In a corner of the library Sazed finds books bound in bark and nature fibre, taken from shifter clans wiped out in the inquisition.
events.detail: Sazed goes looking for shifter books and finds a section of old ones. They are bound in nature fibres and bark, with handmade paper. These books were taken from the shifter clans that were cleansed in the inquisition. Now they sit on the shelves of a Brelish military library. Sazed is enraged.

events.title: Library Cards for Everyone
events.summary: The whole party leaves with library cards, and Sazed borrows an adventure novel for Tauren.
events.detail: Before leaving, everyone signs up for a library card, to much table amusement. Sazed checks out The Adventures of Beren Serpenswallow. The book is for Tauren. It is a quiet moment after a day of possession, interrogation and the empty Dreamweaver shelf.

events.title: Possessed Brand Takes Elric
events.summary: At midnight the Dreamweaver walks Brand out of the house, screaming behind his own eyes, and he drags Elric into the bag first.
events.detail: The Dreamweaver steals four hours of sleep from Sheldor and Charlie Trundle and gives it to Brand, granting him the benefits of a long rest. Possessed, Brand slips out of the house unnoticed. Inside he is screaming, but he cannot stop himself. At Gelf, Elric and Screech's house he casts detect magic, then slips through Elric's window, grabs him and shoves him into the bag. Brand climbs in after him and grapples him away from the exit until Elric's mind gives way. Both men come out as slaves to the Dreamweaver.

events.title: Screech Goes Into the Bag
events.summary: Elric silences the bedrooms, and while invisible imps raid the kitchen, Brand and Elric stuff Screech into the bag.
events.detail: Elric casts silence on Gelf's and Screech's rooms. Before they move on Screech, Brand's detect magic picks up invisible creatures in the main room. Elric checks and finds four invisible imps stealing food, and the two decide to leave them alone. Brand holds Screech down while Elric shoves him into the bag. Brand follows him in and grapples him until Screech loses his mind to the Dreamweaver.

events.title: Gelf Wakes and Fights Back
events.summary: Fleeing imps wake Gelf beside Bellatrix Snaggletooth. He is too strong to grapple, but both end up in the bag, where he resists every intrusion on his mind.
events.detail: Two imps have moved into Gelf's room to steal his things. Gelf is asleep inside the silence spell with a dragonborn woman, Bellatrix Snaggletooth. When the possessed men come in, the imps panic and run, and the light from the open door wakes Gelf. Elric, Screech and Brand try to grapple him, but he is too strong and skilled and escapes out the window. Brand jumps after him and they shove both Gelf and Bellatrix into the bag. Gelf resists the Dreamweaver's intrusions and attacks Brand, asking him why.

events.title: Bellatrix Shot in the Back
events.summary: Gelf gets Bellatrix out of the bag, but Screech chases her down and shoots her in the back; her scream reaches Clockwork's shop.
events.detail: Inside the bag Elric attacks Bellatrix and nearly kills her. Gelf uses a manoeuvre to get her out. Screech and Elric chase her outside. Screech shoots her in the back and kills her. Before she dies her screaming alerts Clockwork in his shop nearby.

events.title: Gelf Shoved Into the Astral Sea
events.summary: Losing a brutal fight inside the bag, Brand shoves Gelf off the ledge, and Gelf floats away into the Astral Sea swearing revenge.
events.detail: Gelf and Brand fight it out inside the bag, and Gelf is slowly winning. Brand tells him he will die. Gelf answers that he is prepared to die for Breland and take them all with him. As his health runs low, Brand makes a last desperate shove and pushes Gelf off the ledge into the Astral Sea. Later, back in the bag, Brand hears Gelf screaming from out in the void that he is going to kick Brand's ass.

events.title: Is Everything Hunky Dory?
events.summary: Disguised as Gelf, Brand fools Clockwork perfectly until he gives the wrong answer to a codeword, and the warforged come through the back door.
events.detail: Brand cleans the blood with thaumaturgy and Screech hides Bellatrix's body in the bag; they plan to blame the commotion on imps. Brand casts disguise self as Gelf as Clockwork arrives with two half-repaired warforged enforcers, the ones the party fought a few days earlier. Brand copies Gelf's voice and manner perfectly, explaining that imps broke in while he was with a woman and scared her off. Clockwork wants to see her, and Brand claims she slipped out the window. Then Clockwork asks if everything is 'Hunky Dory', and Brand says things are good. The correct answer between Clockwork and Gelf was 'It's the Hunkily Doriest.' The back door explodes inward as the Clockwork Defender and the warforged spellcaster burst in, and an alarm starts blaring from Clockwork's shop.

events.title: The Book of Fire and the Run
events.summary: Clockwork cannot be dreamwoven, so Brand sets the house on fire with the book of fire and the possessed men run for the airfield.
events.detail: The possessed men fight Clockwork's constructs inside the house. The enforcers surround and batter Screech while Elric dodges the Defender and spellcaster and hacks at the half-armoured Defender. Brand shoves Clockwork into the bag, but the Dreamweaver cannot touch him; a warforged does not sleep and cannot dream. Clockwork shoves Brand aside and jumps back into the house. Brand throws the book of fire on the floor, setting the house alight, and dives out the window. Brand, Screech and Elric run through Hobbstweedle towards the airfield with Clockwork and his warforged on their heels.

events.title: Lirael Puts Brand to Sleep
events.summary: Woken by Clockwork's alarm, Lirael, Sazed and Cromwell meet their possessed friends at the village gate and bring them down.
events.detail: The alarm from Clockwork's shop wakes Lirael, Cromwell, Sazed and the rest, who run into Hobbstweedle with no idea what is happening. At the village entrance they find Brand, Screech and Elric running with Clockwork behind them, shouting that they attacked him. The possessed men are tired and hurt, and the party knocks Brand and Elric unconscious; Clockwork's syringe stabilises them. Screech uses the stabilisation to wake Brand but is soon knocked out. Brand heals himself and runs for an alley, and Lirael puts him to sleep. The rest of the household arrives and is sent home, unhappily, to lock down the house; Clockwork explains what happened, and the party realises Brand had been possessed all along.

events.title: The Empty Jail and a Trail of Blood
events.summary: At the jail Sheldor and Charlie are gone and two guards are dead; bloody tracks lead to the airfield, where the gangway guards are dead too.
events.detail: The party takes the prisoners to the jail, avoiding the eyes of Sentinels coming out of their buildings. Lirael asks Clockwork to turn off the alarm and it is off before he finishes the sentence. At the jail Sheldor and Charlie are gone and two guards lie dead, so Clockwork turns the alarm back on and Lirael wakes Blazehelm by sending stone. A PA system calls a code black and Sentinels lock their doors. Sazed follows the bloody tracks north, then sharply right towards the airfield. There the guards at the gangways of both the Broadsword and the Kingsblade are dead; on the Kingsblade Sazed and the Defender find a dead duergar engineer and a dead deep gnome chef, while Lirael and Cromwell search the empty Broadsword.

events.title: Kingsblade Hijack Foiled
events.summary: Charlie Trundle kills the head of engineering and starts the Kingsblade's lift-off. Cromwell turns the whole ship off from the lawn.
events.detail: On the bridge Sazed and the Clockwork Defender find Sheldor and Charlie fighting Nedira and the dwarf head of engineering, Monty O'Brien. Sazed blows the Horn of Silent Alarm and joins in. Charlie kills Monty and starts the Kingsblade's lift-off. Cromwell races out of the Broadsword onto the lawn and casts on/off on the Kingsblade, and it drops back to the ground. Lirael and Cromwell climb the crane and misty step aboard, while Blazehelm warns over the sending stone that the ship will be shot down if it takes off. The party overwhelms Charlie and Sheldor, the Defender stabilises them, and everyone returns to the mansion by carriage.

events.title: Bellatrix Wakes Among Her Killers
events.summary: Paxon fetches another diamond and Eloria revives Bellatrix, who panics at the sight of the men who killed her.
events.detail: At the mansion Blazehelm tests Lug Murzog with detect good and evil: Lug is clear, but the others are still possessed. Bellatrix also has to be revived, so Paxon is sent away for another diamond and more paperwork. Eloria brings her back. Bellatrix freaks out on seeing her killers in the room. Eloria calms her, takes her to another room to explain, and leaves her with a butler.

events.title: Brand Dies Just a Little Bit
events.summary: To get Brand back, the party kills him and revives him. Paxon arrives with the diamond just too late and asks if they could not have waited.
events.detail: The party decides the fastest way to free Brand is to kill and revive him, which to Paxon's annoyance needs another diamond. Sazed kills Brand. Paxon arrives with the diamond, shocked: 'Couldn't you wait?' Eloria revives Brand and Monty O'Brien, the dwarf head of engineering. Brand is glad to have his mind back, apologises, and asks if he died; the party tells him he died just a little bit. Monty shares a small moment with Nedira and Feldor, and Blazehelm's detect good and evil clears Brand.

events.title: Clockwork Lassos Gelf From the Void
events.summary: Brand reveals the Dreamweaver wanted the Kingsblade crashed into the Citadel. Clockwork, who cannot dream, goes into the bag and ropes Gelf back from the Astral Sea.
events.detail: Brand explains what the Dreamweaver wanted: to crash the Kingsblade into the Citadel, and to have Brand himself. He also explains that Gelf is still floating in the Astral Sea. Clockwork cannot be possessed, so he is sent in. The party ties their ropes into a lasso, and Clockwork enters the bag and lassos Gelf. Everyone pulls him out and he immediately starts fighting, still possessed. The party knocks him out quickly and adds him to the others.

events.title: Into the Dreamweaver's Plane
events.summary: Feldor and Eloria put the party to sleep and link their dreams, and they wake on a black rocky plane where their friends sit caged.
events.detail: It is time to free Screech, Elric, Sheldor, Gelf and Charlie Trundle. The party lies down on couches and Feldor and Eloria cast sleep on them. Then the two cast dream on each of them, linking their dreams together. The party feels the darkness of the Dreamweaver as they go under. They arrive on a black, rocky plane. Their friends sit in a cage, sullen and lifeless, among floating orbs of light.

events.title: Bombing the Dream Eater
events.summary: A swirling monster paralyses Brand and Lirael, so Lirael lights a short fuse on the smokepowder satchel and runs. The blast deals 165 force damage.
events.detail: A dark, swirling monster emerges from the mist: the Dream Eater. It paralyses Brand and Lirael. Cromwell tries to lock it into a compelled duel but it shrugs it off with legendary resistance. The floating orbs gather into two staring eyes, and Sazed chips at the monster while it nearly kills Lirael. Cromwell uses mage hand to pick the cage lock, though a locked chain still holds it shut. Lirael sets a short fuse on the smokepowder bomb and runs, just as a featureless face rises from the mist with the orbs as its eyes. The bomb deals 165 force damage and kills the Dream Eater.

events.title: A Brass Dragon Bursts From the Light
events.summary: The face below rages, and a brass dragon explodes out of the light to attack it. The chain falls from the cage and light returns to their friends' eyes.
events.detail: With the Dream Eater dead, the face below them rages. A brass dragon appears in an explosion of light and attacks it, and both vanish into the darkness. The dream begins to fall apart. Cromwell's mage hand picks the lock on the chain, and it falls off the cage. Light returns to the friends' eyes. Lirael yells to wake Gelf, and Gelf starts waking the others.

events.title: Escaping the Collapsing Dream
events.summary: The eyeless face crushes the platforms as everyone races for the portal, until the dragon's brass tail drags it into the dark.
events.detail: Lirael and Brand wait by the portal while Sazed runs to help the others. Rocks vanish under their feet, explode into blinding light and float away into the dark. The face returns with its eyes gouged out by the dragon, a picture of agony. It crushes the platforms with its hands and reaches to hold them in the collapsing dream. The dragon's brass tail wraps around the face and drags it and its hands into the dark. Everyone leaps through the portal and wakes.

events.title: Friends Come Back to Themselves
events.summary: The freed Sentinels wake up as themselves, Gelf demands a rematch with Brand, and Eloria lets Sazed keep her elegant stethoscope.
events.detail: The party rises from the couches to see their friends come back to themselves. Charlie Trundle introduces himself, Sheldor wants to leave for Xen'drik, and Screech needs to fly. Gelf argues with Brand and Elric that he would have won a fair fight, and he and Brand agree to a rematch. Eloria examines the freed Sentinels with old-school training that outclasses the rushed wartime doctors. Sazed watches closely and asks to help, so she gives him an elegant stethoscope to double-check her work. Impressed, she lets him keep it.

events.title: Added to Blazehelm's Personal Guard
events.summary: The party now reports directly to Blazehelm, and together they plan a speech with fireworks to test the whole village for possession.
events.detail: The party is added to Blazehelm's personal guard and now reports to him personally. To test Hobbstweedle, Blazehelm will speak from a circular podium 60 feet around and cast detect good and evil under cover of exploding fireworks. Clockwork's warforged will make sure everyone attends. Clockwork gives the party a Defender to guard their house while they sleep, the same one they once fought. Bellatrix must stay with Gelf for now, and Eloria will revive the other dead Sentinels tomorrow, after which Hobbstweedle will be out of diamonds. At home Leff is pleased, because if the Dreamweaver can be punched it can be stopped. Sorenson has lost another bet to Keys, and not knowing who to trust reminds Tauren of the streets.

events.title: Mind Control Training
events.summary: Lirael answers the first three secret questions truthfully by mistake, and Leff aces his by not thinking at all.
events.detail: The party trains to resist mind magic. Elric, helped by Eloria, casts detect thoughts on Lirael and questions him; Lirael is meant to hide the answers but misunderstands and answers the first three truthfully. Reminded of the point, he nails the last two, and Dyll Strickland berates him anyway. Feldor casts confusion on Sazed and Eloria casts zone of truth on Brand, and both give away very little. Leff aces his questions by not thinking at all.

events.title: Fireworks Over Hobbstweedle
events.summary: Blazehelm finishes his speech, the fireworks go up, and behind the biggest explosion comes the familiar flash of detect good and evil.
events.detail: The Sentinels of Hobbstweedle gather around the circular podium while Clockwork's warforged make sure everyone attends. Blazehelm gives his speech. When he finishes, the fireworks go off. The party sees the familiar flash of light as he casts detect good and evil, timed perfectly with the biggest explosion. Nobody in the crowd notices.

events.title: No One Else Is Possessed
events.summary: In the war room Blazehelm reveals the village is clean. The secret stays secret, and Bellatrix must live with Gelf indefinitely.
events.detail: Everyone in the know meets in the war room after the speech. To everyone's relief, Blazehelm reveals that no one else in the village is possessed. The dead Sentinels have been revived, Paxon has made the records show the diamonds were stolen by quasits, and Hobbstweedle is out of diamonds. Blazehelm insists on secrecy, since if other dreamwoven people are in the military, telling command could put a target on them. Bellatrix must stay with Gelf indefinitely to keep the secret. Neither of them is thrilled.

events.title: Checklists at Screech's House
events.summary: Lirael preps for flight training at Screech's, where Gelf and Bellatrix are arguing and Screech shows off his nearly finished model Broadsword.
events.detail: Gelf's room burned down, so he is sharing a room with Screech. When Lirael arrives, Gelf and Bellatrix are arguing in it. Screech has nearly finished a model of the Broadsword and is very proud of it. He and Lirael go over checklists and flight rules for tomorrow. Brand works on his own projects.

events.title: Sazed Studies Trance States
events.summary: Looking for another way to free the dreamwoven, Sazed researches trances and is pointed to the military library in Starilaskur.
events.detail: Sazed wants a way to free people from the Dreamweaver that does not require dream spells. He searches the Hobbstweedle library and finds some help, but not enough. The librarian points him to the Starilaskur Military Library, which holds the foremost Brelish literature on trance states. Sazed believes he has a working theory for using a trance to exorcise possession. He only needs more information and more power to pull it off.

events.title: Lirael's First Flight
events.summary: After flight preparations and run-throughs, Screech lets Lirael take a Shuriken into the air for the first time.
events.detail: On Zarantyr 14th Lirael starts learning to fly a Shuriken with Screech. They go through the flight preparations and run-throughs first. Then Screech lets Lirael fly for the first time. He has him try a few turns and a spin. Then he spends two hours teaching Lirael the ins and outs of the fighter.

events.title: Lirael Wins the Paintball Dogfight
events.summary: In his first dogfight the drow out-turns his instructor and paints Screech's cockpit with paintballs.
events.detail: Using his sorcery and a little haste, Lirael manages to outmanoeuvre Screech. He brakes in front of him, drops speed to get below him and shoots. Screech gets wise to the trick, stays on his tail and hits him once. Lirael then spins the fighter while keeping his momentum and shoots Screech for the win, covering his cockpit in paintballs. Screech is shocked and impressed. He calls Lirael a natural and says he has lost a lot of money.

events.title: Clockwork Has No Use for Sentiment
events.summary: Teaching Brand how warforged are built, Clockwork reveals he sees no point in anything that does not serve a function.
events.detail: Brand trains with Clockwork, who shows him how warforged are built using the arm of a new warforged in progress. Brand probes Clockwork's outlook on the world. He learns Clockwork has no need for sentimentality and does not understand it. Built as a tool for a purpose, Clockwork sees no use in things that do not fulfil their function. Brand had liked Clockwork's lack of emotion until now, but this part he cannot understand.

events.title: The Rune Wakes the Spellcaster
events.summary: Clockwork trades the book of fire back for the rune from the dead warforged, then sets it in the spellcaster's chest and it comes back to life.
events.detail: Clockwork asks for the rune the party took from the warforged they killed. In exchange he gives Brand back the book of fire. He places the rune in the chest of the warforged spellcaster. The construct comes back to life, powered and embodied by the rune. Brand sees firsthand that the rune is what makes a warforged who it is.

events.title: Designing Limbs for Faird
events.summary: Faird rolls in asking for a way to fight again, and Brand and Clockwork look at the warforged arm on their bench, then at each other.
events.detail: Faird shows up in a wheelchair. He wants to know if they can do something to get him fighting again. Brand and Clockwork look down at the warforged arm they are working on, then at each other. They spend the next two hours with Faird, designing warforged limbs for him.

events.title: Monty Offers Elemental Engines
events.summary: Monty O'Brien, freshly revived, asks if Brand would like to learn elemental engines while the dwarves rebuild the Kingsblade.
events.detail: Monty O'Brien, Chief of Engineering on the Kingsblade, shows up at Clockwork's. He was killed in the fight to stop Sheldor and has just been brought back. He asks about Brand's head after the possession. Then he asks whether Brand would like to learn about elemental engines, since the dwarves are rebuilding the Kingsblade right now. Brand heads off with Monty and plans to return to work with Clockwork later.

events.title: A Letter From Meriel
events.summary: Erald, now on mail duty, delivers a note from the librarian: Lirael's father left something in a library locker.
events.detail: After training the party finds Erald coming with letters; Paxon has him working the mail. Sentinel mail is classified, so it needs an intelligence officer. There is a letter for Lirael from Meriel, the librarian. She found something his father left in one of the library's lockers. She always goes to the Daily Grind after her shift and asks him to meet her there at 6:30pm, signing it 'Meriel (THE LIBRARIAN!)' with a heart. Lirael heads into town.

events.title: Sazed Insists Plants Have Souls
events.summary: Brand wants to learn potion-making. He masters the practical side of the herbalism kit but flatly refuses the mystic side.
events.detail: Sazed works on potions and Brand joins him, wanting to learn. While brewing, Sazed teaches him the skills he will need to use a herbalism kit. Brand grasps all the practical parts quickly. He does not grasp the mystic part at all. Sazed insists plants have souls, and Brand will not accept it.

events.title: The Larkleaf Grow-Op
events.summary: To prove his point, Sazed finds a hidden patch of Larkleaf behind the house and Brand carves them a stone pipe.
events.detail: Since Brand will not take his word for it, Sazed decides to get him high to show him. He searches the forest behind the house and finds a hidden grow-op of Larkleaf. Brand builds them a pipe out of stone. They get high together. Brand enjoys it but still insists plants are just plants.

events.title: Meriel Dies on the Bridge
events.summary: Meriel waves to Lirael from across the river with her bookbag, steps onto the bridge out of sight, and never reaches the Daily Grind.
events.detail: Lirael waits at the Daily Grind and sees Meriel across the river carrying a bookbag. She waves to him and walks up onto the bridge, out of sight. She never arrives. Lirael goes onto the bridge and finds her dead with an arrow through her throat. He shouts for help, but the arrow carries a silence spell and no sound comes out.

events.title: Wait, I'm a Sentinel
events.summary: The military police suspect Lirael, who runs before remembering he has a badge. Witnesses describe a masked man in a black suit.
events.detail: Lirael throws the arrow in the river and calls the military police over. They immediately suspect him, and he runs for a bit before realising he is a Sentinel and stopping. He dodges their tackle and shows his badge. He explains what happened, leaving out what they do not need to know, and asks for their help. Nearby women say they saw a man in a black suit and a mask with a long nose jump into the water. Lirael dives in after him but finds nothing; the trail is cold.

events.title: Lirael Confides in Mercy
events.summary: At the library another librarian, Mercy, promises to search the records quietly. Walking back through Wroat, Lirael feels a strange presence.
events.detail: Lirael goes to the library and finds another librarian, Mercy. He flashes his badge and checks the lock-up for anything else his father left, but finds only personal effects. He tells Mercy about her coworker's death and asks whether his father had stored anything else there. She says she can look through the records. Lirael asks her to tell him what she finds and to tell nobody else, and she promises. Walking through Wroat afterwards, he feels a strange presence.

events.title: Paxon Names The Even Hand
events.summary: Lirael comes home to his friends getting high and making potions. Paxon recognises the mask: The Even Hand, an assassin no living person has met.
events.detail: Lirael returns home to find Sazed and Brand smoking and brewing potions, and tells them what happened. Unsure what to make of it, the party goes to Paxon. Paxon recognises the description: The Even Hand, an expensive and effective assassin who has appeared in the last few years. He is known to work with House Thuranni. No living person is known to have met him; there are only fleeting witness descriptions like the one Lirael got.

events.title: The Disbanded Royal Ardev Regiment
events.summary: Paxon traces a secret night exercise near the circle to a regiment disbanded four days later. Lirael knows almost every name: his own neighbours from Ardev.
events.detail: Paxon found that shortly after the demons appeared, the Royal Ardev Regiment ran a night exercise in the Boranex forest, supposedly a dry run for a torch-and-burn operation in Thrane. The military records in Wroat show no sign of the exercise or the operation. The regiment was disbanded four days later, on the 21st of Vult 992, after an exercise on the 17th. Its men never left the country and still draw military pay. Lirael recognises nearly every name as conscripts from his home village of Ardev. Three live in Wroat: the blacksmith Murphy Gravewood, his literature teacher Gauss Hog, and his high school friend Kal Valvier.

events.title: Signals Training With Nedira
events.summary: In the night forest Nedira tests Sazed on animal calls, smoke and light signals, then gives him ten years of letters from Prowlstone.
events.detail: Sazed goes into the Boranex forest at night for communications training with Nedira. Nedira teaches him every kind of Sentinel communication and gives him a book to keep track. He tests Sazed's signalling with animal calls, smoke and light, and Sazed nails it. Nedira lets him keep a shuttered light for signalling. He also gives Sazed a collection of letters and drawings from Prowlstone over the last ten years, the village Sazed's warning once saved.

events.title: Mercy Killed, the Records Burned
events.summary: Paxon turns up without the codeword: the Wroat military library's records room has burned down, and Mercy has been killed by an arrow.
events.detail: On the 15th of Zarantyr the party returns home from training and Paxon knocks on the door. Lirael asks for the codeword, but Paxon does not know it and just wants to be let in. He brings bad news. The military library in Wroat had a fire, and the records room burned down. The librarian Mercy was killed by an arrow. The party suspects The Even Hand and decides to investigate.

events.title: Two Scrolls of Speak With Dead
events.summary: Eloria is busy preparing to run Hobbstweedle while Blazehelm is away, but she hands over two scrolls of speak with dead.
events.detail: The party goes first to Eloria's house for help with speak with dead. She is busy preparing to take over Hobbstweedle when Blazehelm leaves again. She cannot come, but she gives them two scrolls of speak with dead. The party takes a carriage to move faster, with Tauren driving and Leff riding shotgun.

events.title: Chief Torg and Another Murder
events.summary: The overworked Wroat police chief does not want black ops trouble, then reveals Murphy Gravewood was murdered an hour ago.
events.detail: At the Wroat Military Police Station the party badges in to see the chief, Torg. He is frustrated; he has enough on his plate without black ops business. He tells them there has been another murder: Murphy Gravewood was killed an hour ago, and Lirael is shocked to lose another friend. The party convinces Torg they are there to take work off his plate, and he becomes grateful. At their urging he sends two beat cops to bring in Gauss Hog and Kal Valvier, whose lives are in danger.

events.title: Meriel Speaks From the Morgue
events.summary: Through speak with dead, Meriel says she never saw her killer, and that Lirael's father left behind a statue carved with runes.
events.detail: The party badges past the morgue doctor to question the corpses, saving one scroll for Murphy. They choose to speak with Meriel. She did not see her killer. Lirael's father had left behind a statue with runes on it. Nobody knew she was meeting Lirael, but everyone knew she went to that cafe after work.

events.title: Three Bodies at Murphy's House
events.summary: The police think a serial killer knew the victims. The party sees an expertly picked lock and a job by professionals.
events.detail: Travelling through Wroat, the whole party now feels what Lirael felt: like they are being watched. At Murphy Gravewood's house there are three corpses. The police think it is a serial killer tied to the librarian murders who knew the victims, since there was no forced entry; one was ambushed and two, including Murphy, put up a short, futile fight. The party does not buy the serial killer theory but keeps quiet. They find the door was picked expertly and no clues were left behind. It looks like professional work, possibly The Even Hand.

events.title: A Glint of Binoculars
events.summary: From Murphy's roof Sazed spots binoculars across the street and chases a dark figure heading for Gauss Hog's house.
events.detail: Sazed climbs onto the roof to look for clues and sees the glint of binoculars from a house across the street. Brand comes up behind him and sees it too. Then Sazed spots a dark figure moving through an alley, jumps off the house and runs after him. The figure is heading towards Gauss Hog's house, and Sazed yells this to Brand and Lirael. Brand jumps off the roof onto the carriage, Lirael runs out to it, and they take off. Sazed loses the figure in the busy streets and keeps running for the house.

events.title: Gauss Hog's House Explodes
events.summary: Just as Sazed and the carriage converge on it, Gauss Hog's house erupts in a massive explosion, and Brand finally sees The Even Hand.
events.detail: As Sazed approaches Gauss Hog's house he sees Tauren, Leff, Lirael and Brand racing down the other street. Then the house blows up. The blast throws Sazed and the police officer sent to collect Gauss Hog to the ground. Brand sees a glint on a rooftop again, and this time sees him clearly: The Even Hand. The assassin runs off across the buildings towards Kal Valvier's house. Sazed sprints down the street, jumps into the carriage, and they race to beat him there.

events.title: Give Us Kal and Walk Away
events.summary: The party beats the assassin to Kal's house, but as they leave The Even Hand and two assassins offer them a deal: hand over Kal and live.
events.detail: The party reaches Kal Valvier's house first. Brand breaks down the door and Lirael casts suggestion on Kal to get him to come with them. As they are about to leave, The Even Hand and two assassins ambush them. He says if they give him Kal he will let them go, this one time. They refuse and fight. The police officer Torg sent for Kal arrives and joins in; his name is Click Clack.

events.title: Kal Shot From the Rooftop
events.summary: The Even Hand drops a smoke bomb and kills Kal with a crossbow from the roof. Sazed brings him back, and he dies again under sanctuary.
events.detail: The assassins focus on Kal, so the party tells him to run, and he escapes through the front door. The Even Hand drops a smoke bomb, jumps onto the roof and kills Kal with his crossbow. Sazed finds Kal dead and revives him, and Kal tells them the killer is on the roof. Lirael misty steps up and Brand's thorn whip pulls The Even Hand off. Brand casts sanctuary on Kal, but The Even Hand kills him again anyway.

events.title: Hunger of Hadar Takes the Assassins
events.summary: Lirael's hunger of hadar kills one assassin and Click Clack kills the other, but The Even Hand smoke-bombs free and runs Kal down.
events.detail: One assassin had slipped into the crowd; another ran around the house with Click Clack chasing him. The first slips back out of the crowd and ambushes the party. Lirael casts hunger of hadar and they kill him, and Click Clack kills the other one coming around the house. The party surrounds The Even Hand, but he throws another smoke bomb and slips away. He catches Kal and kills him again, but outnumbered he cannot take his head. As the party hacks at him, something about his body does not feel right.

events.title: Click Clack Splits The Even Hand
events.summary: The Even Hand finally takes Kal's head, and then Click Clack's axe splits him open to reveal a black metal warforged with red eyes.
events.detail: Sazed revives Kal again, and The Even Hand kills him again, this time cutting off his head. As he finishes, Click Clack drives his axe into his shoulder and splits his body, wounding him mortally. His insides show he is a warforged. His mask falls away to reveal a black metal face with glowing red eyes. He says something like 'You got lucky this time,' and the party sees something shift behind his eyes, as they have seen with Clockwork. Then the red eyes go out, his internals spark for a few seconds, and the machine is dead.

events.title: Lirael Sr's Obelisk in Meriel's Bag
events.summary: Among the dead assassins' things is Meriel's book bag, holding the rune-carved obelisk Lirael's father obsessed over.
events.detail: The party introduces itself to Click Clack and thanks him, taking an immediate liking to the dim-witted elf. The two assassins are flesh and blood, and one carries a note telling them where to meet. They also have Meriel's book bag, and in it is Lirael Sr's obelisk. Lirael remembers it: his father thought it was important and part of the conspiracy he obsessed over, and Lirael never took it seriously until now. Its runes are ancient and similar to those on the demon portal. The party loads the bodies into the carriage and hides them.

events.title: Click Clack Resigns
events.summary: Chief Torg finally learns why he is so overworked: he has been rewriting Click Clack's police reports, which are all stick-figure drawings.
events.detail: Back at the station the party looks for information on The Even Hand while Click Clack resigns. Chief Torg is furious. He is overworked because he has been redoing all of Click Clack's reports, which arrive as stick drawings he has to interpret. He screams at Click Clack for five minutes and asks him to identify a square object in one drawing; it was a head. Click Clack just wants to clear out his locker, and Torg says fine if he is back in five minutes, if he can count to five. Astoundingly Click Clack counts to 25, and an impressed Torg hands over the locker key. A friend at the station mocks him for his life choices, then invites him for beers later.

events.title: The Master Key
events.summary: Click Clack claims his locker key is a master key, forces it into the T filing cabinet by brute strength, and finds nothing.
events.detail: Click Clack returns claiming he has a master key, completely unaware that it is not one. Brand does not believe him, but Lirael goes in with him to check. At the filing cabinet marked T, Click Clack smashes the key into the lock and turns it by sheer strength, destroying the mechanism and opening the drawer. There is nothing useful inside. When Click Clack returns the key, Torg is impressed he is back in under five minutes, until he sees the key. He is simply thankful he no longer has to deal with Click Clack.

events.title: Gauss Hog Turns Up Alive
events.summary: While Brand and Sazed wait on the carriage, Gauss Hog walks up to report that his house blew up. He was not inside.
events.detail: Brand and Sazed are waiting outside on the carriage when Gauss Hog shows up. He has come to report to the police that the house he was staying in blew up. The party warns him his life is in danger and tells him to come with them. They gather to leave the city for Hobbstweedle, still feeling watched. At the gate they get guest passes for Gauss Hog and Click Clack.

events.title: The Regiment's Real Mission
events.summary: Gauss Hog tells Blazehelm and Paxon what the regiment really did: a classified strike that bombed the circle just as a Balor was coming through.
events.detail: The party tells Blazehelm and Paxon what happened and gets the story out of Gauss Hog. The Royal Ardev Regiment was in Wroat preparing for an attack on Thrane. Its leader, Captain Flowers, said they had a classified order to take out a target near a retirement community, which they knew was not really one. They met heavy demon presence but took no casualties. They used a Broadhelm concussion bomb to destroy the circle right as a Balor was about to come through. A few days later the regiment was disbanded and scattered, the Thrane operation never happened, and Gauss Hog has waited a month for reassignment; Blazehelm wants to talk with him further.

events.title: Imps Firebomb the House
events.summary: Imps in stolen Sentinel gear hurl alchemist's fire at the party's house, led by the two who escaped the demon village.
events.detail: After dropping off Tauren and Leff, the party spots a band of imps in stolen Sentinel gear throwing alchemist's fire at the house. Two of them are the imps that escaped the village and were later in Gelf and Elric's house; this is revenge for the village. The party cuts through imps, but the rest keep throwing fire. Brand's ray of frost puts out a large part of the blaze, so the imps simply move to the other side of the house. Sazed runs in to get the household on buckets and calls Clockwork through the Defender for warforged firefighters, and an alarm sounds from Clockwork's shop.

events.title: Rolick's Dust Finds the Last Imps
events.summary: The surviving imps turn invisible, but Click Clack throws Lirael's bag of dust and Sazed spots the other by a rustling tree.
events.detail: After the party kills most of the imps, the rest turn invisible and try to flee. The party is wise to that trick by now. Lirael gives Click Clack his bag of dust from Rolick, and Click Clack throws it where he thinks the imps are, coating one of them. Sazed races outside ahead of the others and spots the other invisible imp by the rustling of a tree. They finish off the last two before they can escape. With the fire out, Click Clack goes home to his wife, and the firefighting warforged tell the party to see Clockwork about The Even Hand.

events.title: The Form They Definitely Shouldn't File
events.summary: Eloria has no diamonds for Kal, but explains a form for gentle repose that they definitely should not fill out or take over Paxon's head.
events.detail: The party goes to Eloria's house to ask how to save Kal. She makes them coffee and tea, and they meet her roommate Eleanor, who is working on an airship compressor. Eloria says there are no diamonds left. Gentle repose is not normally spent on regular soldiers. But there is a form they definitely 'shouldn't' fill out, and definitely 'shouldn't' take over Paxon's head.

events.title: An Ardev Song on the Piano
events.summary: At Eloria's house Lirael mourns Meriel, Murphy and Kal with a traditional song from Ardev, and Eloria joins him.
events.detail: In two days Lirael has lost Meriel, Mercy, the blacksmith Murphy Gravewood and his school friend Kal. Murphy and Kal were both from his home village. At Eloria's piano he plays a traditional Ardev song to mourn them. Eloria joins in.

events.title: The Obelisk Rune Reads Dream
events.summary: Sazed steals the regiment file while a very annoyed Paxon gives Lirael a book that decodes one rune on the obelisk: dream.
events.detail: At the mansion Sazed steals the regiment file. The party then talks to a very annoyed Paxon about the obelisk. He gives Lirael a book on it and manages to annoy Brand in the process. With it, Lirael decodes one rune on the obelisk. The script is even older than the circle's, though the runes are similar. The rune says dream.

events.title: The Rune Transmits a Soul
events.summary: Clockwork finds The Even Hand's rune does not hold his mind; it broadcasts it. Three intact runes would let him triangulate the assassin.
events.detail: Clockwork examines The Even Hand's body. The rune inside him does not contain his 'soul'; it transmits it. If the party can recover three undamaged runes, Clockwork can triangulate The Even Hand's position. This one is broken. Clockwork is also struck by how advanced the warforged body is and how much they could learn from it.

events.title: Blast Marks at the Broken Circle
events.summary: Back at the broken circle, faint weathered blast marks confirm Gauss Hog's story of the concussion bomb.
events.detail: The party returns to the broken teleportation circle in the Boranex forest. They notice the faint remains of an explosion, eroded by weather. It fits Gauss Hog's account of the regiment's Broadhelm concussion bomb. Someone really did blow up the circle on purpose.

events.title: The Very Old Imp
events.summary: Tracks lead to a hut with one very old imp who disapproves of the young ones' stealing. His song is so annoying the party kills him anyway.
events.detail: The party follows tracks from their house to a small hut. Inside is one very old imp. He plays an annoying song and says he disapproves of the young imps stealing. He seems harmless and does not fight back. His song is so annoying that the party kills him anyway, and he has an unusual amount of health for an imp.

events.title: A Last Night at Brew and Ale
events.summary: Gelf, Elric and Screech drag everyone to the bar before Gelf and Elric ship out, and the household talks about where home is.
events.detail: When the party gets home, Gelf, Elric and Screech show up wanting to go to Brew and Ale before Gelf and Elric leave in the morning. Sheldor talks about wanting to go home and not knowing what he is doing here. Keys and Sorenson do not know what they are doing either, but they have no home to go back to.
