The party learns Keys went to prison for refusing to kill animals and turning on his squad instead. Elric is oddly excited about the coming mission, and Gelf is not.

events.title: Sazed Dances, Eleanor Hides
events.summary: Gauss Hog arrives a newly minted Sentinel. Sazed's flirting earns him a dance with Eloria, while Eleanor hides behind Brand.
events.detail: Gauss Hog shows up at the bar, now a Sentinel himself. Eloria and Eleanor arrive. Sazed tries to flirt with Eloria and she gets him out on the dance floor. Eleanor has no interest in dancing, or really in being at the bar at all. Lirael and Sazed help her slip off the dance floor, and she hides behind Brand.

events.title: Rigged Chicken Races
events.summary: Lirael rigs chicken races with some deep gnomes, Screech and Keys, and walks away 100 gold richer.
events.detail: Lirael organises chicken races at the bar with some deep gnomes, Screech and Keys. The races are rigged. Lirael makes 100gp off them. Nobody seems to catch on.

events.title: The Gelf and Brand Rematch
events.summary: Gelf demands the rematch he swore from the Astral Sea. Brand is not interested until long rest potions come out and the bar starts betting.
events.detail: Gelf asks Brand for the rematch they agreed on after the dream. Brand is not interested. Then Gelf pulls out long rest potions and the bar starts cheering them on. Everyone bets on the fight. Brand wins.

events.title: Brand Walks Eleanor Home
events.summary: Brand leaves at ten, and so does a relieved Eleanor. On the walk home she warms up to him a little.
events.detail: Brand leaves the bar at 10pm. Eleanor leaves at the same time, relieved to be done. They have a short chat on the way home. Eleanor seems to warm up to Brand a little. Sazed stays too long and leaves at 12:45, and Lirael parties until the bar closes at 2am.

events.title: The Brass Dragon Breaks the Prison
events.summary: The party shares a nightmare of a prison. They hold their minds together, and the brass dragon frees itself and them, revives Lirael, and sends Brand to the forge.
events.detail: That night the party dreams of a prison. They pass their wisdom saves and hold out against it. The brass dragon from the Dreamweaver's plane breaks itself free and frees them too. It revives Lirael. It tells Brand to go to the forge.

events.title: Hangovers on the Training Field
events.summary: Sazed tanks his hangover through morning training. Tauren, Leff and Sheldor do not, and Dyll lets them hear about it.
events.detail: Morning training comes after a long night at Brew and Ale. Sazed tanks his hangover. Tauren, Leff and Sheldor are less lucky. Dyll Strickland yells at all three of them.

events.title: Fighting Their Own Doppelgangers
events.summary: In dream training run by Lirael, everyone fights a doppelganger of themselves, and Shadow Lirael steals the smokepowder bomb trick.
events.detail: Feldor and Eloria run dream training, though Lirael ends up leading it. The party learns how to tell they are dreaming, and how to dream lucidly and control things. To train their minds they fight doppelgangers of themselves. Shadow Lirael cleverly uses the smokepowder bomb strategy and blows Sazed and Lirael back to the waking world. Brand finishes the fight in the dream alone.

events.title: A Silence Arrow in the Door
events.summary: A silence arrow and a note from The Even Hand are stuck in the party's door. He is very much alive, and he knows where they live.
events.detail: The party finds a silence arrow and a note from The Even Hand in their door. It is the same kind of arrow that killed Meriel. Clockwork had said the assassin's broken body only transmitted his soul, and here is the proof. The party clears the premises but finds nothing but tracks.

events.title: Tracks Into the Sewers
events.summary: The tracks end at the river, and the party realises The Even Hand is moving through the sewers. Clockwork starts designing sewer crawlers.
events.detail: The tracks from the house lead to a river and disappear. The party realises The Even Hand is using the sewers to get around. Clockwork begins designing sewer crawlers to hunt through them. Meanwhile Leff announces he wants to eat a cow.

events.title: The Stolen Sewer Map
events.summary: The Hobbstweedle library's sewer map has been stolen. Lirael and Cromwell sneak into the mansion for Paxon's copy, but he is already sending one over.
events.detail: The sewer map has been stolen from the Hobbstweedle library, with a trail leading to the river. Paxon should have a copy. Lirael and Cromwell sneak into the mansion to steal it. Paxon, it turns out, is already copying one and sending it over.

events.title: Bellatrix Sent Home
events.summary: Bellatrix is fed up with being kept in town, so the party lets her go home.
events.detail: Bellatrix has been forced to stay with Gelf since the possession to keep the secret. She is annoyed about being kept in town. The party sends her home. It is a decision that will come back to haunt them.

events.title: Dyll's Sasquatch Bucket
events.summary: Dyll arrives needing the party to fill a bucket so he can track a sasquatch. It turns out to be a gnome prank.
events.detail: Dyll Strickland shows up with an urgent request. He needs the party to relieve themselves in a bucket so he can find a sasquatch. It is a prank by the gnomes.

events.title: Brand Leads a Church Service
events.summary: Brand gives a service in the Hobbstweedle church and learns about the previous priest, Fogen, killed in the Skyfire Raid from Aundair.
events.detail: Brand gives a church service. Afterwards he learns about the priest before him, Fogen. Fogen was killed in the Skyfire Raid launched from Aundair.

events.title: Erald Delivers the Sewer Map
events.summary: Erald brings Paxon's copy of the sewer map and complains about being overworked.
events.detail: Erald arrives with the sewer map Paxon copied. Between records, investigations and classified mail, Paxon has him doing everything. He complains about being overworked. The party now has a way to follow The Even Hand underground.

events.title: The Paxon Painting Heist
events.summary: Dyll says no pranks, so the party recruits Screech and three gnomes at Brew and Ale to copy Paxon's portrait, draw on it and hang it in the main hall.
events.detail: On the 17th the party finishes training and Dyll says no pranks, so they decide to pull one. At Brew and Ale they recruit Screech and the gnomes Spingus, Dandy and Fizbark. The plan is to duplicate Paxon's painting, draw on it and hang it in the main hall. Fizbark will distract Paxon at 8 when new supplies arrive so the painting can be copied. Spingus will get them into the mansion, and Dandy will distract the guards that night while they hang it.

events.title: Eloria and Clockwork Join the Prank
events.summary: Eloria is ecstatic to forge documents and supply a scroll of facsimile, and Clockwork is pleased to contribute glue. Paxon has annoyed a lot of people.
events.detail: The party asks Eloria to forge documents and provide a scroll of facsimile. She is ecstatic to be included. They ask Clockwork for glue, and he is pleased to be part of it. Recruiting is easy. Paxon has annoyed a lot of people.

events.title: Raiding the Potion Room
events.summary: Up the dumbwaiter and invisible, the party raids the mansion potion room and leaves with a scroll of comprehend languages and the Amulet of Compulsive Truth.
events.detail: At 8 the party deceives the side guard of the mansion and goes into the kitchen with Spingus. They ride the dumbwaiter up, cast invisibility and sneak into the potion room. Most of the potions are junk. They also find a Scroll of Comprehend Languages and the Amulet of Compulsive Truth. They steal all of it.

events.title: The Tomb of Centarrel
events.summary: With Paxon's painting duplicated, the party opens the hidden teleporter behind it and arrives in a tomb for the dragons of Centarrel and the soldiers who killed them.
events.detail: The party duplicates Paxon's painting, which hides the keyhole to an unmarked teleporter room, and goes through the portal. They arrive in the Tomb of Centarrel. It honours the Dragons of Centarrel and the soldiers who killed them. The graves are dated from the 8th to the 13th of Eyre 968, the Day the Walls Fell in Wroat.

events.title: The Graves of Their Fathers
events.summary: Among the soldiers buried in the tomb are High Marshall Elmor Daerthane, Thaldamir's father, and Cedric Ironhard, Gelf's father.
events.detail: The party walks the graves of the soldiers who fought the dragons. They find the grave of Elmor Daerthane, Thaldamir's father, a High Marshall who fought alongside the troops. They also find the grave of Cedric Ironhard, Gelf's father. Both died in the days the walls fell.

events.title: Clockwork Wyrmlings and a Dragon Skull
events.summary: Deeper in the tomb, clockwork wyrmlings guard a closed dragon skull. A secret exit leads out to the Hobbstweedle cemetery.
events.detail: The party finds a secret exit that comes out in the cemetery of Hobbstweedle. Looking deeper into the tomb, they find clockwork wyrmlings. The way onward is a closed dragon skull. They decide to come back later.

events.title: After the Walls Fell
events.summary: The tomb fills in the history: after the dragons of Centarrel were killed, the dragons left Khorvaire, the Guns of Wroat went up, and the Sentinels were formed.
events.detail: The party takes in the history behind the tomb. The killing of the Dragons of Centarrel came with the Day the Walls Fell in 968. Afterwards the remaining dragons left Khorvaire. The Guns of Wroat were put up in 971. The Sentinels were created in 972.

events.title: Hanging the Portrait Under a Beholder
events.summary: Invisible, the party slips back into the mansion with Dandy, who pulls the guards away with a Beholder illusion while they hang the doctored portrait.
events.detail: The party sneaks back into the mansion invisibly at night with Dandy. Dandy conjures an illusion of a Beholder to distract the guards. The party puts up the doctored copy of Paxon's portrait in the main hall. Nobody sees them do it.

events.title: Paxon's Portrait Unveiled
events.summary: At 8am the doctored portrait is revealed in the main hall. Everyone laughs, even Blazehelm, and Paxon is humiliated.
events.detail: The party shows up at the mansion at 8am for the unveiling. Everyone laughs at Paxon and he is humiliated. Even Blazehelm finds it funny. Dyll asks if they were involved in the gnomes' prank, and they deny it. He seems to buy it, but drops hints that he knows and approves. Spingus tells them they now owe the gnomes; Lirael gives him 20gp, which does not seem to sway him.

events.title: Bellatrix Is Dead
events.summary: Blazehelm comes to the house himself: Bellatrix and her roommate were killed overnight, and a note was left behind.
events.detail: Brand had asked to speak with Blazehelm before liftoff. Instead Blazehelm comes to the party's house in person. Bellatrix is dead. Her killers also murdered her roommate, and they left a note. She had been sent home only the day before, after complaining about being kept in town.

events.title: Why Blazehelm Trusts Paxon
events.summary: Brand voices his doubts about Paxon. Blazehelm explains that Paxon annoyed the military into hiring him, prison stint included.
events.detail: Brand tells Blazehelm he has concerns about Paxon. Blazehelm tells the story of how Paxon got in. He annoyed the military until they hired him, and was even put in prison at one point along the way. Paxon is annoying, Blazehelm admits. But he believes in the party.

events.title: Goodbyes at the Airfield
events.summary: The party says goodbye to friends heading off to fight a Karrnathi airship fleet the Pillar of Dawn has engaged.
events.detail: The party heads to the airfield. Their friends are leaving to fight a Karrnathi airship fleet that the Pillar of Dawn has engaged. The party says goodbye. They will be leaving on a ship of their own, the newly christened Moonwatch.

events.title: The Moonwatch Crew Roster
events.summary: Screech captains the Moonwatch, with Beazle at the helm, Lirael co-helm, Brand engineer and Sazed on communications and navigation.
events.detail: The ship roles are assigned. Screech is ship captain. Beazle is helmsman and Lirael co-helmsman. Brand is ship engineer, and Sazed is communications and navigation officer. Sorenson is head of security and Erald is intelligence officer.

events.title: Parting Gifts
events.summary: Eleanor hands Brand a typed manual of the ship upgrades, Clockwork gives him an all-purpose tool, Sazed gets the Wildheart Claw tattoo and Lirael the Bloodwell Vial.
events.detail: Eleanor briefs the party on the Moonwatch's upgrades and gives Brand a hand-typed manual. Clockwork gives Brand an all-purpose tool. Eloria gives Sazed the Wildheart Claw tattoo. Sheldor gives Lirael the Bloodwell Vial.

events.title: The Moonwatch Departs
events.summary: Blazehelm makes Screech a Master Chief and the party Petty Officers First Class, hands over 400 gold, and the Moonwatch lifts off.
events.detail: Blazehelm promotes Screech to Master Chief. He promotes the party to Petty Officer First Class, the same rank as Paxon. He also gives them 400gp. Then the party leaves Hobbstweedle aboard the Moonwatch, ending their time with the Sentinels.

events.title: Lift-Off for Ardev
events.summary: The Moonwatch leaves Hobbstweedle for Ardev. Lirael gets a turn at the helm and flies horribly.
events.detail: Sazed takes over plotting the course once Lirael has had his go at piloting. Brand and Screech test the new compressor: the ship can boost for up to an hour, twice a day, as long as Brand watches the engine the whole time. The party picks their cabins and Beezel helps them modify their uniforms. Chester the mimic is helped into a new form as a safe. Beezel hands out stolen Blazehelm whiskey and cigars to celebrate the first mission.

events.title: Evil in the Mirrors
events.summary: Brand's detect good and evil lights up every mirror on the ship. Each time Lirael looks into one, a horrible nightmare flashes through him.
events.detail: Lirael looks into a mirror three times and each look brings a new flash of nightmare. Nothing like this has happened since the prison, and the mirrors in Hobbstweedle never did it. Brand senses different levels of evil from different sizes of mirror: the bigger the glass, the stronger the aura. The crew starts to suspect the mirrors are a window for the Dreamweaver and the Shadow Mirror.

events.title: Detour over the Yedani Prison
events.summary: To test a theory, the party secretly turns the Moonwatch toward the Yedani mountains to fly over the prison where Lirael was held.
events.detail: Sazed plots the new course without telling Erald or Beezel. The idea is to see whether the evil in the mirrors grows as the ship nears the prison. Brand keeps casting detect good and evil on the approach. The aura never grows: the mirrors are no stronger over the prison than they were at lift-off.

events.title: Sorenson's Fears
events.summary: Sorenson admits to Lirael that he only joined the Sentinels for his freedom, and that he is scared. Lirael then tells Erald and Beezel about the Dreamweaver.
events.detail: Sorenson is nervous to be out in the world without Keys, does not want to die, and worries about everything. Lirael tells him that he might look like he has it together, but he does not know what he is doing either. Afterwards Lirael decides the crew deserves the truth. He tells Erald and Beezel about the Dreamweaver that once possessed him.

events.title: The Fourth Look
events.summary: Lirael looks into a mirror a fourth time and collapses unconscious on the deck.
events.detail: Sazed will not let Beezel near him while he is down. Brand wakes Lirael with a slap. He is not possessed, but the nightmare leaves him shaken, with a penalty to everything he tries for a while. The party realises that, dangerous or not, the mirrors are a source of information they still need to look into.

events.title: Cromwell the Stowaway
events.summary: The party turns around to find Cromwell standing there, out of nowhere. He passed out drunk aboard the night before.
events.detail: Nobody had noticed him come aboard. He passed out drunk on the ship the night before they left Hobbstweedle. Sorenson missed him completely during the security check. Cromwell is now part of the Moonwatch's crew whether anyone planned it or not.

events.title: Mirrors Overboard
events.summary: Every mirror on the Moonwatch goes over the side, except one small makeup mirror locked inside Chester.
events.detail: The crew decides the mirrors are too dangerous to keep lying around. They keep a single makeup mirror for study and store it inside Chester the safe. To test it, Chester flashes the mirror at Sazed. Sazed fights off the nightmare and confirms the mirror is no stronger here than it was right after lift-off.

events.title: A Chipmunk in the Books
events.summary: Beezel, in chipmunk form, rummages through Sazed's books, and Sazed loses his temper.
events.detail: Beezel thinks it is funny to mess with Sazed's books while in chipmunk form. Sazed is not amused. He gets genuinely angry and shoves Beezel away. The next day Beezel makes amends with apology whiskey and cigars.

events.title: Dandy's Dinner
events.summary: Dandy the gnome chef serves dinner, very sure of himself, and wants someone to tell Spingus how much better his cooking is.
events.detail: Over dinner the crew talks about what they want from Ardev. Sorenson wants to visit Shmem Gorgi's parents and find out whether the town has a recording studio. Dandy wants to know whether any restaurants there need his tutelage. Everyone has their own reason to look forward to landing.

events.title: Canuck Songs into the Night
events.summary: The ship's band plays traditional Canuck songs and the whole crew dances late into the night.
events.detail: Beezel takes the night shift at the helm and Screech joins him, ecstatic to be the captain of a ship. The band sets up with Sorenson on guitar, Dandy on bass and Screech on drums. Screech brings out sheet music for traditional Canuck songs. They play into the night while everyone dances and has a good time, then the ship goes to bed.

events.title: The Cookie Feud
events.summary: Erald can't sleep and bakes cookies. Dandy is furious, and even more furious when the cookies turn out to be good.
events.detail: After Lirael comes out of his trance he finds Erald up, unable to sleep, and planning to bake. Dandy takes the cookies as a challenge to his kitchen. He makes breakfast to prove he is the better cook. Then he tastes one of Erald's cookies and is enraged to find it is good. Meanwhile Sazed teaches Brand how to use the herbalism kit.

events.title: Steve the Skycracker
events.summary: Pirates ambush the Moonwatch over the Dagger River. A blue dragon destroys them, then turns on the ship for trespassing in his sky.
events.detail: Lirael has Screech pull the braking maneuver, but it is not enough to lose the pirates. Then a blue dragon tears the pirates apart and comes for the Moonwatch. Lirael speaks to it telepathically to reason with it. The dragon is Steve the Skycracker, angry that they are in his skies when they belong on the ground. The crew pushes the compressor harder than they probably should and knocks the dragon over. Steve departs, demanding they ask permission before flying again. Beezel sleeps through the whole thing.

events.title: A Cold Welcome to Ardev
events.summary: Ardev's air traffic control answers Sazed in nonsense, and the mercenaries at the landing do not recognise the Sentinel badge.
events.detail: Before they land, Erald gives the party a sending stone to keep in touch. The mercenaries who meet them are hostile until two of Ardev's police, Jazz Chism and Mustang, berate them. Jazz is the ex-boyfriend of Lirael's crush Xera, and his father Wilford Chism heads the Silver Flame church and was Lirael Sr's best friend. Mustang is an experimental warforged police unit with an enhanced personality core. The two officers escort the party away from the angry mercenaries and into town.

events.title: Fark's Bargain Whores
events.summary: Jazz tells them the Magic Society has closed. Its building is now a brothel called Fark's Bargain Whores.
events.detail: Lirael Sr once led the Magic Society, and now it is gone. Jazz heads back to the police station and Mustang goes to Fark's. The party goes to the cemetery. There Lirael finds the headstones of his friends Dwarzel, Smelt and Lars. They pass on into lower Ardev toward Lirael's family home.

events.title: The Murderer's Home
events.summary: Lirael's sister opens the door and calls to their mother that "the murderer's home". His mother is thrilled, and smokes through the hard conversation he forces on her.
events.detail: Felicia Jr leaves for her shift at the Turckle and Churckle. Felicia Sr is overjoyed to see her son. She has started smoking again and has joined the Silver Flame church. She asks Lirael to stay at the house. When he tries to talk about what is really going on she keeps avoiding it, until he insists they have to talk. She puffs through cigarette after cigarette and bears it, plainly upset.

events.title: Lirael Sr's Den
events.summary: In the basement den, Lirael Sr's books and journals trace a brilliant general's slide into obsession with the Dreamweaver and the Shadow Mirror.
events.detail: Lirael Sr was a powerful wizard, a Brelish general and head of the Magic Society, and a scholar of ancient eldritch beings. Three years ago he became convinced that someone in the Brelish military was trying to capture the Dreamweaver, and that only the Shadow Mirror could control it. He stopped doing his duties, sent away his guard, and was discharged after he was caught investigating his superiors. Lirael once followed him to a warlock cult in Starilaskur. A year and a half into his obsession he disappeared. Going through the den, Lirael tells the party the whole story. He wonders whether his father was mad, or a man who saw what no one else could.

events.title: Runes on the Obelisk
events.summary: Comprehend languages finally reads the runes on the black obelisk.
events.detail: The party casts comprehend languages on the runes in the den. The inscription reads: "The Gate to Shadows and Dreams. The Reflection of the Mirror. The Light of the Way. Beware of Knowledge." The lines tie the obelisk to the Gate and the Mirror. "Beware of Knowledge" becomes a warning the party keeps running into, in the library and in Sorenson's dream song.

events.title: Lirael Sr's Last Poem
events.summary: After a year and a half without an entry, Lirael Sr's journal ends with one last poem. It tells them how to light the obelisk.
events.detail: Lirael Sr had stopped writing poetry, which makes the final entry stand out: "Standing tall and black as night / Fortune is within its sight / Spoken tongue that no one knows / Light the way and it will show." The party puzzles over it and works out the answer. They light the obelisk. It reveals a hidden door and a puzzle left behind by Lirael Sr. The puzzle behind the door will take them two hours to solve.

events.title: The Madman's Puzzle
events.summary: It takes two hours to solve Lirael Sr's bizarre library puzzle, and his insanity shows in every part of its construction.
events.detail: Lirael has just shared his and his father's story in an emotional moment. The puzzle behind the hidden door is maddening and makes little sense. When it finally gives way, it reveals an elevator. The party rides it down and enters an anti-magic field.

events.title: Slaad Dad
events.summary: In a secret office at the bottom of the elevator sits Lirael Sr, saying he gave up on the Dreamweaver and that everyone is doomed. Sazed does not believe it and steps between them.
events.detail: Sazed is right. The father turns into a slaad and opens with a fireball. Brand casts enlarge on Sazed and the fight turns against the creature. As it starts losing, the slaad turns invisible and hides to regenerate. Lirael searches the elevator but cannot find it, and Brand and Sazed block the entrance while Sazed sweeps the room.

events.title: Up the Chimney
events.summary: The slaad has shrunk itself and escapes up in the elevator. The enlarged Sazed crams himself up the chimney to meet it at the top.
events.detail: Before Sazed can step into the elevator, its doors close and it starts to rise. The slaad reveals itself inside, small now, and attacks ferociously, held off by Brand. Sazed forces his massive form into the chimney and races up to the den. When the elevator doors open the party ambushes the slaad and kills it.

events.title: The Secret Office
events.summary: Lirael Sr's office holds a pedestal with a slot for the obelisk and a diamond-shaped hole like the one on the hidden door upstairs.
events.detail: The party finds the covers of the Wroat Military Library's Dreamweaver books, but the pages inside are different books marked with Dewey decimal numbers. Someone has swapped the real books out. In a book in the den Brand learns that slaads are mind controlled by whoever holds their control gem. That raises the question of who sent this one.

events.title: Mother Under Suggestion
events.summary: Lirael's mother is shocked by the dead slaad and will not leave. Lirael uses suggestion to get her onto the Moonwatch.
events.detail: She shows Lirael his old room, which she has filled with hoarded things, and a mirror in it nearly drags him into a nightmare. She wants him to stay for three days. He casts suggestion and she walks to the ship. When the spell ends she says Lirael is becoming like his father. She will go with him, but he must never put a spell on her again. Then she bonds with the crew of the Moonwatch.

events.title: I Pray the Worst Has Come
events.summary: Sorenson shares a song that came to him in a dream. It contains a phrase Lirael Sr always used.
events.detail: The song opens "I pray the worst has come, written on tomes and set in stone". Its chorus runs "Behind the eye of your mind, tell me those thoughts are mine". Its last verse warns "Black lights will show, the key to the hole. Beware of what you know." Lirael recognises the opening line as his father's saying. The song seems to point at the obelisk, the den and the warning on its runes.

events.title: Baron Hellsauce Makes an Offer
events.summary: While Sazed smokes outside, Baron Hellsauce of the Dragons Claw puffs out his chest and offers him a mercenary job.
events.detail: Beezel has given Sazed apology whiskey and cigars for the business with the books. Sazed is smoking one of the cigars outside when Baron Hellsauce comes over. He offers Sazed a place with the Dragons Claw mercenaries. Sazed turns him down.

events.title: Carrk's Message at the Library
events.summary: At the Ardev Library, Sazed finds a hidden poem from Carrk in the sign-in sheet: the shifter village Stones Throw has been wiped out.
events.detail: Chip the chipmunk librarian is terrified to see Lirael. Carrk's message says he was too late to save Stones Throw and is heading to Hearthswood near Starilaskur. The party finds the books it came for, and inside their covers are the real Wroat Dreamweaver books. They read until they reach the part about Beware of Knowledge, then stop, though there is more to read. They put each book back in its proper cover and leave.

events.title: Barry Baritone
events.summary: In Ardev square the party meets Barry Baritone, a warforged built with both Cannith and Broadhelm tech.
events.detail: Brand asks how that is possible. Barry says he was built by Brokk Broadhelm, son of Art, for the Cannith Forge. Brokk is Brand's nephew. Barry gets off work at 10:30 and agrees to take them to the forge then.

events.title: Trouble at the Turckle and Churckle
events.summary: At the Turckle and Churckle, Lirael's old crush Xera is harassed by Dragons Claw mercenaries, and the party slips them a potion.
events.detail: Felicia is not happy to see Lirael, but Turckle, like a supportive uncle, always believed he was innocent and gives them free food and drink. Lirael and Xera try awkwardly to find their old groove. Mercenaries in the back flip up her skirt and bet on her underwear. When Turckle asks them to pay, they tell him they run the town. On their next round Lirael makes an illusion of breaking glass and pours a potion of talk with ants into their drinks. Turckle tells the party to beat some respect into them, but not to kill them, and to take it outside.

events.title: Ants, Insults and Tighty Whities
events.summary: Lirael wins a battle of insults with Captain Ellis. Outside, ants order the mercenaries to lick a spilled drink off the street.
events.detail: Ellis, a captain under Morganth and the man who flipped Xera's skirt, doesn't care what they say. Lirael beats him in a battle of insults, and everyone takes it outside while Xera and later Felicia come out to watch. An angry woman taking notes follows them out. Sazed finds ants and Lirael throws them on the mercenaries, who obey the ants and lick a spilled drink. Xera pulls down Ellis's pants to reveal tighty whities with hearts on them. The party de-pants the rest, and Sazed kicks one so hard he nearly kills him.

events.title: Jazz Smells Magic
events.summary: Lirael's speech about liberty falls flat. Jazz arrives, detects the spell on the mercenaries, and Mustang talks him out of arresting anyone.
events.detail: Lirael appeals to the people of Ardev to throw off the rule of the mercenaries, but the crowd looks worried rather than moved. Jazz and Mustang come over, and Lirael plays dumb. Jazz casts detect magic and knows the mercenaries are under a spell. Mustang cools him off with stories of the mercenaries' unpunished misdeeds. Jazz lets them go, asks them to stop causing trouble and assigns Mustang to watch them. Xera identifies the note-taker as Grib Grimley, a reporter for the Ardev Watch.

events.title: Felicia Storms Off
events.summary: Lirael finally talks to his sister. She is furious that he left her when she needed him, and she storms off into the night.
events.detail: First the party feeds the mercenaries bread soaked in a potion of Everything Tastes Like Fish. Then Lirael goes inside to talk to Felicia, and it goes badly. Turckle goes to comfort her and take her home. Lirael waits two minutes before following, and when he steps outside she is gone. Neebus comes out of the kitchen to help Xera.

events.title: Irresistible to Birds
events.summary: A potion of irresistibility to birds brings every amorous bird in Ardev down on the mercenaries, and the dishwasher Neebus too.
events.detail: Birds of all kinds come from all over town. The party forgot Neebus was nearby, and he comes running at Ellis as well. Lirael pins him down. When Sazed and Lirael try to drag him away he wriggles loose and very nearly gets to Ellis. They finally rescue the mercenaries from the birds and have Mustang lock Neebus up until the potion wears off.

events.title: The Spared Quasit
events.summary: Fat, fearless imps and quasits pour out of the Turckle and Churckle's side door with stolen food. Sazed lands on one from a rooftop.
events.detail: The demons are unafraid and harass the townsfolk. Sazed jumps off a building and kills an imp by landing on it. Brand and Lirael catch up and they cut down all but one quasit. For its life, the quasit names a shifter village the demons used to raid before it burned: Stones Throw. Sazed lets it go with orders to tell the demons to stop stealing. Later, working in the kitchen, Sazed catches more quasits in the storage room, with the spared one warning them he killed their friends. They flee and leave their loot behind.

events.title: The Right Hand at the Cannith Forge
events.summary: After helping Xera run the bar, the party follows Barry to the Cannith Forge. They meet The Right Hand, Merrix d'Cannith's emissary, and Brand fights with his nephew Brokk.
events.detail: Short on staff, the party calls Beezel, Screech and Rufus to help Xera, and tries the ring of Jeff, but nobody appears. Stray animals follow them to the forge. The Right Hand and his warforged owl Archimedes are leaving as they arrive. He is in Ardev to make sure the merging of the police and the Dragons Claw goes smoothly, as it was Art's plan, and he warns that they have angered the mercenaries. Jeff finally arrives: a frog man cursed by a witch he cheated on to obey whoever holds the ring, annoyed at having run the whole way. They send him to help Xera. Inside, Brokk calls Brand a murderer. He says the family forge stopped releasing its inventions, while House Cannith actually ships them.

events.title: Gynn at the Cannith Forge
events.summary: Mephits are looting the forge, and one is an illusion hiding a glabrezu named Gynn. Lirael slips the ring of random teleportation onto the demon and sends him away.
events.detail: Sazed spots the mephits stealing from the next room and the party moves in. Struck, one mephit reveals itself as Gynn the glabrezu. He wants Brokk and offers to let them live if they hand him over. They refuse. In a single round Gynn knocks Sazed out, and Brand quickly heals him. Then Lirael, in a moment of genius, slips the ring of unpredictable teleportation onto Gynn and activates it. The remaining mephits are easy.

events.title: Brokk Refuses the Ship
events.summary: Brokk thanks them, but it changes nothing. He refuses to board Brand's airship and goes to shelter at Ardev Castle with the Dragons Claw.
events.detail: Gynn is gone but will be back, so they have to leave. Brokk finds an invisibility scroll and argues with Brand over the plan before they go, and the strays follow them again. At the Turckle and Churckle, Brokk refuses to get on the Moonwatch. Brand finally gives up. Barry and Brokk leave for the castle, and Brand decides to drown his sorrows. The party frees Jeff from his obligations and he starts drinking too.

events.title: Filgar the Wererat
events.summary: Sent for a keg, Brand finds Filgar the wererat in the bar's basement and settles in to get drunk with him.
events.detail: Xera is scared of a huge rat in the basement. Filgar turns out to be completely relaxed. He is waiting for The Rat Man, Pick Wick Pendleton. They drink in basements by night and spend their days in the forest punching birds. Like Smarmy before him, Brand has found the strangest creature around and made it his best friend. Xera sends Lirael down for the keg, then Screech, then Sazed, and each one but Lirael stays to drink, Sazed passing round Larkleaf. Another wererat brings back Neebus, who was being annoying, and he is sent away again.

events.title: An Interview Gone Wrong
events.summary: Lirael comes back up with the keg to find a reporter waiting to interview him. He sits for it reluctantly, and it does not go well.
events.detail: She is publishing either way, so Lirael goes through with it. Then he tells Elk and Neer what happened to Kal, and that Kal is under gentle repose. They are proud of his work and tell him to come by tomorrow so they can pool gold for a diamond. Sazed asks Filgar about the Silver Flame. Filgar only knows the church gives him free food. The Rat Man never shows up. When the drinkers stumble upstairs, Lirael and Xera close the bar and head to the Moonwatch to wind down.

events.title: Felicia Taken
events.summary: Lirael's house is wrecked. Turckle's flask, Felicia's purse and the teleportation ring lie on the floor, and Gynn has dragged two bodies away.
events.detail: The Moonwatch crew has had a raucous night of its own, so the party goes looking for Felicia before relaxing. On the walk the strays follow again, and now an owl circles above them. Brand casts identify on the ring and learns it sent Gynn to the Gorgis house. The party follows the drag marks to the surface, where the trail vanishes. Glabrezus can fly.

events.title: The Clocktower and the Cat
events.summary: The clocktower watchman saw which way the glabrezu went. On the way to the castle, a stray cat tries to lead them somewhere else.
events.detail: The party talks its way past a sleepy young mercenary guard and climbs to the top of the clocktower. The man on watch saw the glabrezu and the direction it flew before he lost it. They head for the castle. Sazed calls one of the strays, a cat, onto his shoulder, and it grows agitated as they near the castle. Beezel is called to talk to it. The cat is a druid: the mercenaries plan to kill them at the castle tonight, and someone wants to talk to them. The cat tries to lead them stealthily, but Brand and Lirael stick out, and the owl follows.

events.title: The White Stag
events.summary: At the forest edge, a white stag with a brown crescent moon on its brow leads Sazed alone to a secret meeting. It is The Bloodsinger, leader of the Covenant of Emberfall.
events.detail: The radical shifter group believes modern society must be destroyed for shifters to survive, and that the Dreamweaver could be used to that end. They work with the Dragons Claw as a means to an end, with no loyalty to it. The Bloodsinger wants to recruit Sazed. He does not know where the demons come from, but warns of a deep darkness in Ardev from the Dark Six, the Fury in particular. He names Fark's Bargain Whores as an inflection point. As Sazed leaves he sees dozens of eyes in the trees, and The Bloodsinger turns into air. Back on the Moonwatch everyone has passed out, and Lirael finds Xera asleep in his bed and covers her with a blanket.

events.title: Stealing the Morning Paper
events.summary: Lirael wakes at 7:45 and races, invisible, to the Ardev Watch to stop his interview from hitting the streets.
events.detail: Leaving the ship, he finds Mustang keeping watch while mercenaries case the Moonwatch. Mustang warns that the mercenaries are coming for him, and that Jazz thinks a night in jail might smooth things over. Lirael spots invisible mercenaries waiting in ambush and turns invisible himself. At the paper he fakes the sound of the glabrezu to scatter the paper boys. He forges a note saying the papers will be picked up later, and Grib Grimley leaves them outside the office. Lirael carries the stack back to the ship, though more copies are bound for the library at noon. The headline: Murderer Returns to Ardev: Admits to Killing Again.

events.title: The Candle Test
events.summary: Xera is shocked and impressed that Lirael finally learned magic, and sets him an old test from their youth.
events.detail: When Lirael drops his invisibility, Xera hands him an unlit candle to light, the test they used to do. Lirael answers with a fire bolt that destroys the camera. She hugs him and says she knew he used magic on Ellis. Lirael denies it again, and she tells him he is cute when he lies.

events.title: The Abandoned House
events.summary: Brand's detect good and evil leads straight to an abandoned house full of demon sign, Turckle's supplies and Felicia's Blood of Vol charm.
events.detail: The crew wakes from nightmares, all except Filgar and Jeff, who are now friends. The party keeps Felicia's kidnapping from Felicia Sr and Xera. They put their Sentinels on the ship's guns and try to bring the invisible mercenaries in to talk, but the mercenaries leave and then trail them through town. In the abandoned house's basement there is a sealed passage. Brand disarms its trap and keeps the claymore mine.

events.title: The Lost Mausoleum of Ardev
events.summary: The passage opens on the tomb of Alton Ardev, who led outcast drow from Sharn to build a town for all races, half above ground and half in Khyber.
events.detail: A soft glow fills the chamber, and a low fountain sparkles with blue, rejuvenating water. Murals show Alton as a humble figure among drow and goblinoids, the outcasts fleeing Sharn, and his procession into the wilds with his staff raised. One mural shows the vision of Ardev with its people mingling in peace. Statues show him young and hopeful and then old and weathered. A final mural shows him standing alone before the King of Breland, pleading for his town. A young Neer and Elk were once his advisors.

events.title: Five Imps in Twelve Seconds
events.summary: Imps and quasits guard the mausoleum entrance. In twelve seconds Sazed sprints 110 feet and kicks five of them to death.
events.detail: The imps and quasits are gathered at the entrance to the mausoleum. Sazed covers 110 feet in one sprint and kicks five of them to death in twelve seconds. Brand kills the last one. The table names the session after it: Sazed Kills 120,000,000,000 Imps In One Turn.

events.title: Weresharks in the Halls
events.summary: The party sneaks past two weresharks, Topek and Wylon. Lirael knows them, but something is wrong with them.
events.detail: Deeper in the mausoleum the party sneaks past the two weresharks. Lirael knows them both, but something about them is wrong. The party avoids a fight and keeps moving. Along the way they also find a mimic chest. Later that day Topek and Wylon fight the bone devil alongside them.

events.title: Heeby Deeby Dee, You Killed Me
events.summary: Following music, the party finds Shrimp Diggery, the annoying, old and weirdly tough imp they killed. He has written a song about it.
events.detail: Shrimp is drinking holy water because it tastes good, even though it burns him. After they killed him he started on the hot side of the portal and came through to the cold side, where people don't like him. The party trades a flute and two ounces of Larkleaf for nine bottles of Ancient Ardev Holy Water, three each. Shrimp shows them a secret passage and has something important to say, but cannot remember it. Sazed takes that as a cue to look around, and spots mud mephits about to ambush them.

events.title: A Seductive Voice
events.summary: One of the mud mephits contacts someone telepathically, and a seductive woman begins taunting them in their minds.
events.detail: In the next room an enlarged bone devil strains to reach them and cannot. Shrimp wants them to free his friend Snarky, so they leave him. The murals reveal that a hobgoblin Dreamweaver cult once infiltrated Ardev, exploiting its inclusive ideals and bringing a hard crackdown from the Crown. Alton left to seek counsel with the King. Before the main room, Sazed and Brand have visions from their gods that empower them, and Lirael pulls new power from within.

events.title: The Fury Ritual
events.summary: Fark is a succubus. With Gynn she has murdered Turckle, the Gorgises, Neer and Elk, and bound Felicia above a portal as a vessel for the Fury.
events.detail: The victims, including the draft dodgers Neer and Elk had been hiding, hang mutilated around the room. Felicia lies bound and in a trance on a table above the demon portal. The party attacks and Fark activates the ritual. The Fury appears in spectral form, growing more solid by the moment. Gynn stuns Sazed, but Brand saves him with his luck. Lirael destroys the corpses of Shmerly Gorgis and Neer and breaks Felicia's trance. They kill Fark and she is absorbed into the portal, which spits out two lesser demons.

events.title: The Chicken Gambit
events.summary: Lirael turns his sister into a chicken and misty-steps her out of the portal's grip. For a moment all three see something beyond.
events.detail: Felicia cannot leave the bounds of the portal in any form, so Lirael picks up the chicken and misty-steps away. There is a flash of light. Brand and Sazed see their god, and Lirael sees Felicia as a child. They come back where they were: the misty step worked and Felicia is no longer a chicken. The demons' magic fails and the portal goes dead.

events.title: Felicia's Fire
events.summary: Gynn dies, and Felicia's grief and rage erupt as an unintended fireball that kills the demons. Like Lirael's, her latent sorcery has been woken by a ritual.
events.detail: She begins mutilating Gynn's corpse. When Sazed tries to stop her and put a blanket on her, she shoots a fire bolt at him. Lirael casts calm emotions and she breaks down sobbing. They wrap her in a blanket and start out of the dungeon. She is terrified and traumatised.

events.title: Down the Underground River
events.summary: Fleeing the dungeon, the party fights through abishai and the bone devil. Brand takes 49 damage in a single turn and they dive into an underground river.
events.detail: Abishai ambush them from a room of magical darkness, planning to use their corpses to restart the ritual. Lirael's hypnotic pattern buys a minute. The bone devil, smaller now, moves to cut them off and Felicia fireballs it by accident. Topek and Wylon have killed the other demons and are losing to the devil. Brand helps, the weresharks jump into the river, and Felicia unintentionally casts darkness to cover Brand. Brand casts enlarge on the pursuing devil, and it smashes the statues of Elk and Neer as it follows. Just as it catches them, Brand snares it in a web.

events.title: Rallying Ardev
events.summary: The river spits them out into Ardev's lake, where the Moonwatch is waiting. Then they go door to door to raise a force against the bone devil.
events.detail: On board, Felicia Sr is none the wiser, Xera is suspicious, and Filgar and Jeff are drunk. Felicia Jr lies to their mother about what happened and she believes it. Everyone not needed is sent below deck. Captain Flowers at the police station is convinced of the danger and deploys every officer, and The Right Hand will gather the mercenaries. At the fairgrounds they recruit Auntie Bees, a bizarre woman obsessed with bees who loves Ardev and will help.

events.title: All of Ardev vs the Bone Devils
events.summary: Police, mercenaries, druids, two weresharks and Auntie Bees with a million bees meet the devil as it digs up through the abandoned house.
events.detail: Beezel, Screech, Sorenson, Topek and Wylon come with the party. Jazz, Mustang and Snivel Fargus lead the police, and The Right Hand brings Brokk, Barry, Morganth and the mercenaries, though Ellis and Baron Hellsauce are absent. Morganth tells Lirael they have a truce for today, and Brokk tells Brand the same. The Bloodsinger arrives with his druids and becomes a triceratops. The devil bursts up, summons a second, and friends and enemies destroy both. Sazed shoos away the reporters Grib Grimley and Helena Braithwind. Nothing changes with Brokk or Morganth, but The Right Hand is impressed with Brand and the Bloodsinger with Sazed. Auntie Bees chases off the mercenaries with her bees for taking her castle.

events.title: Oberoth the Guardian
events.summary: Back in the mausoleum, the party ambushes the abishai, then Oberoth the Guardian barges in, ridden by Snarky Chark and Shrimp Diggery.
events.detail: With Sorenson, Screech, Beezel, Topek and Wylon in tow, the party destroys a lightning trap and finds the Sling of Ardev and a Ring of Spell Storing. The abishai are out of their trance and trying to restart the portal. Oberoth demands that the intruders leave or be killed, and Mustang shoots him in the face twice. The party finishes the abishai and then does as Oberoth asks. The guardian is surprised and grateful.

events.title: Calm Emotions in the Square
events.summary: Crossing the square, the party walks into Morganth's crew fighting Auntie Bees. Lirael calms everyone, and Morganth slips him a scroll of see invisibility.
events.detail: Xera and her sister Zenya are keeping the townsfolk distracted by dancing to Gribble Goblin and his Green Goblin Goblin band. Morganth, Brokk, Snivel Fargus and The Right Hand burst in, battling Auntie Bees over her castle. Lirael's calm emotions settles everyone except The Right Hand, who resents the interference. The Bloodsinger in stag form scares Auntie Bees away, then vanishes into a tree. Morganth again asks Lirael to join the Dragons Claw and says they seem fated to be foes. When Lirael wishes Morganth could see reason, Morganth says he would be surprised what Morganth can see, and presses the scroll into his hand. Children hand out flyers: Thaddeus Cannith will open a House Cannith recording studio on the 22nd, with a speech and free records.

events.title: Fey-Lynn's Magic Society
events.summary: In the Kel House basement, Fey-Lynn insists Karrnath controls the Dreamweaver and interrogates Lirael about his possession. Sazed catches anger flashing across her face.
events.detail: On the way, talk of a bear army inspires Beezel to run off and raise one. The meeting includes Auntie Threadwood, aunt of Lirael's friend Rory, Wilford Chism, Neebus Flit and The Right Hand. Everyone is shocked that Turckle, Neer and Elk are dead except Fey-Lynn, who just wants to get on with the meeting. She believes the Karrnathi military has the Shadow Mirror, the Obelisk and the Gate, and tolerates no dissent. Brand doesn't believe The Right Hand could have intercepted the messages they decode, and walks out. Lirael explains Beware of Knowledge and, finally, that detect thoughts lets him spot the possessed, which fascinates Fey-Lynn. Outside, Brand and Sazed give him grief for telling her, and they agree to come back in the morning and read her mind.

events.title: Wererats and Bears Aboard
events.summary: The party returns to find the Moonwatch hosting a huge party of wererats and bears, and Brand delivers a dad lecture.
events.detail: Barry, Sorenson and Screech are jamming. The wererats call Brand lame and leave, and Jeff goes with them. Lirael and The Rat Man tell each other off. Filgar comes to Brand's room to apologise. The party sets a guard rotation, keeping ten free hours for Screech to record with Barry for Thaddeus's speech. After a short rest they sneak out through the landing gear to avoid the eye of Archimedes.

events.title: Stones Throw in Ashes
events.summary: The shifter village is burned and destroyed, with a pile of corpses bearing radiant burns. A treant named Eldgrave says it was the Silver Flame.
events.detail: Among the wreckage the party finds a +1 greatsword and a Helm of the Devout. While they try to bury the dead, a pile of trees turns out to be Eldgrave. Once he trusts them he explains that it was not the old, moderate Silver Flame faithful from town. It was young, powerful warriors who came from all sides in the dead of night. He does not know why the Bloodsinger was not there.

events.title: Children in the Well
events.summary: Eldgrave says there are kids in the well. Under the rock and boards, eight small children and ten-year-old Skye Amberwood have hidden for a week.
events.detail: Brand's ingenuity, Sazed's agility and the treant's strength move the rock and pry the boards off the plug. The children are two to five years old. Sazed knew Skye's father, Glade Amberwood, and uses that to win her trust. Skye says Carrk promised to help them but never came. She wants to know where her father is and whether anyone survived, and Sazed will not tell her. They pull the children out with a rope, and Sazed asks Eldgrave to stay and guard the village.

events.title: Archimedes Shot Down
events.summary: Back at the Moonwatch, Brand shoots The Right Hand's warforged owl Archimedes out of the sky with ray of frost and stuffs him in the bag of holding.
events.detail: They slip the children aboard through the landing gear and settle them in Cromwell's room. Skye asks why a shifter has an airship and who Sazed really is. Instead of answering he gives her a motivational speech rooted in his own past. It satisfies her for now, though she wants to know more. Sazed sleeps in front of the door.

events.title: A Dream of the Gate
events.summary: Sazed and Brand receive dream messages from their gods. Lirael dreams of his father saying only: "The Gate".
events.detail: Sazed and Brand each receive a message from their gods while they sleep. Lirael's dream is of his father, who says only "The Gate". Felicia Jr sleeps on Lirael's floor, as she did as a child after a bad dream. In the morning she asks him for a spell to delete a memory and says she wants to talk later. Lirael says hi to his mother and runs off to the Kel House without checking for invisible ambushers.

events.title: At Xera's Window
events.summary: Lirael climbs to Xera's second-floor window at dawn and tells her Turckle, Neer and Elk are dead. He asks for her necklace.
events.detail: Xera wants to know why Turckle didn't come in to work. Lirael tells her the demons killed him, and wanted to use Felicia as a vessel for the Fury. He has to get his mother and sister to safety, and she can come if she wants, though she will be safe if she stays. She hands over the necklace, which came in an unaddressed letter a year ago. Then Lirael starts reading the minds in the house: Zenya is asleep and dreaming, and next is Fey-Lynn.

events.title: Phase Two
events.summary: Fey-Lynn is possessed by the Dreamweaver and enacting phase two: taking Lirael's mother out for tea.
events.detail: Lirael reaches into Fey-Lynn's mind from Xera's room. She is possessed by the Dreamweaver and is carrying out its phase two, which means taking Felicia Sr out for tea. As Lirael reads her, he finds another mind nearby and peers in, and it is reading his. He fails to probe deeper and flees the Kel House with Xera. As they run, men in plague masks set fire to his family's house and ride off in an armored carriage.

events.title: Ambushed by Ellis
events.summary: At the cemetery entrance to upper Ardev, Ellis's wizard holds Lirael in place and the mercenary beats him unconscious.
events.detail: Lirael and Xera are running from the Kel House toward upper Ardev when Ellis catches them. His wizard casts hold person, and Ellis beats the helpless Lirael until he passes out. Lirael and Xera are both captured. Before the morning is over The Even Hand kills Ellis and takes the captives for himself.

events.title: Jyo Falls into Ardev
events.summary: Jyo, a Sentinel, is sucked into a sinkhole outside the World Scar and comes out near lower Ardev. He puts out the fire at the Xal'ri house.
events.detail: Townsfolk tell him Lirael is in town with an airship, and they are not happy about it. They hand him the latest Ardev Watch: Mass Murderer Summons Demons in Ardev. Helena Braithwind's article blames Lirael for the demons and the murders of Neer, Elk, Turckle and the Gorgises. It credits Morganth's Dragons Claw with saving the town. Grib Grimley has stopped publishing, and the second headline announces Thaddeus Cannith's studio opening.

events.title: Mustang Full of Arrows
events.summary: A frantic Mustang bursts onto the Moonwatch bristling with arrows: Felicia Sr has been kidnapped.
events.detail: Fey-Lynn took Felicia Sr out for tea. Mustang thought something was wrong and followed. Felicia was taken and snipers in the clocktower attacked him. Brand wakes the ship and prepares everyone. Jyo wanders aboard, surprising everyone, and reveals he is a Sentinel. There is no time to ask how he got there.

events.title: Ellis Dead in the Street
events.summary: Screech flies the Moonwatch low over town. Below lie Ellis and his wizard, brutally killed, and the armored carriage is fleeing Ardev.
events.detail: The Even Hand killed them and took Lirael and Xera for himself. The Moonwatch gives chase and catches up to the carriage. The party jumps down onto it with Mustang and Felicia Jr. The Even Hand is waiting for them on the roof.

events.title: Mustang Betrays Them
events.summary: On the roof of the fleeing carriage, Mustang turns on the party. He has been one of The Even Hand's bodies all along.
events.detail: The party lands on the roof with Mustang and Felicia Jr, and The Even Hand is waiting. Then Mustang turns on them. Felicia turns invisible and slips below to look for her mother and brother. The party knocks Mustang and The Even Hand off again and again, but they climb back on with grappling hooks. Sazed is thrown off, catches the side, and the top floor explodes in a fireball above him.

events.title: Ball Bearings and an Arcane Safe
events.summary: Sazed smashes into the carriage, scatters ball bearings and finds no hostages, only an arcane safe that is a portal to the Astral Plane.
events.detail: The ball bearings trip the plague soldiers inside. Sazed avoids them, climbs to the second floor and finds Felicia with a burning plague soldier, whom he finishes off. There is no sign of Felicia Sr or Lirael. Sazed recognises the runes on the safe: it opens onto the astral realm.

events.title: Out of Your Depth
events.summary: The carriage nears a lightning rail bristling with ballistas and anti-air cannons. The Even Hand tells Brand they are out of their depth, and that he has been living invisibly on the Moonwatch.
events.detail: Brand and Jyo spot the train from the carriage roof. Its guns are aimed at the Moonwatch. The Even Hand advises them to jump off, since they are not his mission right now. To push Brand off, Mustang has to switch off his own personality core. Brand only just saves himself with his leg struts.

events.title: Leap from the Carriage
events.summary: With the train in sight and the Moonwatch unable to cover them, the party jumps clear with the safe. They have lost this round.
events.detail: Sazed shoves the safe out and climbs to the roof with Felicia. Another plague soldier falls dead from his horse, and The Even Hand is thrown onto the road again before sprinting away. A plague soldier's thunderwave knocks Felicia off, and Brand catches her at the last moment. As they recover, Mustang fires a final volley from the carriage and drops Brand unconscious. Sazed heals him and they escape on the Moonwatch with the safe and a dead plague soldier. Peering into the safe, they see the Astral Plane, a portal, and a train car where Mustang and The Even Hand are closing another safe.

events.title: Paxon: A Black-Booked Train
events.summary: Paxon calls. Lirael and his mother are being arrested on bunk charges, and an unfinished lightning rail was switched on last night.
events.detail: If the party can get them out, the charges can be fought and won. Paxon found the train black-booked and will look into who turned the old line on. He advises against killing the plague soldiers, who are probably Brelish soldiers. He also found that Mustang had no record before Ardev. The train reaches the end of its unfinished track in six hours.

events.title: A Bear Army and a Pigeon
events.summary: Paxon calls again: Eloria will be in Ardev at 0815 tomorrow. Beezel has raised his bear army with help from Mr. Beaks the pigeon.
events.detail: Frustrated by the defeat, the party plans its next steps while Felicia barely holds on. Beezel's bear army grew out of the talk on the way to the Kel House. The party finds a tracking charm hidden on the ship. They give it to Mr. Beaks and send him flying off with it.

events.title: Brand's Workshop
events.summary: Brand builds a machine to remove the safe's hinges, two train decouplers, and a ray to blast Mustang's positronic brain back on.
events.detail: The hinge machine is for the second safe, the one aboard the train. The decouplers are for cutting the train apart, and the ray is meant to switch Mustang's personality core back on. Erald delivers a pair of sending stones so the party can talk to Jyo, plus blueprints of the train. Lirael has the sending stone tied to the Moonwatch, so Sazed will signal Screech with his light instead.

events.title: A Call from Lirael
events.summary: Erald comes to them terrified: Lirael is calling his stone. On the line is Lirael, dreamwoven, threatening Ember and the Sagewoods.
events.detail: Erald's sending stone is ringing from Lirael's end, and the party takes the call. Lirael is dreamwoven and warns them to stop following him. He threatens Ember and the Sagewoods. When he realises they mean to keep pursuing, he tells them to sleep well.

events.title: Skye Feels Abandoned
events.summary: Sazed decides to hide the shifter children at an old hideout, and Skye is furious at being left behind.
events.detail: The hideout was discovered a decade ago, which Sazed thinks may make it safer now. Skye is getting angry. She wants to know where she is being taken and what is going on. When she hears she will be left alone, she is furious with Sazed. To her he is one more adult abandoning her and going off to die.

events.title: Shadowing the Train
events.summary: While the party finishes its long rest, Screech matches the train's speed and keeps the Moonwatch just over the horizon ahead of it.
events.detail: The party goes to bed to finish its long rests. Screech holds the Moonwatch just over the horizon in front of the train. That keeps the ship out of sight of the ballistas and anti-air cannons. When the rests are done, the party puts its plan into action.

events.title: Jyo the Spider
events.summary: Brand's machine removes the safe's hinges, but an unseen ray severs the scissor arm. Jyo slips through the gap as a spider.
events.detail: Jyo protects himself from possession with protection from evil and good and sets a return point for his ring of return location. Through the hole he reaches the train car and sees Fey-Lynn, Xera, Mustang and The Even Hand. Spotting a spider, the captors go on alert and hold the women hostage, threatening it. Jyo slips out the door onto the roof. Mustang follows and flicks him off the train.

events.title: The Invisible Beholder
events.summary: Jyo teleports back and tells everyone to follow. An invisible beholder stands before the portal, and Sazed stuns it so they can run past.
events.detail: They burst into the train car, which surprises Mustang and The Even Hand, except that they cannot be surprised. The captors seize the women again. The Even Hand says that if anyone takes one step, he will do what he did to Kal. Jyo slips through the door again and crawls along the underside of the train, believing he is unseen.

events.title: Xera and Fey-Lynn Beheaded
events.summary: The Even Hand and Mustang carry out their threat and behead Xera and Fey-Lynn.
events.detail: The killings happen in front of the whole party. The Even Hand repeats that the party is out of its depth, and says the Flock will find Jyo. Jyo reaches the end of the car, turns back into himself and uses a decoupler to detach the train just as one of the Flock steps out. Their bodies are later carried off the train in the bag of holding.

events.title: Bears and a Barrel
events.summary: Sazed and Beezel's bears charge The Even Hand and Mustang. The Even Hand kills Maisha the bear, and Cromwell tumbles through the portal.
events.detail: Sazed and the bears attack The Even Hand and Mustang. The Even Hand kills Maisha, one of the bears. Then Cromwell comes through the portal. He fell asleep drunk in a barrel and came along without anyone knowing, and now he has come to help.

events.title: Mustang Wakes
events.summary: Brand enlarges Sazed and blasts Mustang with his ray. Mustang's own mind wakes long enough to strike his master and shout that it is a trap.
events.detail: The ray is the one Brand built to switch Mustang's personality core back on. Mustang surprises The Even Hand with an attack. He tells the party to run, because it is a trap. Then he falls to the floor inactive. The Even Hand is intrigued that one of his bodies has a mind of its own, and says he will mind wipe it.

events.title: Counterspelled by Lirael
events.summary: Outnumbered, The Even Hand flees into the astral realm. When Brand follows, his magic missile is countered by an invisible, dreamwoven Lirael.
events.detail: Brand turns invisible and Sazed comes through the portal after him. Lirael fireballs the spot where Brand stood a moment before. Cromwell peeks in and out of the portal firing arrows. On the train roof Jyo sees the Flock approaching and a light from the Moonwatch. He uses his last teleport to return to the ship and enter the astral realm.

events.title: The Even Hand Dies
events.summary: The bears Telos and Gruff enter the portal and are possessed. The Even Hand appears with Felicia Sr as a hostage, until Brand's lightning and Sazed's fists end him.
events.detail: Coming out of invisibility, The Even Hand tells everyone to stop. He means to wait until they are all possessed. In one swift move Brand reveals himself and hits him with lightning while Sazed pulls Felicia Sr clear. Sazed finishes off the assassin, then stuns the dreamwoven Lirael.

events.title: Five Minutes of Air
events.summary: The party knocks out Lirael and Felicia Sr and puts them in the bag of holding, where they have five minutes of air.
events.detail: They are both dreamwoven. Brand takes Lirael's sending stone. Meanwhile Cromwell is ambushed while peeking out of the portal: the train doors have opened and the Flock are there. He jumps out, misty-steps onto the roof and shoves one of them off. As the party exits the portal, Sazed sees a light message from the Moonwatch: "Something big coming, we must move, AA guns offline?"

events.title: The Dream Prison
events.summary: Inside his own mind, Lirael wakes in a cage in a dream prison alongside Felicia Sr, Xera and Fey-Lynn.
events.detail: A Dreamweaver beholder comes to taunt him and shows him Ellis's brutal death. Lirael feels a little of his magic return and picks the lock with a rusted piece of metal. As he tries to escape he watches Xera and Fey-Lynn fall and die. The Dreamweaver taunts him once more.

events.title: Jyo Torn Apart by Bears
events.summary: The train is racing toward a massive turtle-shaped mobile fortress. The possessed bears come out of the portal and tear Jyo to pieces.
events.detail: Cromwell is down and the Flock are pushing him off the train. The party kills the bears, a moment too late. With the beholder emerging from the portal, Cromwell down and Jyo dead, they are hopelessly outnumbered. Sazed races to the top of the car to heal Cromwell.

events.title: Ten Minutes of Freedom
events.summary: Brand pulls Lirael from the bag and casts protection from evil and good on him, giving him ten minutes free of possession. Lirael's hypnotic pattern entrances the beholder.
events.detail: The Moonwatch keeps coming in under fire from the anti-air guns, and Brand calls the ship to get out of range until they call. Lirael's lucky hypnotic pattern stops the beholder. They shove the bodies of Jyo, Xera and Fey-Lynn into the bag of holding. Brand breaks open Mustang's chest and takes his rune. A black, suffocating mist begins to form.

events.title: Hooves in the Mist
events.summary: The Flock flee in fear. Hooves sound in the mist, and hellfire orbs blow the fleeing Flock to pieces. The Skull Knight has come to save them, and then to judge them.
events.detail: The party climbs to the roof of the car to join Sazed and Cromwell. The Flock are already fleeing in fear when the sound of approaching hooves reaches them. Hellfire orbs tear the fleeing Flock apart. The Skull Knight arrives on an undead horse. They call the Moonwatch and tell it to pick them up at the last car once the anti-air guns blow.

events.title: The Train Hits the Turtle Fortress
events.summary: Sazed plants a smokepowder satchel on the train's elemental ring and jumps. The Skull Knight catches him, and the train slams into the fortress and blows its head off.
events.detail: Brand detaches the last car with the final decoupler while Lirael thunderwaves to slow it. Lirael's mage hand signals the Moonwatch through the smoke, and Cromwell's mage hand retrieves The Even Hand's rune from the astral realm. The Skull Knight rides Sazed back to the detached car, then vanishes as the smoke clears. The Moonwatch takes a little more fire before the train is out of range. Climbing the rope, they watch the explosion destroy the fortress's head before the whole fortress turns invisible.

events.title: Felicia Learns the Cost
events.summary: On the Moonwatch's deck, Felicia is thrilled to see Lirael and horrified to learn what happened to Fey-Lynn and Xera.
events.detail: The party climbs onto the deck and tells Screech to fly back to Hobbstweedle. Felicia is overjoyed that her brother is alive and free. Then she learns what happened to Fey-Lynn and Xera, and she is horrified. Their bodies, and Jyo's, are in the bag of holding.

events.title: The Skull Knight's Judgment
events.summary: The black mist returns and the Skull Knight steps onto the deck to judge those who carry the Obelisk and the Gate.
events.detail: Lirael's father carried these artifacts before them. The knight asks a series of cryptic questions and the party's answers satisfy him. He concludes that they are careful of knowledge, have seen half the light, and that their minds are barricaded. He judges them worthy to carry the Obelisk and the Gate. Then he uses his sword to open a portal into Lirael.

events.title: Do You Know Its True Name?
events.summary: Inside Lirael's dream prison, the Dreamweaver rants at the Skull Knight. The knight silences it by asking whether it knows its true name.
events.detail: The knight frees Lirael from possession, something he cannot do often. He says they have the chosen of Dol Dorn as an ally. He warns that the Dreamweaver corrupts knowledge to feed its power, as it has done to his own history. If they learn too much and become possessed, he will kill them. He leaves into the mist, saying he will be watching, and that the wizard of time believes they may stop the key from turning.

events.title: Mr. Beaks Returns
events.summary: Mr. Beaks comes back from his decoy mission. Filgar wakes up and punches him, to everyone's annoyance.
events.detail: Mr. Beaks had flown off carrying the tracking charm as a decoy. When Filgar heads below deck to amuse himself, the crew stops him. They then clear the ship of every remaining tracking charm. Brand turns the arcane safe into an anti-magic field and throws the trackers inside.

events.title: Sazed Comes Back
events.summary: The party returns to the shifter hideout for Skye and the children. She is stunned that Sazed is alive.
events.detail: She had been angry that he was another adult leaving her to die. Coming back alive earns Sazed major points with her. On the way to Ardev she grows tired of him dodging her questions, but she does not push. She is happy he came back.

events.title: A Missed Recording Session
events.summary: Barry and Brokk are waiting in Ardev, angry that Sorenson missed the recording session. Thaddeus has had to push his speech back a day.
events.detail: Sorenson was meant to record with Barry for the opening of the House Cannith studio. They ask whether he can record now, and the party says no. Barry will be back tomorrow. The party kicks Filgar off the ship, and he goes to find the Rat Man.

events.title: I Tag Ye Cosmic
events.summary: Obelisk and Gate slot into the hidden desk and black light fills the den. A hidden compartment holds a wayfinder compass missing its lodestone.
events.detail: Lower Ardev has shifted when they return, and the top floor of Lirael's house is burned away. The party activates the Ring of Jeff as they enter. Placing both artifacts fully lights the obelisk and a little door opens in the wall. In the empty lodestone slot is a note from Lirael Sr: "I Tag Ye Cosmic." They realise it is an anagram of The Magic Society.

events.title: Lilya the Guide
events.summary: Under the Kel House the lodestone brings the compass to life, and the apparition of a drow girl appears. Lilya will guide them, though she can't say where.
events.detail: Lirael checks with detect thoughts that the Kel House is empty. They climb in through Xera's open window and search the basement until they find the lodestone. Fitted into the compass, it fills with magical energy. Lilya leads them toward Khyber. They decide to take care of a few things in Ardev first and head to the Silver Flame church.

events.title: Curfew in Ardev
events.summary: Ardev is crawling with mercenaries and police: a 9pm curfew for children and an 11pm curfew for adults. Mercenaries throw dead imps into a cart.
events.detail: Children are being sent inside as the party passes. At the church they meet Milton Gravewood, Murphy's father. After he lost the forge to Cannith his wife died, and he started drinking and lost the house. They give him some gold, and Brand offers him a job, but he would rather drink. He leaves to find alcohol.

events.title: Bimble Niblet Repents
events.summary: Inside the Silver Flame church, Bimble Niblet, the quasit Sazed spared, has given up his evil ways and gives Sazed the blessing of the repentant.
events.detail: Sazed finds another poem from Carrk in the sign-in sheet. It shares Carrk's thoughts on the Covenant of Emberfall, and he is unsure whether they are right. Wilford leads them to the basement to talk privately. There they run into Filgar and The Rat Man. The Rat Man doesn't want to leave until they intimidate him, and he backs away telling them to keep walking.

events.title: A Stranger Evil
events.summary: Wilford Chism felt the Fury's presence in Ardev vanish yesterday. Something stranger has taken its place.
events.detail: Wilford tells them something was off with Fey-Lynn, and they tell him she was possessed. He does not trust The Right Hand, and the Magic Society is functionally over. He has felt a powerful evil growing in the town. With this, the Ardev arc and the first act of the campaign come to an end.

events.title: Wilford Doubts the Ardev Watch
events.summary: Back in an Ardev of checkpoints and curfews, the party finds Wilford Chism in the basement of the Silver Flame church. He tells them the Ardev Watch's hit pieces are turning the town against Lirael, and he does not believe a word of them.
events.detail: The town the party returns to has changed: checkpoints on the streets and a curfew enforced by police and mercenaries. Wilford says the stories in the Ardev Watch have the townsfolk upset and angry. He does not trust what the paper reports. A tortle reporter named Dell has already come to him looking for the real story. Wilford cannot stay long; he has funerals to prepare. The party's next stop is the Valvier house, where the family promised enough gold to buy a diamond and revive Kal.

events.title: The Valvier House, Torched and Picked Over
events.summary: Jeff finally turns up as the party slips into the Valvier house through the secret passage in the icebox. Inside, the house is half burned and wrecked, and the promised gold is gone.
events.detail: Lirael takes a hammer to the head on the way through the icebox passage. The house is half torched and destroyed. The clues point to the demons: a burnt thong, a flyer for the Fark's Bargain brothel, and claw scratches on the walls. There are also signs of the police: bootprints, boarded windows and missing evidence. The gold is gone, but the Valviers' note is still there: "This is all our gold. Don't worry about us though, we can sell a few artifacts and be just fine. Neer has been telling me I need to do a purge anyways. Thank you for everything Lirael, just bring our great grandson home."

events.title: Jazz Learns Mustang Was the Even Hand
events.summary: At the police station, Jazz is pinning up a missing-person poster for the reporter Grib Grimley. The party tells him what happened to Xera, Felicia and Fey-Lynn, and that his partner Mustang was a body of the Even Hand.
events.detail: The party passes through a checkpoint on the way to the station. Grib Grimley is a reporter they have seen around town before, and now she is missing. Jazz is shocked by the news about his colleagues. Learning that Mustang belonged to the Even Hand hits him hardest. The party asks for his help going through the police files. He agrees, and leaves them alone with the records while he does paperwork in another room.

events.title: The Gold Under a False Name
events.summary: Brand slips past the alarm into the police evidence locker. The Valviers' gold is there, logged under the name Craig Jensen, with its evidence code erased from the file.
events.detail: The party finds the police file on the Valvier house. Its evidence code has been erased, but enough of it remains to work with. Brand breaks into the evidence locker without tripping the alarm. Using the code, they find the family's gold. Someone in the police had filed the Valviers' last fortune away under the name Craig Jensen. It is enough to buy a diamond.

events.title: Jazz Joins the Fold
events.summary: Lirael finds Jazz deeply upset over Xera and tells him about the quest to stop the Dreamweaver. Jazz already knows the name.
events.detail: Lirael leaves the files to speak with Jazz and catches him grieving over Xera. He tells Jazz what the party is really trying to do. They try to avoid naming the Dreamweaver, but Jazz already knows about it. The party brings him into the fold. From now on Jazz is their man on the inside of the Ardev police.

events.title: Captain Flowers Under Threat
events.summary: Upstairs, Lirael reads Captain Flowers's mind and hears the truth behind the curfew: the mercenaries will kill his family if he does not do what they say.
events.detail: Flowers is finishing a conversation with The Right Hand, who tells him the curfew will continue whether the townsfolk like it or not. Lirael's detect thoughts catches Flowers's dislike of the order and the threat behind it. The party tells Flowers they know his family is being threatened. He takes them to a room downstairs to talk, and they send Jazz out. They update him while hiding as much as they can. They want to save his family but cannot do it yet, and he admits he hates having the mercenaries in town but can do nothing about it. With Mustang gone, he assigns Jazz to watch out for the party.

events.title: The Right Hand Activates Daedalus
events.summary: In a short exchange with The Right Hand, Lirael hears his mind seething that Brand killed his owl. He silently sends word to activate Daedalus.
events.detail: The Right Hand stays polite on the surface while the party talks with him. Underneath, Lirael's detect thoughts picks up his anger over the owl Brand destroyed. He sends a message to activate something called Daedalus. The answer comes on the walk home. A warforged eagle watches the party from above as they return to the Moonwatch. It must be Daedalus.

events.title: Brokk's Peace Offering
events.summary: Back at the Moonwatch, the party finds a stack of armor plating left by Brokk, with a note calling things even between him and his uncle.
events.detail: The note reads: "Your ship is weak Uncle, I thought you could use some superior metal. Consider us even. - Brokk Broadhelm." Jazz comes back to the ship with them. Nobody is in a partying mood. They plan to repair the ship the next morning and then leave for Hearthsfire and Starilaskur. They also decide to try to rope Milton Gravewood into helping with the repairs.

events.title: A Body Count of Twenty-Six
events.summary: Slipping out at dawn to buy diamonds, Lirael picks up the morning paper. The Ardev Watch now keeps a daily body count for him, and it stands at 26.
events.detail: Lirael leaves before the non-drow wake, as soon as curfew ends. He tells Felicia Jr to raise the alarm if he is not back by 8:30. Milton is not at the liquor store. The paper's main story, "Deranged Murder Kills Again! Police Forced to Enact Curfew," blames the Even Hand and Ellis murders on Lirael and praises the police and mercenaries. It is signed by Helena Braithwind. A small column questions the curfew in carefully tamped-down language, signed Dell Quickfoot. People in the street start staring at Lirael, so he turns invisible.

events.title: Mercenaries at Turckle and Churckle
